“Ling Ting, don’t you regret this!”

Qin Nan’s mother didn’t believe that Ling Ting could live without her son. She stood up, pointed at her, threw out a harsh threat, grabbed her bag, and stormed off in a huff.

After driving Qin Nan’s mother away, Ling Ting slammed the door shut. Her legs went weak, and she slowly slid down to the floor.

Covering her mouth, her tears fell like broken pearls; she simply couldn’t control them.

She treated everyone with sincerity, so why was she being belittled to the point of being dust?

“Mom, Dad, I miss you so much...”

Because of the visit from Qin Nan’s mother, Ling Ting had a good cry out of grievance. Once she had cried enough, she got up to clean.

Due to her personality, Ling Ting had always been this way—whenever she felt wronged, she would bury herself in work.

Ling Ting knew she was pathetic for being like this, but with both her parents gone, she really lacked the confidence to stand her ground.

After cleaning the room, Ling Ting, fearing she would start overthinking, took out paper and a pen and began to draw.

She had studied fashion design. Although she hadn’t reached the level of a professional designer, the clothes she had helped Qiaoyin design over the past few years had gained recognition from quite a few people in that small online shop.

The little savings she had were all earned from drawing.

As for why she took the civil service exam?

It was entirely because of her parents.

When her parents were alive, they were both civil servants. She wanted a stable job to put her parents’ minds at ease in heaven.

When it came to hobbies, one loses track of time once immersed. After finishing a drawing, Ling Ting looked up and realized that, without noticing, it was already past four in the afternoon.

The day had passed too quickly. She organized her drawings.

Just as she was wondering whether to lie down and rest for a while, the phone on the table rang.

It was Ji Zhengyao!

Ling Ting’s expression was one of helplessness. She hesitated for a long time, unsure whether to open the message.

If she opened it, she truly didn’t know what she could say to Ji Zhengyao. If she didn’t, it would seem impolite.

After agonizing for a long time, Ling Ting finally couldn’t resist and tapped on Ji Zhengyao’s name.

This time was different from the previous two; there was no standard greeting. A link appeared prominently on the screen.

Ling Ting blinked. Curiosity got the better of her, and she clicked the link.

The link led to a small game where a hungry rabbit bumped into walls to find carrots.

Watching the little rabbit bump into the wall over and over again without finding the carrots it loved, Ling Ting couldn’t help but laugh out loud.

“How silly.”

The little rabbit seemed to hear her mockery; it wiggled its bottom and made a wronged expression.

Ling Ting thought it was adorable and, smiling, helped it bump open a wall.

But her luck was bad; there were no carrots behind the wall.

Feeling sorry for the little rabbit, Ling Ting frowned and bumped open another one.

Still nothing...

Ling Ting refused to give up. She bumped into walls one after another, but the little rabbit was dying of hunger and still hadn’t found a carrot.

In the end, the little rabbit couldn’t take it anymore and died of hunger...

Uh...

Ling Ting stared speechlessly at the starved rabbit, not understanding why a dignified Bureau Chief would send her such a childish game.

The game seemed simple, but it was actually testing her IQ.

Determined to prove herself, Ling Ting started the game again, but the result was the same as the previous times.

The little rabbit died of hunger again...

Looking at the rabbit that had died in despair, skin and bones, Ling Ting pouted and threw her phone onto the pillow in anger.

Why was this game so hard to play?

Ji Zhengyao looked at the rabbit that had also died on his screen, the corners of his mouth curling into a handsome arc.

Ling Ting’s rabbit had died of hunger, but his was the exact opposite.

His rabbit had died from overeating.

He wondered if Ling Ting would be angry if she knew his rabbit had died from eating too much.

He had originally intended to send Ling Ting a message today to ask if she had time later.

But thinking about how she hadn’t replied to his previous two messages, Bureau Chief Ji hesitated.

Afraid that a sudden invitation would scare the little girl, Ji Zhengyao hesitated for a moment and sent the game instead.

But he hadn’t expected the girl to be so clumsy; she had played several times, and the rabbit had died of hunger every time.

Ji Zhengyao wanted to send his own game tips to help Ling Ting, but after a moment of thought, he gave up.

The little girl looked soft and incapable on the surface, but she was stubborn to the core.

If he really pushed her too far, it would be counterproductive.

For some things, circuitous tactics were better.

Having figured it out, Bureau Chief Ji put a cigarette in his mouth and dialed Director Huang’s number directly.

He was going to treat all his colleagues to dinner tonight, and he would see Ling Ting soon.

Ling Ting: “...”

Who said I wanted to see you?

chapters.title: Director Ji Hosts a Dinner
chapters.content:
Division Chief Huang was a man of action. After receiving the call from Ji Zhengyao, he immediately sent a message to the group chat.

【Director Ji is hosting a dinner at Rose Garden tonight at seven. I hope all colleagues can attend on time.】

Ling Ting, who was having a great time gaming, saw the message in the group. She blinked, and her mood instantly soured.

Go to dinner with Ji Zhengyao?

She didn't want to go.

Thinking back to the awkward scene during their last meal together, Ling Ting quickly exited the game interface and called Division Chief Huang.

Ling Ting had originally intended to ask Division Chief Huang for a leave of absence, claiming she was sick.

But before she could finish her opening greeting, she was cut off by the Division Chief.

"Little Ling, whatever you have going on today, push it aside."

Division Chief Huang spoke earnestly, "It’s a great honor that Director Ji is inviting us to dinner."

"Chief, I..."

"No matter the reason, you must go today!"

Division Chief Huang didn't give Ling Ting any chance to make excuses. Just like last time, he hung up the phone decisively.

Ling Ting stared at her phone, feeling like crying but having no tears.

Is a dinner mandatory now?

Since she couldn't get the leave, Ling Ting didn't dare not go. She lay on her bed for a while longer, got up to tidy herself up a bit, and resigned herself to heading toward Rose Garden.

Because it was quite far, Ling Ting was delayed on the road, and it was nearly 7:30 by the time she arrived at Rose Garden.

She was clearly late.

"Ling Ting, why are you only just arriving?"

Little Liu, dressed in casual clothes, was standing at the entrance of Rose Garden. Seeing Ling Ting arrive, he immediately walked over to greet her.

"The subway station is a bit far; I walked over."

Ling Ting shyly smoothed her long, loose hair. She hadn't looked up the directions beforehand.

"It was my oversight; I should have gone to pick you up."

Little Liu felt guilty; he should have just called Ling Ting in advance.

"No need, it wasn't that far."

Ling Ting gave Little Liu a shy smile; she couldn't possibly let him pick her up.

Little Liu didn't live in her direction, and if he had gone out of his way to pick her up, it would have cost him quite a bit in gas money.

"Let's go."

Having been colleagues for so long, Little Liu understood Ling Ting and knew she was frugal, so he didn't dwell on the issue and led her into Rose Garden.

Rose Garden was huge, a great place that integrated dining, drinking, and entertainment.

The facilities inside were very advanced, many of which Ling Ting had never seen before.

Following behind Little Liu, Ling Ting was dazzled, finding everything she saw fresh and new.

Ling Ting lived a very routine life, and Little Liu knew she probably hadn't been to a place like this, so he deliberately slowed his pace to let her take it all in.

"Hey, why are you two dragging your feet? The banquet is about to start, hurry up."

Sister Wang walked out of the private room. Seeing Little Liu and Ling Ting moving slowly and looking unhurried, she urged them on.

"Coming."

Little Liu also knew they had been delayed too long. He smiled apologetically and signaled for Ling Ting to go in.

Ling Ting, who had been full of curiosity just a moment ago, finding everything wonderful, suddenly felt nervous at the thought of seeing Ji Zhengyao immediately.

Her hands involuntarily gripped the straps of her backpack.

She hoped that later, Ji Zhengyao wouldn't pay any attention to her.

As it turned out, Ling Ting was overthinking it.

"Little Ling, you’re such a slow child. What time do you think it is?"

Division Chief Huang was constantly observing the leader's expression. Seeing that Ji Zhengyao had looked toward the door seven times in just half an hour, he already understood the situation.

Seeing Ling Ting finally arrive, he immediately called out to her.

"I'm sorry, Division Chief Huang, I left late."

Ling Ting’s voice was naturally soft, and now, due to embarrassment, a faint blush spread across her pretty little face. Her voice sounded as delicate as a feather brushing against one's heart.

Ji Zhengyao sat at the head of the table. Seeing the person he had been waiting for finally arrive, the fake smile on his face became much more sincere.

"It’s fine that you’re here. Division Chief Huang, don't scold her."

Ji Zhengyao was handsome, and as he smiled from the heart, his words were full of approachability.

Hearing Ji Zhengyao come to her defense, Ling Ting shifted her gaze, which she had been trying to avoid, and it collided with his.

It was a fleeting touch.

"Director, Chief, I’m going to go take my seat."

Ji Zhengyao’s gaze was intense; Ling Ting felt as if she had been scalded and quickly found an excuse to leave.

She was here to eat today, and she couldn't become the center of attention like last time.

That feeling was truly too uncomfortable; she really wasn't used to it.

Seeing Ling Ting walk away, the smile on Ji Zhengyao’s face faltered, but he immediately picked up his wine glass and began chatting with the person next to him as if nothing had happened.

Division Chief Huang was sharp-eyed; he had caught every micro-expression on Ji Zhengyao’s face.

The leader was unhappy, and the young comrade had sat down so obliviously. Division Chief Huang sighed inwardly.

Ji Zhengyao clearly had some interest in Ling Ting. Although he didn't know if it was genuine affection or just a whim, in Division Chief Huang's eyes, it was an opportunity.

If you want to climb the ladder, without external help, you’ll just be a low-level clerk for the rest of your life.

The reason Division Chief Huang had climbed to his current position wasn't because of the rumors in the office about him having relatives in high places.

Actually, that was just a smokescreen he had put out; there were no such relatives.

His success was entirely due to his ability to seize opportunities and read people’s expressions.

Since the leader had a need, he didn't mind playing the mediator to create some opportunities for Ji Zhengyao and Ling Ting.

After all, this was beneficial to all three parties.

"Director Ji, thank you for your generosity today. Would you like to say a few words to everyone?"

Division Chief Huang’s old face was full of flattery as he bowed and scraped while refilling Ji Zhengyao’s glass.

Ji Zhengyao had reached his current position by knowing the ins and outs of the dinner table.

In such an occasion, he really should say a few words. He smiled calmly and picked up his wine glass.

Ling Ting’s table was a bit far from Ji Zhengyao’s. Sitting beside Sister Wang and Little Liu, her tense heart finally relaxed.

Looking at the fine wine and food on the table, and the elaborate plating, Ling Ting’s eyes lit up.

She was usually frugal, making do with noodles or fried rice, so she could finally enjoy a real meal.

"Eat up."

Little Liu was amused by Ling Ting’s look of wanting to eat but feeling too shy, so he deliberately turned the lazy Susan for her.

"Thank you."

There was no need for reserve at this point. Ling Ting gave Little Liu a shy smile, picked up a piece of fish with her chopsticks, and popped it into her mouth.

"Mmm."

Ling Ting nodded with satisfaction; high-end restaurants were indeed different.

Ling Ting’s taste buds were quickly conquered; she narrowed her eyes and picked up another piece.

"This one is also quite delicious."

Seeing Ling Ting eating happily, Little Liu pointed to another dish and told her.

"Okay, I'll try it."

Ling Ting and Little Liu got along well, and she was quite relaxed in front of him.

She ate the colorful and fragrant dishes on the table one bite after another, her face full of contentment.

During this time, she didn't hear a single word of what Ji Zhengyao said at the main table. It wasn't until everyone started applauding that she slowly raised her head.

Ji Zhengyao had spent years in the officialdom, and he knew how to say all the right things. In just the time it took to have a meal, he had won over many hearts.

But as he looked at the little girl who only knew how to bury her head and eat, never once looking up at him from start to finish, he felt an inexplicable sense of frustration.

chapters.title: Explosive Relations
chapters.content:
Perhaps his gaze was too intense; Ling Ting seemed to sense it and finally looked up.

But after just one glance, the young girl hurriedly looked away, not lingering for even a second.

Director Huang was sharp-eyed. Following Ji Zhengyao’s gaze, a plan instantly formed in his mind.

He gave his confidant a look, and before long, several people from various departments came over to toast Director Ji.

Ji Zhengyao held two positions and was usually quite busy at work, so there were very few opportunities to see him at the office.

Such a good opportunity was not to be missed, and many people planned to go over to get familiar with him.

Sister Wang straightened her hair, lifted her chin triumphantly at Ling Ting and Xiao Liu, and stood up as well.

There were four people in their office, and whether it was seniority or age, she was the undisputed choice to go over and offer a toast.

Xiao Liu and Ling Ting, of course, had no objections.

The two of them were just there to eat today; other matters were not their concern.

But just as Sister Wang picked up her glass and prepared to go over, Director Huang arrived.

He came to Ling Ting, lowered his voice, and said, "Xiao Ling, you arrived late today. Go over and say a few words to Director Ji."

"What?"

Ling Ting looked at Director Huang in shock, not understanding why she needed to go talk to Director Ji just because she arrived late.

Couldn't they just let her eat her meal in peace?

"Director Huang..."

Sister Wang was already prepared, and upon hearing Director Huang’s words, her eyes filled with shock.

This was clearly a case of him not wanting her to go and replacing her with Ling Ting instead.

"You wait a moment."

Sister Wang could barely maintain her facial expression, and Director Huang, who wasn't blind, certainly saw it.

However, he didn't intend to pay her any mind, telling her to sit down first instead.

Sister Wang was unconvinced and stood stubbornly in place. After being glared at fiercely by Director Huang, she walked away resentfully.

Ling Ting was frightened by the venomous look Sister Wang gave her before leaving, and she shook her head violently, not wanting to move at all.

But Director Huang didn't give her a chance to escape, pulling and dragging her toward the main table.

Ling Ting was no match for Director Huang’s strength, and with so many people around, she couldn't afford to cause a scene with a superior.

When she reached Ji Zhengyao’s side with Director Huang, the people in front of him had already dispersed. Ling Ting stood there helplessly, not knowing what to say for a moment.

Ji Zhengyao was very satisfied with Director Huang’s quick thinking. He nodded at him and then looked at Ling Ting.

Ling Ting appeared very reserved, the knuckles of the hand holding her wine glass turning slightly white.

Ever since reuniting with Ling Ting, Ji Zhengyao had noticed that the young girl’s complexion was poor, often pale, and her eyes carried a hint of melancholy.

Ji Zhengyao didn't know what had happened to her over the past ten years, but he selfishly wanted to catch a glimpse of it.

Ling Ting was flustered by Ji Zhengyao’s stare. It wasn't until she felt Director Huang nudge her arm that she reacted, saying nervously, "Director Ji, I arrived late today. I’m sorry."

Since the director had told her to come over, Ling Ting instinctively assumed she was there to apologize.

"It’s fine. Sit down."

Ji Zhengyao couldn't bear to see Ling Ting’s eyes turning red, as if she had suffered some great grievance, and he pointed to the chair beside him.

"No, no, no."

Hearing Ji Zhengyao ask her to sit, Ling Ting subconsciously wanted to refuse.

But Director Huang, who was standing nearby, wouldn't allow it. Before she could finish her sentence, he pressed her down into the chair.

He even made an excuse about having had too much to drink and needing to go wash his face, asking the young comrade to help keep the director company.

Ling Ting: "..."

"Eat."

Seeing that Ling Ting was dazed and hadn't touched her chopsticks for a long time, Ji Zhengyao pushed some dishes he thought were good toward her.

Seeing her eating with such relish earlier, he had become a bit hungry himself.

"Director Ji, I’d like to go to the restroom."

Ling Ting felt all eyes gathering on her face. She couldn't taste the delicious food on the table, and like a primary school student, she suddenly raised her hand to report to Ji Zhengyao.

Ji Zhengyao paused slightly, then nodded and said with a smile, "Go ahead."

Ling Ting felt relieved, stood up, and ran out of the private room.

Her speed was so fast that Ji Zhengyao felt the young girl had practically left an afterimage.

Regardless of how Ji Zhengyao felt, Ling Ting ran outside the room in one breath, her tightly wound nerves finally relaxing as she let out a long sigh.

Ji Zhengyao’s sense of oppression was just too strong; she really couldn't adapt to it.

"Huang Yu, what do you mean by this?"

Ling Ting walked slowly toward the restroom, thinking she would delay as long as possible since she was mostly full anyway.

But just as she reached the entrance of the restroom, she heard a familiar voice from not far away.

Ling Ting blinked, and as if possessed, she crept closer.

"What could I possibly mean? Don't be unreasonable."

Ling Ting bent over and poked her head out, discovering that the two people arguing were none other than Director Huang and Sister Wang.

"You’ve been icing me out for this entire period. Do you think I don't know what you’re thinking?"

Sister Wang crossed her arms, saying with the air of someone who saw the whole picture: "Just because I answered your wife’s phone call, you gave the welcome speech draft to Ling Ting last time, and this time you let her take my place to toast the leaders?"

"Wang Meili, can you stop spouting nonsense?"

Director Huang looked around in a panic and hissed in a low voice, "You were the one who didn't want to write the draft. Is it a crime for me to give it to someone else?"

"I didn't want to write the draft, but I wanted to toast the leaders! Why did you let Ling Ting go? Did I not serve you well enough?"

My god!

Ling Ting silently took two steps back, hunched over, and ran away quickly.

What on earth had she just heard?

Sister Wang and Director Huang?

Both of them were married!

Ling Ting felt her mind was in chaos, and her feet moved faster and faster.

But as she walked, Ling Ting realized something was wrong.

All the doors looked the same, and she couldn't remember which room number it was.

She seemed to be lost.

Just as Ling Ting was hesitating about whether to find a waiter to ask where the room booked by Director Ji was, the phone in her pocket rang.

"Hello, is this Miss Ling?"

It was a young man’s voice on the other end. Ling Ting checked the caller ID and was surprised to confirm it was a call from Qiao Yin.

"I am Ling Ting. Who are you?"

"Miss Qiao is currently at the Second People’s Hospital. She..."

"What happened to her?"

Ling Ting didn't wait for the other person to finish, her face changing drastically as she became instantly anxious.

"She was hit by a car. There’s no one with her. Can you come over?"

The young man on the other end said again.

"Yes, I’m coming right now."

Ling Ting hung up the phone, grabbed a waiter to ask where the exit was, and rushed out like a madwoman.

But when she reached the entrance, she realized she couldn't hail a taxi there at all.

Ling Ting felt panicked; her hands wouldn't stop trembling, and tears welled up in her eyes.

Her parents had died in a car accident, and the tragic scene was still etched in her mind to this day.

Worried about Qiao Yin, Ling Ting couldn't care about anything else. She looked toward the direction of the main road and started running at full speed.

She ran and tried to flag down cars the whole way, but not a single one stopped.

Ling Ting was drenched in sweat, the wisps of hair on her forehead dampened by the moisture.

"Ling Ting."

Just as Ling Ting was filled with despair, clutching her knees and gasping for breath, a black sedan slowly pulled up in front of her.

"Director Ji?"

Ling Ting looked at Ji Zhengyao, momentarily stunned.

Wasn't he eating?

"Where are you going?"

Seeing Ling Ting’s eyes red and looking as if she might cry at any second, Ji Zhengyao frowned imperceptibly. "Get in the car and tell me."

Ling Ting was burning with anxiety and had no time to think too much. She pulled open the car door and sat in.

"My friend was in a car accident. Can you take me to the Second People’s Hospital?"

Ling Ting tried to appear calm, but the tremor in her voice gave her away.

Ji Zhengyao nodded, stepped on the gas, and the car sped off.

chapters.title: Qiaoyin’s Accident
chapters.content:
Worried about Qiaoyin, Ling Ting dialed her number over and over again, but the call never went through.

"What should I do?"

Ling Ting looked at Ji Zhengyao helplessly, her voice unconsciously laced with a sob.

Watching Ling Ting, whose face was as pale as paper and whose eyes were filled with worry, Ji Zhengyao’s expression shifted slightly, and a sharp pain pricked somewhere in his heart.

He had seen Ling Ting this anxious and distressed before.

Back then, she was still so young, her throat hoarse from crying, her body trembling like a sieve, yet she had stubbornly dragged him out from under the car.

"It’s okay. I have a friend at that hospital; I’ll have him go check."

With that, Ji Zhengyao took out his phone and called his friend.

"My friend is already on his way. It’ll be fine."

Ji Zhengyao put his phone away and turned his head to comfort Ling Ting.

"Faster, can you go faster?"

Her parents' car accident had left Ling Ting with an indelible psychological shadow. Until she saw with her own eyes that Qiaoyin was completely unharmed, she wouldn't be at ease.

For ten years, Ji Zhengyao had driven steadily, always keeping his speed under sixty miles per hour within the city.

But at this moment, Ling Ting’s anxiety caused him to lose his usual composure. He kept pressing the accelerator, driving the car at high speed.

Just like that, Ji Zhengyao ran a red light, and forty minutes later, they finally arrived at the Second People's Hospital.

Perhaps due to her extreme panic, Ling Ting didn't watch her step after getting out of the car and stumbled, nearly falling.

Ji Zhengyao was quick-witted and caught her just in time.

"Ling Ting, don't worry. I’m here."

Ji Zhengyao looked directly into her eyes, giving her strength.

Ling Ting, who had been completely lost just a moment ago, stared straight at him upon hearing his words.

She was indeed too nervous. Qiaoyin wouldn't end up like her parents; she would definitely be fine.

"Excuse me, are you Miss Ling?"

A young man in a suit and tie walked over.

"Yes, I am."

Ling Ting nodded and let go of Ji Zhengyao’s hand.

"Ji..."

Chang Ning hadn't expected to run into Director Ji here.

Ji Zhengyao was also a bit surprised to see Xiao Chang.

However, he only gave a slight nod and didn't say much.

Chang Ning was observant; seeing that Ji Zhengyao had come with Ling Ting, he smiled at him and led them into the hospital.

"What exactly happened?"

Ling Ting followed behind Chang Ning, asking as they walked.

"Miss Qiao didn't follow traffic rules while riding her electric scooter and collided with our CEO’s car. She was injured."

"Where is she hurt? Is it serious?"

Ling Ting asked anxiously.

Chang Ning looked back at Ling Ting. "The injury is on her hand. It’s not serious, but she lost quite a bit of blood."

Er...

The wound wasn't actually large, but for some reason, it took a long time for the bleeding to stop.

After hearing Chang Ning’s words, Ling Ting grew even more worried. Once they entered the ward, she rushed straight to Qiaoyin.

"Ling Ting?"

"Qiaoyin, are you okay?"

Seeing Qiaoyin, Ling Ting couldn't hold back her tears. She checked her arms and legs up and down, terrified that she might have broken something.

"I'm fine, I'm fine. I'm completely fine."

Seeing that Ling Ting was scared to the point of tears, Qiaoyin quickly pulled her in to comfort her.

"Qiaoyin, you scared me to death."

After checking her over completely and confirming that, other than her left hand being wrapped in gauze, Qiaoyin was fine, the weight on Ling Ting’s heart finally lifted.

"I'm sorry, I'm sorry. It’s all my fault."

Qiaoyin helped wipe Ling Ting’s tears, apologizing with a face full of self-reproach.

"What exactly happened?"

Ling Ting sniffled, her emotions finally calming down.

"It’s my fault."

Qiaoyin glanced at Chang Ning, who was standing to the side, then winked at Ling Ting and whispered guiltily.

Ling Ting and Qiaoyin had known each other for so many years; they had a certain level of unspoken understanding.

Seeing her keep winking at her, she instantly understood something.

"Um, I'm fine now. Secretary Chang, you can go back."

Qiaoyin waved her hand at Chang Ning and said politely.

Because of her recklessness, she had caused him to be troubled for half the night, and she felt a bit embarrassed.

"Miss Qiao, our President Li is very sorry for hitting you. This is some compensation."

As he spoke, Chang Ning took a bulging envelope from his pocket and handed it over.

Qiaoyin and Ling Ting weren't stupid; they naturally guessed what was in the envelope.

"Secretary Chang, that’s not necessary."

The traffic accident was her fault, and Qiaoyin wasn't seriously hurt, so she didn't want the man's money.

A gentleman loves wealth, but acquires it in the right way.

She wasn't going to extort anyone.

"Miss Qiao, you don't need to feel embarrassed. Just take it."

Chang Ning placed the envelope on the nightstand, smiled at the two of them, and turned to leave.

"Wow, so much money?"

After Chang Ning left, Qiaoyin picked up the envelope on the table. Seeing the money inside, her eyes widened instantly.

"Ling Ting, this deal was worth it... Ouch!"

Before Qiaoyin could finish her sentence, Ling Ting gave her a tap on the head.

"Are you stupid?"

Ling Ting said crossly, "You’re lucky you’re fine. If you had broken a leg, let’s see if you’d still think it was worth it."

"Hehe."

Qiaoyin knew she had spoken thoughtlessly. Seeing that Ling Ting was angry, she immediately gave a flattering smile.

"I was just saying. I’ll definitely be careful in the future."

She had been scared to death at the time. If it hadn't been for that man taking her to the hospital...

Thinking of that incredibly handsome man, Qiaoyin’s eyes went blank.

"What’s wrong with you?"

Ling Ting helped Qiaoyin stuff the money into her bag. Seeing her suddenly go quiet, she asked in confusion.

"Ling Ting, that man was so manly."

Qiaoyin’s face was full of infatuation, her hands unconsciously cupping her face.

"Which man?"

Thinking of Secretary Chang from earlier, Ling Ting thought he looked average and shouldn't have caught Qiaoyin’s eye.

"The one who brought me to the hospital, of course."

Qiaoyin grabbed Ling Ting’s hand. "Secretary Chang said his surname is Li, and he’s a CEO."

When he was holding her, he was full of strength, and his whole body was practically radiating hormones.

"That’s enough out of you."

Ling Ting couldn't stand Qiaoyin’s infatuated expression and shook her head. "Are you really okay?"

If she was fine, they should check out and go home.

"I'm fine, I'm fine."

Qiaoyin put away her smile and specifically walked a few steps for Ling Ting to show she was fine.

She was perfectly healthy.

"If you're fine, let's go."

The smell of disinfectant was everywhere in the hospital, and Ling Ting wasn't used to it.

Qiaoyin didn't want to stay there either. She packed up and walked out of the ward with Ling Ting.

But when she saw the well-mannered Ji Zhengyao at the door, her eyes widened instantly. She slowly turned her head, tugged on Ling Ting’s sleeve, and whispered excitedly, "This one is even more handsome!"

Seeing that Ji Zhengyao hadn't left yet, Ling Ting’s face turned bright red, and she instantly remembered her own embarrassing behavior from earlier.

Ji Zhengyao said something in a low voice to his doctor friend, and after the friend left, he walked up to Ling Ting.

"Let me drive you two home."

Ji Zhengyao gave a slight nod to Qiaoyin and looked at Ling Ting.

"No... no need, Qiaoyin’s house is just nearby."

Ling Ting was embarrassed to death, stammering as she lied.

chapters.title: Making Plans to Eat Together
chapters.content:
Qiaoyin knew Ling Ting best. Seeing her look of total resistance, she immediately stepped forward and said to Ji Zhengyao with a grin, "Ling Ting is right. My place is very close; it takes less than five minutes to walk."

Ji Zhengyao saw the subtle exchange of glances between the two clearly, but seeing that Ling Ting truly didn't want him to take her home, he didn't force it.

"Alright then. Send me a message if you need anything."

With that, Ji Zhengyao turned and left.

The little girl was acting like a stranger the moment things changed.

"Ling Ting, who is he?"

After Ji Zhengyao left, Qiaoyin couldn't hold back for even a minute. She grabbed Ling Ting and started digging for answers.

Ling Ting didn't hide anything from Qiaoyin. After a moment's thought, she explained about their blind date and how they ended up working in the same unit.

"Ling Ting, you've hit the jackpot!"

Qiaoyin was shocked and excited. "Isn't this a classic trope from a TV drama?"

"Tell me, is he pursuing you?"

Qiaoyin grabbed Ling Ting's arm, her eyes full of excitement.

"Oh, forget it. I was so embarrassed I could have died."

She hadn't noticed while she was too nervous, but now, recalling her behavior in the car, she wished she could crawl into the hospital walls.

Qiaoyin understood Ling Ting. If it were her, she would have treated it as a joke and wouldn't have taken it to heart at all. But Ling Ting was different—she was introverted, overthought everything, and was too timid.

"Alright, alright. If you're embarrassed, just avoid him later. Let's go home, let's go home."

Qiaoyin didn't want to see Ling Ting sighing, so she pulled her toward the hospital exit.

After the long ordeal, it was past eleven o'clock by the time they got home.

"Qiaoyin, was your place robbed?"

Upon returning to Qiaoyin's place and opening the door, Ling Ting was stunned.

Qiaoyin's home wasn't large; it was a two-bedroom apartment of about eighty square meters. But at that moment, it didn't look like anyone lived there at all. Clothes were scattered across the sofa, the coffee table, and even the floor.

"I just got back from being out, I haven't had time to tidy up yet."

Qiaoyin didn't feel embarrassed at all. After entering, she kicked a shoe aside and invited Ling Ting to sit down.

Ling Ting was naturally tidy, and seeing this scene where there was nowhere to step, she felt extremely uncomfortable. But she couldn't just stand there, so she had no choice but to tidy up as she walked.

"Qiaoyin, you were messy back in school, and now that you've graduated, why hasn't anything changed?"

Ling Ting moved the clothes off the sofa and gestured for Qiaoyin to sit. She was a patient, after all, and needed to rest.

"Oh, it's fine, no one ever comes over anyway."

Qiaoyin waved her hand with a grin, not seeing anything wrong with her messy home. She could find whatever she needed regardless.

"Why don't you just admit you're lazy?"

Ling Ting glared at her. This living environment was simply not suitable for human habitation.

"Alright, go lie down in the bedroom, I'll clean up."

Ling Ting couldn't stand it anymore. She rolled up her sleeves, intending to help clean.

"It's too late, do it tomorrow."

Qiaoyin yawned and pulled Ling Ting toward the bedroom.

"Fine."

Ling Ting's emotions had been like a roller coaster today—crying, laughing, and feeling scared—and she was quite sleepy now.

However, living in what felt like a refugee camp made Ling Ting uneasy, so she woke up early the next morning. She cleaned Qiaoyin's home from top to bottom. When Qiaoyin woke up, she was shocked.

"Wow!"

Looking at the floor that was so clean it reflected her image, Qiaoyin's eyes nearly popped out.

"Ling Ting, how did you do it?"

She had tried to clean before, but the more she cleaned, the messier it got; it was pointless. How long had it been? Ling Ting had turned her impossible-to-walk-in home into a spotless space! She was a genius!

"Alright, let's go out to eat."

After working all morning, Ling Ting was starving.

"Eat, eat, eat! Ling Ting, how about hot pot?"

Since she had scared Ling Ting half to death with her accident and Ling Ting had spent the whole morning cleaning, Qiaoyin decided to treat her to a big meal. She had money now, so she could spend it freely. She couldn't go to the amusement park with her injured hand, but she could still eat and drink.

"Absolutely not. Let's find a Chinese restaurant and get you some chicken soup to recover."

After checking Qiaoyin's hand, Ling Ting flatly rejected her suggestion.

"Ling Ting, I'm fine."

Qiaoyin still wanted hot pot.

"What do you mean you're fine? You lost so much blood, just endure it for two days."

Ling Ting looked at her. "Are you going or not?"

"Going, going, let's go."

Qiaoyin was afraid that if they kept arguing, she wouldn't even get the soup, so she waved her hand and led Ling Ting toward a nearby restaurant.

After they arrived and ordered, Ling Ting handed over her phone, pointing to the design sketches she had saved for Qiaoyin to see.

"Ling Ting, why are you bothering with that civil service job? Quit and work with me; I guarantee you'll make a fortune."

Looking at the designs, Qiaoyin was truly delighted. They were beautiful! Ling Ting was a talented person; it was a real shame she wasn't a designer.

"If you think they're good, just find someone to make them."

Although Ling Ting loved fashion design, she had no intention of quitting her civil service job.

"Ling Ting, I'm serious. Will you consider it?"

Qiaoyin really couldn't bear to see Ling Ting's talent buried.

"Alright, I'm going to the restroom."

Not wanting to hear Qiaoyin's nagging, Ling Ting stood up and headed toward the restroom. Pursuing the civil service job was following in her parents' footsteps, and she was determined to stick with it. As for fashion design... it would just have to remain a hobby.

"Ling Ting?"

Ling Ting looked back to see Ji Zhengyao standing behind her with a smile on his lips.

"Director Ji?"

Ling Ting blinked her clear, bright eyes, feeling a bit confused. What was going on lately? Why did she run into Ji Zhengyao everywhere she went? Did she need to check a fortune-telling calendar before leaving the house from now on?

"Who are you here with?"

Ji Zhengyao didn't know what she was thinking. He asked with a smile, his hands in his pockets.

"With a friend."

Ling Ting avoided his gaze and tilted her head toward Qiaoyin's direction.

"Would you like to join us?"

Ji Zhengyao was not the type to invite others often.

"No thanks, we'll just eat by ourselves. You go ahead and be busy, Director Ji."

Ling Ting had developed a phobia of eating with Ji Zhengyao. She smiled and tried to leave.

"Ling Ting, I helped you yesterday. Don't you have anything to say?"

Seeing her try to leave, Ji Zhengyao stepped aside to block her path. He wasn't the type to be used and then dismissed.

"Uh..."

Ling Ting looked at him blankly. After a long moment, she said, "Director Ji, then... then let me treat you to a meal?"

After struggling for a long time, she finally managed to say something that satisfied him.

"Alright, let's make it this weekend."

Ji Zhengyao agreed readily.

"Director Ji, I'm leaving now."

Ling Ting pulled the corners of her mouth in an awkward smile. She really hadn't expected him to actually agree. Why was her brain so slow? Wouldn't a gift have sufficed as a thank you?

"Ling Ting, I'll come pick you up next weekend."

Seeing the conflicted look on the little girl's face, Ji Zhengyao curled his lips into a smile, his voice sounding pleased.

Ling Ting: "..."

If she backed out now, would it be too late?

chapters.title: Where to Eat
chapters.content:
Because he was going to have a meal with Ling Ting on the weekend, Ji Zhengyao was in an inexplicably good mood. When he returned home that evening, he did something unprecedented and didn't go into his study.

"Zhengyao, have you been exhausted lately?"

Wen Yazhi came out of the kitchen, carrying a bowl of soup in her hands.

"Sister-in-law, I'm not tired."

Ji Zhengyao took the soup from Wen Yazhi, took a sip, set it down, and said with a smile.

"Work is never-ending. You should rest appropriately; don't work yourself into an illness while you're still young."

When Wen Yazhi married into the family, this brother-in-law was only two years old, so she had practically raised him herself.

Although they were brother-in-law and sister-in-law, their bond was like that of mother and son. In her heart, she held Ji Zhengyao in the same regard as she did Ji Yunxiao.

Ji Zhengyao knew his sister-in-law was concerned about him and nodded. "I know."

Despite his gentle exterior and the constant smile on his face, Ji Zhengyao didn't listen to anyone in the family except for the old patriarch. As his sister-in-law, Wen Yazhi was happy to receive his assurance, regardless of whether he was just humoring her.

Looking at her brother-in-law, who was outstanding in both appearance and ability, Wen Yazhi hesitated for a moment before cautiously testing the waters. "Zhengyao, don't blame me for being meddlesome, but you're thirty-one already. Isn't it time to settle your personal affairs?"

This wasn't actually something Wen Yazhi wanted to ask; after all, no matter how close they were, as a sister-in-law, she shouldn't overstep her bounds. It was Zhengyao’s mother who had asked her to inquire. Her mother’s intention was for her to sound him out and see if he had any plans for an arranged marriage.

Ji Zhengyao was shrewd; the moment his sister-in-law opened her mouth, he knew whose idea it was. However, he had always been a maverick and had no interest in arranged marriages.

"Sister-in-law, the person I marry in the future will only be someone I love."

After saying this, he smiled and picked up the soup, drinking it slowly.

Wen Yazhi nodded and didn't press the matter further. It seemed Zhengyao’s mother’s plans were destined to fall through.

After finishing the soup his sister-in-law had brewed and chatting with her for a while, Ji Zhengyao saw that the time was right and got up to return to the study upstairs.

Once back in the study, he lit a cigarette, took two puffs, and pulled out a file that had been buried at the very bottom of his drawer.

Opening the file that hadn't been touched in a long time, Ji Zhengyao’s eyes turned cold. He took out his phone and dialed a number.

"Are you free lately? I need your help with something."

The car accident back then was too suspicious; it was time for him to investigate. Originally, he hadn't wanted to pursue the matter, as the internal affairs of the Ji family were too chaotic, and he feared that pulling one thread would affect the whole, potentially implicating the old patriarch.

But ever since he met Ling Ting, Ji Zhengyao’s thoughts had changed. The young girl’s parents had died in that accident; he owed it to her to seek justice.

Ling Ting didn't know that Ji Zhengyao had already begun investigating the car accident for her sake. The oppressive atmosphere in the office was enough to drive her crazy.

"Ling Ting, what's wrong with Sister Wang?"

Seeing Sister Wang head to the office next door with a long face, Xiao Liu leaned over to Ling Ting and asked in a low voice. He had noticed that Sister Wang had been speaking in a sarcastic, passive-aggressive tone for the past two days and hadn't been treating Ling Ting well either.

"I don't know."

Ling Ting was organizing the documents at hand, feeling nauseated. Sister Wang was just angry at Section Chief Huang and was taking it out on her. But what could she do? She couldn't exactly go around broadcasting their business, could she? She wouldn't dare.

"Do you want me to go talk to her?"

Xiao Liu couldn't stand seeing Ling Ting being bullied and wanted to go have a chat with Sister Wang. They were all colleagues in the same office; no one owed anyone anything.

"No, no."

Ling Ting held Xiao Liu back and shook her head. "Forget it, it'll be better in a couple of days."

Once Sister Wang and Section Chief Huang made up, her miserable days would come to an end.

A week passed in the blink of an eye. After getting off work on Friday, Ling Ting was just preparing to go home when she received a message from Ji Zhengyao.

[Are you free today? Let's have dinner.]

Looking at the words on her phone, Ling Ting pursed her lips and puffed out one cheek. She deeply regretted the impulse that day to offer to treat Ji Zhengyao to a meal. But no matter how much she regretted it, she couldn't go back on her word. After thinking about it, Ling Ting replied to Ji Zhengyao for the first time.

[I'm free.]

"Heh."

Ji Zhengyao finally received Ling Ting’s reply and couldn't help but laugh out loud.

[Wait at home, I'll come pick you up later.]

Ji Zhengyao sent another message to Ling Ting, then grabbed his car keys and headed home. He needed to go back and change his clothes—he wanted to pick something that looked youthful and energetic.

...

"Uncle, you're home! Come on, keep me company for a ride."

Seeing his uncle’s car at home, Ji Yunxiao ran in, full of excitement, and shouted loudly.

"Not going."

Ji Zhengyao changed into the clothes he had selected and gave his nephew a sharp look. From now on, the first thing he would do when he got home was lock the door, to save him from barging in without knocking.

"Uncle, how long has it been since you watched a race? There are some real pros today, come on, let's go."

As he spoke, Ji Yunxiao moved to pull Ji Zhengyao along. Ji Zhengyao had a date; how could he possibly go watch a race? He pushed Ji Yunxiao away and threatened him coldly, "Go yourself. If you're still here in a minute, I'm telling your mother."

"Eh?"

Ji Yunxiao was a bit stunned, but he was quick-witted; he grinned, turned around, and ran off. His uncle always meant what he said, and Ji Yunxiao didn't want to be grounded by his mother.

With his nephew gone, Ji Zhengyao’s ears were finally at peace. He raised an eyebrow and walked to the mirror. Because of his work, he always wore professional attire; it was rare for him to be dressed casually today. He had to admit, he looked quite handsome.

After admiring himself in the mirror for a while, Ji Zhengyao saw that the time was right and drove toward Ling Ting’s home.

For some reason, the residential complex where Ling Ting lived didn't even have a security guard, and outside vehicles could enter at will. Ji Zhengyao’s car drove in with ease. Once inside, he parked the car and called Ling Ting directly via voice message.

The call rang for a long time before Ling Ting answered, her tone slightly uncertain.

"Director Ji?"

"I'm here. Come down."

Ji Zhengyao said to Ling Ting.

"Oh, okay, okay, okay."

There was a flurry of activity on the other end of the line, as if she had bumped into something; Ji Zhengyao even heard Ling Ting let out a cry of pain.

"Are you okay?"

Ji Zhengyao furrowed his brows, but just as he asked, the call was disconnected.

Although Ling Ting was usually slow-paced, she was exceptionally fast today. Before Ji Zhengyao could worry for more than two minutes, she came rushing out of the building.

Although she had ridden in Ji Zhengyao’s car before, it had been dark then, so she only knew the color and the model. Ji Zhengyao watched as she scurried around the complex like a headless chicken, even leaning against other people's car windows to look inside, and he couldn't help but laugh.

"Over here."

Ji Zhengyao waved at Ling Ting.

Ling Ting followed the sound of his voice, saw his car not far from the entrance, and trotted over.

"Director Ji."

Ling Ting was very reserved, a bashful smile on her lips, and she even gave Ji Zhengyao a silly bow.

Ji Zhengyao: "..."

"Don't be nervous."

Ji Zhengyao curled his lips and asked in a low voice, "Where did you bump yourself just now?"

"Huh?"

Ling Ting didn't quite understand what Ji Zhengyao meant.

"When we were on the call just now, I think I heard you bump into something."

Ji Zhengyao opened the car door, signaling for Ling Ting to get in.

"It was nothing, I just knocked over a coat rack."

Thinking of her own clumsiness just now, Ling Ting couldn't help but blush.

chapters.title: The Considerate Director Ji
chapters.content:
Ling Ting was very beautiful—the kind of beauty that doesn't strike you at first glance, but grows on you the more you look.

The young girl had exceptionally good skin, so fair it seemed to glow. Only when he was close did Ji Zhengyao notice that even the fine hairs on her skin were milky white.

Ji Zhengyao had seen many beautiful girls, but few were as clean and unadorned as Ling Ting.

Ling Ting’s personality was somewhat like a timid rabbit.

Shrinking away, yet exceptionally cute.

"What would you like to eat?"

After closing the car door and getting in from the other side, Ji Zhengyao asked for Ling Ting's opinion.

"I haven't decided. You choose, Director Ji."

Ling Ting didn't go out to eat often, so she really didn't know where was good.

The restaurant she went to with Qiaoyin last week was nice, but Director Ji had already been there.

"You'll leave it to me?"

Ji Zhengyao raised an eyebrow and suddenly leaned in close to Ling Ting. A cold, woody fragrance mixed with the scent of tobacco drifted into her breath.

Ling Ting was startled by Ji Zhengyao, her almond-shaped eyes widening as she dared not move.

*Click.*

The seatbelt buckle beside her made a crisp sound.

*Whoosh.*

Ling Ting secretly let out a sigh of relief; she had overthought it.

The little thoughts in Ling Ting's mind were written all over her face, which successfully amused Ji Zhengyao.

This little girl—every movement of hers was so cute.

"Director Ji, shall we go?"

Ling Ting felt a bit uncomfortable under Ji Zhengyao's playful gaze. She reached up to tuck her hair behind her ear and said in a small voice.

Ji Zhengyao had originally wanted to tease her more, but seeing that the girl’s face was flushed red enough to be feverish, he abandoned the idea.

"Alright, let's head out."

With that, Ji Zhengyao started the car in high spirits.

Ling Ting had assumed Ji Zhengyao would just pick a random restaurant in the city, but as they drove on, she noticed something was off.

The car kept driving further and further, well away from the city center.

"Director Ji, where are we going?"

Ling Ting leaned against the car window and asked in a soft, melodic tone.

It wasn't intentional; it was just how she was, naturally.

"There’s a private restaurant in the southern part of the city. We’ll be there soon."

Ji Zhengyao rubbed his slightly itchy ear and turned the steering wheel. A moment later, he pulled into a quiet, elegant courtyard.

"We're here."

Ji Zhengyao opened the car door for Ling Ting and gestured for her to get out.

Ling Ting realized too late and once again looked down on herself for not being socially savvy.

If Director Huang were here, he would have definitely handled the door-opening task perfectly.

Director Huang: "..."

Are you being polite?

"Let's go."

The evening sun was quite strong. Fearing Ling Ting might get sunburned, Ji Zhengyao pointed to a long corridor ahead and walked in first.

Ling Ting followed behind Ji Zhengyao, looking around as she walked.

Many flowers were planted on both sides of the corridor, competing in beauty and looking absolutely stunning.

As the sun set, the golden rays spilled over them, making it look like a fairyland.

"Do you like it here?"

Seeing Ling Ting staring intently at the flowers, Ji Zhengyao leaned over slightly and asked.

Ling Ting caught that unique scent of his again and subconsciously dodged to the side.

Every time Ji Zhengyao got close, she became extremely nervous.

"Mm, I like it."

Ling Ting pursed her lips and said in a low voice.

She had loved flowers since she was a child; her rental apartment’s windowsill was already filled with them.

"Alright, then take a pot home when we leave."

Ji Zhengyao waved his hand grandly, "Take whichever one you want."

"No, no, I..."

Ling Ting waved her hands, rushing to refuse, but she suddenly fell silent mid-sentence.

A butterfly had boldly landed on the edge of her hair.

She tugged on Ji Zhengyao’s sleeve, pointed with one finger, and whispered in a breathy voice: "Director Ji, look."

Ling Ting’s eyes were bright and lively, blinking like a playful bird in the forest.

Ji Zhengyao was stunned, forgetting to answer for a moment.

"Are you scared?"

After a long while, Ji Zhengyao found his voice and asked gently.

"Not scared."

Ling Ting smiled at Ji Zhengyao, her eyes curving into crescent moons.

The butterfly flew away.

Ji Zhengyao: "..."

"It’s okay, it just flew away."

Ling Ting watched the butterfly leave, her tone light and cheerful.

"Then let's go inside."

Although Ji Zhengyao felt a bit of regret, seeing that Ling Ting didn't mind, he nodded and led her into a private room.

"The dishes have already been ordered; they'll be here in a moment."

Ji Zhengyao poured a cup of tea for Ling Ting and gestured for her to sit wherever she liked.

"You already ordered?"

She had been with him the whole time; when did he order?

Ling Ting found it a bit strange.

"It’s a set menu; I ordered it when I booked the table."

Ji Zhengyao placed the teacup by Ling Ting’s hand, signaling for her to try the tea.

Ling Ting didn't know much about tea, but she took a small sip, and the fragrance instantly spread through her mouth.

"It’s good."

That was the only evaluation she could give.

After all, she rarely drank tea.

Ji Zhengyao smiled; he liked this flavor too.

Seeing that Ling Ting was still very reserved, his eyes flickered, and he began to chat about everyday life.

"Ling Ting, where did you go to university?"

In truth, Ji Zhengyao already knew; he had read her file the day he took office.

"At Yun University," Ling Ting smiled. "I studied fashion design."

"Then what made you decide to take the civil service exam?"

Ji Zhengyao moved closer to Ling Ting, sitting shoulder-to-shoulder with her, and continued to ask.

"Um... I just wanted to."

Ling Ting lowered her head, her voice quiet.

Ji Zhengyao’s proximity made her feel extremely uncomfortable.

"Mr. Ji, your food is ready."

Ji Zhengyao enjoyed watching Ling Ting’s awkwardness and had intended to tease her more, but a middle-aged woman walked in.

She wore a kind smile and placed the tray in her hands onto the table.

There were three dishes on the tray: a braised pork belly, a plate of fish, a stir-fried vegetable dish, and two bowls of rice.

Ling Ting looked at Ji Zhengyao, wondering if they should order more. After all, she was the one treating, and it felt bad to have so little.

"It’s enough."

Ji Zhengyao understood what Ling Ting was thinking, shook his head, and handed her the chopsticks.

Ling Ting took the chopsticks, realizing too late.

Shouldn't she be the one doing that?

He was the Director, after all.

She once again thought of the socially savvy Director Huang.

...

"Eat."

Ji Zhengyao picked up a piece of fish and placed it in Ling Ting’s bowl.

His glasses were just for show—or as the old man put it, to hide his sharp edge.

In reality, his eyesight was excellent.

He had seen clearly how Ling Ting ate fish that day.

"Thank you."

Ling Ting did love fish, but having a superior pick food for her still made her feel a bit flattered.

"Today, we aren't distinguishing by rank; we’re just having a simple meal. Don't be so reserved."

Ji Zhengyao wanted to help Ling Ting relax, his attitude gentler than ever before.

After all, they had even been on a blind date...

"Director Ji, thank you so much for that day."

Ling Ting didn't know what was on Ji Zhengyao’s mind. She smiled sweetly, raised the teacup in front of her, and thanked him.

"Don't be so formal with me."

Ji Zhengyao also raised his cup, his eyes filled with doting affection. "If you need anything in the future, just come to me."

Come to you?

Ling Ting shook her head violently in her heart.

She wouldn't dare.

However, Ji Zhengyao was indeed quite nice, both in appearance and temperament.

Just the fact that he was always smiling and never put on airs as an official was quite good.

Since he was a nice person, Ling Ting couldn't be too rude. Looking at the braised pork belly in front of her, she thought for a moment, picked up a piece, and placed it in Ji Zhengyao’s bowl.

"Director Ji, you eat too."

chapters.title: Qin Nan Goes Mad
chapters.content:
Ji Zhengyao was startled by Ling Ting’s actions. He stared straight at her, a sweet, warm current flowing through his heart.

"Eat quickly, it’ll get cold soon."

Ji Zhengyao spoke in a slightly hoarse voice, gesturing for Ling Ting to eat the fish.

Ling Ting obeyed. She smiled, her eyes curving into crescents, and put the fish from her bowl into her mouth.

"Mmm."

Ling Ting nodded. "It’s delicious."

"Is it good?"

Ji Zhengyao knew Ling Ting would like this place.

"The dishes here don't look like much, but they taste great."

Ji Zhengyao added some vegetables to Ling Ting’s bowl, explaining gently, as if afraid of startling her.

"I’ve lived this long, and I’ve never eaten such delicious food."

She had thought the dishes at Rose Garden were already top-tier.

Ji Zhengyao paused for a moment, then smiled and said, "If you want to eat it again, I’ll bring you back."

Ling Ting took it as a polite remark from Ji Zhengyao. She smiled shyly and said nothing.

Ji Zhengyao had eaten his fair share of delicacies, but he felt exceptionally satisfied with this meal today.

Ling Ting had a gentle personality and spoke obediently. The two of them exchanged questions and answers, getting along remarkably well.

He watched Ling Ting eat the vegetables he had served her, one small bite at a time. He felt satisfied and cherished, a smile appearing in his eyes before he even realized it.

All these years, he had been climbing his way up, never letting a single opportunity slip by.

Yet, on one sleepless night after another, he had lost his direction.

He didn't know what his goal was, nor did he know the meaning of what he was doing.

Now...

Now, Ji Zhengyao had found his direction. He worked hard and strived for progress simply because he wanted the person by his side to eat happily and enjoy herself.

"Director Ji, I’m finished. Where do I go to pay?"

Ling Ting finished the last mouthful of rice in her bowl and looked around, but couldn't find the lady who had served them earlier.

"I have a membership card here; I’ve already paid."

Ji Zhengyao stuffed a tissue into Ling Ting’s hand.

"What?"

Ling Ting pouted, looking a bit unhappy.

They had clearly agreed that she would treat him.

"How about next time? You can treat me next time."

Ji Zhengyao pulled Ling Ting up and walked toward the exit, saying, "Come on, let’s go see which flowers you like, and we’ll take a pot home."

He had noticed when they arrived that the little girl had been staring at those flowers, her eyes fixed on them.

"No, Director Ji, that wouldn't be right."

Ling Ting did like those flowers, but she couldn't just take one away just because she liked it.

Besides, taking it without asking—wouldn't that be stealing?

"It’s fine. I already spoke to the owner, and he said he’d give us one."

How could Ji Zhengyao not see what was in Ling Ting’s heart? He raised an eyebrow at her and walked toward the long corridor.

With a long stride, he stepped over the railing of the corridor and pointed at the flowers inside, asking Ling Ting, "Which pot do you want?"

"Director Ji, are you really giving this flower to me?"

Ling Ting looked longingly at the flowers by Ji Zhengyao’s feet, still asking with some uncertainty.

"Really giving it to you. Pick one."

Never mind one pot of flowers—even if she wanted to take them all back, he, Ji Zhengyao, could make it happen.

"Then I want the one next to you."

Having received Ji Zhengyao’s confirmation, Ling Ting was overjoyed. She happily pointed at the violets she had been eyeing for a while.

"Alrighty."

Ji Zhengyao picked up the pot of flowers and stepped back over.

"Here, for you."

Ji Zhengyao was all smiles, his eyes filled with a doting affection he wasn't even aware of himself.

"Thank you, Director Ji."

Ling Ting cradled the pot of flowers, thanked Ji Zhengyao happily, and ran toward the car.

Ji Zhengyao watched the little girl skipping along, full of vitality, and felt a joy he had never experienced before.

On the way back, Ling Ting sat in the passenger seat, hugging the pot of flowers. Her body leaned slightly to the side, and her head bobbed as she drifted off to sleep.

Looking over, the evening breeze had tousled the girl’s long hair, with a few mischievous strands dancing in the air, brushing against his shoulder as if they were there or not. Ji Zhengyao curled his lips into a smile, suddenly feeling the illusion of a peaceful, quiet life.

Because Ling Ting looked so beautiful while sleeping, after they arrived home, Ji Zhengyao, as if possessed, took out his phone and snapped a photo of her face.

The sound of the camera woke Ling Ting. She rubbed her sleepy eyes and looked at Ji Zhengyao with a dazed expression.

Ji Zhengyao was looked at softly by Ling Ting’s unguarded eyes, and ripples stirred in his calm heart, as if someone had thrown a stone into it.

"Director Ji, are we here?"

Ling Ting looked out the window, asking groggily.

"Yes, we’re here."

Ji Zhengyao withdrew his gaze, coughed lightly, and put his phone away.

"Then I’ll head back first."

Ling Ting hugged the flowers and opened the car door to get out.

"Ling Ting!"

Ji Zhengyao called out to her.

But when she turned her head, he didn't know what to say.

"It’s nothing."

Ji Zhengyao smiled, signaling that Ling Ting could go.

"Goodbye, Director Ji."

Ling Ting was still dazed from sleep and didn't notice anything unusual about Ji Zhengyao. She opened the door and struggled to carry the pot of flowers as she prepared to head home.

"Ling Ting!"

Qin Nan rushed out from the darkness and grabbed her hand. "I said we were about to get married, so why did you suddenly ask for a breakup? So, you’d already found someone else?"

Qin Nan glanced at Ji Zhengyao’s car, his eyes looking as if they were spitting fire.

That car was something he wouldn't even dare to dream of in this lifetime.

"Qin Nan, what are you doing? Let go of me!"

Ling Ting was in pain from Qin Nan’s grip; she could barely hold onto the flowerpot.

"I won't let go. You have to give me an explanation today."

The reason Qin Nan hadn't come to find Ling Ting these past few days was because he had listened to his mother.

His mother said that the reason Ling Ting had made a scene before the wedding was just to manipulate him.

His mother said she had seen such things many times and that he shouldn't pay any attention to it; just ignoring her for a few days would be enough.

But he had waited and waited, yet he never saw Ling Ting have a change of heart.

Qin Nan had intended to sneak over to take a look, but he hadn't expected her to have a new lover already.

"Let go!"

Ji Zhengyao had originally intended to get out of the car to help Ling Ting with the flowers, but as soon as one leg stepped out, he heard Qin Nan’s words.

He hesitated for a split second, then saw that Ling Ting’s face had turned pale.

"I said let go!"

His voice was cold enough to freeze someone solid.

Qin Nan was very thin, and Ji Zhengyao was a soldier by trade; the disparity in their strength was incomparable.

He rubbed his arm, which had been pinched painfully by Ji Zhengyao, and glared fiercely at Ling Ting.

"Qin Nan, we have already broken up."

Ling Ting’s face was covered in tears, her voice filled with endless grievance. "Can’t we just part on good terms?"

"No!"

Qin Nan roared, "Ling Ting, it’s just signing a prenuptial agreement. If you loved me, you wouldn't care at all."

"If you loved me, you wouldn't have asked me to sign it in the first place!"

Ling Ting sobbed uncontrollably, her whole body trembling.

"You watched your mother bully me and did nothing, and now you’re blaming me?"

Ling Ting set the flowerpot down, her eyes full of despair. "You knew I had no parents and no one to back me up, yet you still teamed up with your mother to bully me. How could you have the heart to do that?"

"Ling Ting, listen to my explanation."

Qin Nan wanted to say something, but Ling Ting interrupted him. "Qin Nan, we are finished. From now on, let’s go our separate ways and not disturb each other, okay?"

"No."

Qin Nan shook his head and took two steps back. "No, I don't agree."

chapters.title: Completely Unable to Sleep
chapters.content:
Seeing Ling Ting crying until she could barely stand, her frail body trembling violently, Ji Zhengyao felt a pang in his heart. He narrowed his eyes at Qin Nan, walked over, and pulled her directly into his arms.

Qin Nan felt a slight tremor at that look from Ji Zhengyao. Once he regained his composure, he turned the tables, "Ling Ting, tell me the truth, is it because of him that you broke up with me?"

Even now, he couldn't believe that a single prenuptial agreement could make Ling Ting leave.

"Qin Nan..."

"So what if it is?"

Before Ling Ting could explain, she was interrupted by Ji Zhengyao.

He held down the struggling girl in his arms and looked down at Qin Nan with contempt, "You're getting married, yet instead of thinking about what you can provide for your wife, you're racking your brains to scheme against her. Do you even count as a man?"

"Our business is none of your concern!"

Feeling guilty under Ji Zhengyao's words, Qin Nan retorted with forced composure, "Don't just stand there and talk big. I don't believe you can give Ling Ting anything."

"I can give her plenty."

Ji Zhengyao smiled confidently and secretly stroked Ling Ting's soft cheek, "If Ling Ting marries me, never mind a house, I could transfer all my assets into her name."

Ji Zhengyao provocatively lifted his chin and raised an eyebrow at Qin Nan, "Well? Are you unconvinced?"

"I..."

Qin Nan was shocked by Ji Zhengyao's words, his eyes full of disbelief.

"Director Ji, I..."

Ling Ting was startled by Ji Zhengyao's words. She instantly forgot the sensation on her face and reached out to tug at his sleeve.

"Ling Ting, a man who schemes against you even for marriage isn't worth it. From now on, stay with me, and I guarantee you'll live well."

After domineeringly shutting down Qin Nan, Ji Zhengyao bent down to pick up the potted plant from the ground and pulled Ling Ting toward the residential complex.

Ling Ting followed passively behind Ji Zhengyao, looking at his tall, upright back. Her mind was a blank, and her entire body felt numb.

She felt as if she were hallucinating; Ji Zhengyao's words echoed in her ears for a long time.

"Do you need me to walk you up?"

When they reached the bottom of Ling Ting's building, Ji Zhengyao reached out and pinched Ling Ting's cheek again, gesturing with his chin toward the plant in his hand.

Ling Ting looked at Ji Zhengyao and shook her head foolishly.

"Then be careful going up."

Ji Zhengyao shoved the flowerpot into Ling Ting's arms and leaned in to plant a kiss on her forehead.

Because of that kiss, Ling Ting didn't sleep well all night. The next morning, she called Qiao Yin.

She had backed herself into a dead end and desperately needed Qiao Yin's guidance.

"Qiao Yin, what do you think Director Ji actually meant?"

Ling Ting pursed her lips, her small face full of conflict.

"Ling Ting, do you think Director Ji might have fallen in love with you?"

Qiao Yin was standing in the factory workshop, covering one ear with her hand, shouting into the phone with excitement.

"Don't talk nonsense, how could that be?"

Ling Ting didn't believe it; it was impossible for the two of them.

"Then just pretend he's helping you."

Qiao Yin shrugged. She had a premonition that Ling Ting's romantic luck had arrived.

That Director Ji definitely had his eye on her.

Regardless of whether Ling Ting's romantic luck had arrived or not, for the next few days, she didn't dare reply to any of the messages Ji Zhengyao sent her.

On the rare occasions they ran into each other at work, she would scurry away, acting like a mouse seeing a cat.

Ji Zhengyao was furious at Ling Ting's avoidance, but he couldn't just summon her to his office.

Things spread too quickly in the workplace, and he didn't want to cause trouble for Ling Ting.

But he felt stifled.

Ji Zhengyao was the type to hold a grudge; if he wasn't comfortable, he wouldn't let others be comfortable either.

Unable to vent his anger on Ling Ting, he could only have someone investigate Qin Nan.

Upon learning that the two had been together for two years and had always been on good terms—and that they would likely have been married by now if not for the fallout over the prenuptial agreement—Ji Zhengyao felt even more congested.

Because of this, Ji Zhengyao's face had been dark for the past two days, to the point where even Secretary Yao was walking on eggshells.

He always felt that someone was about to have bad luck.

Just as Secretary Yao suspected, Qin Nan, who had become a thorn in Director Ji's side, was summoned by his direct superior early Wednesday morning.

He was sent on a business trip to a remote mountainous area, which would last for more than half a month.

With Qin Nan gone, Ji Zhengyao felt much better. Over the weekend, he uncharacteristically agreed to go watch Ji Yunxiao race.

"Uncle, oh my, why are you still sitting there?"

Ji Yunxiao ran in from outside. Seeing that his uncle hadn't even changed his clothes yet, he was so anxious he almost started spinning in place.

"Can't you be more steady?"

Ji Zhengyao glared at his nephew, who was twenty-eight but acted like an eight-year-old. He crushed his cigarette and went to his room to change.

After changing, he led Ji Yunxiao downstairs, instructing him as they walked, "Call Li Sheng and ask him what he's doing."

"You got it!"

Hearing his uncle ask him to call his idol, Ji Yunxiao was thrilled. He pulled out his phone and dialed.

Li Sheng hadn't been very busy lately. He had been hungover the night before and was still sprawled in bed when he received Ji Yunxiao's call.

However, it had been many days since he last saw Ji Zhengyao, so he stretched and climbed out of bed.

The group met at the racetrack. Ji Yunxiao went to change, while Li Sheng and Ji Zhengyao sat in the shade.

"What's wrong with you? You look like you have something on your mind."

Li Sheng poured himself a glass of water and asked with a chuckle, looking at Ji Zhengyao.

Ji Zhengyao leaned back lazily against the chair, rubbed his brow, and said honestly, "I'm in a bad mood."

The little girl was avoiding him too effectively, and Ji Zhengyao was frustrated that he couldn't catch her.

"Oh? The always-smiling Director Ji actually has times when he's in a bad mood?"

Li Sheng pushed the cup in front of him toward Ji Zhengyao and teased him, "Don't tell me you've been dumped?"

In truth, Li Sheng was just joking; he knew full well whether Ji Zhengyao had a girlfriend.

But to his surprise, Ji Zhengyao didn't deny it at all and even nodded seriously.

"You could say that."

"No way?"

Li Sheng was shocked, "Who is it?"

He was genuinely curious about who had captured the heart of this cold-hearted man.

Didn't he love no one but himself?

"You wouldn't know her even if I told you."

"If you tell me, won't I know her?"

Li Sheng stood up excitedly, took out his phone, dialed a number, and shouted into it without any regard for his image, "Hey, hey, hey, big news! Ji Zhengyao is dating someone!"

There was dead silence on the other end, followed by a piercing howl.

"Re-re-really?"

Li Sheng hung up the phone before the person could finish.

...

"Old Ji, Chang Ning said he ran into you at the hospital with a girl. Could it be her?"

Li Sheng tossed his phone aside and stared intently at Ji Zhengyao.

Ji Zhengyao glanced at Li Sheng, who had no trace of a CEO's image left, "So what if it is?"

"Bring her out!"

Li Sheng couldn't stand that the secretary had seen the person Ji Zhengyao liked, but he hadn't.

"Wait a while, it's not possible for now."

The little girl was too timid and full of wariness toward him; even if Ji Zhengyao wanted to bring her out, he couldn't.

She was so reserved when it was just the two of them; if she saw strangers, she might just get scared to tears.

"What's the matter? You haven't chased her down yet?"

chapters.title: Xiaolu is Back
chapters.content:
Li Sheng pulled a stool over and sat down next to Ji Zhengyao, rubbing his chin with the air of a mastermind. "Want me to give you some advice?"

"Get lost."

Ji Zhengyao didn't need anyone's help.

"You..."

"Uncle, I'm about to start."

Li Sheng wanted to say more, but was interrupted by Ji Yunxiao, who had come running over.

"Go ahead, stay safe."

Ji Zhengyao lifted his chin and instructed Ji Yunxiao in a low voice.

"Got it."

Ji Yunxiao high-fived Li Sheng and walked toward his car.

A large crowd had already gathered over there; since his uncle and Li Sheng were in the VIP area, it wasn't too crowded.

But no matter where his uncle was, as long as he showed up, Ji Yunxiao’s confidence doubled.

Perhaps it was the arrival of Ji Zhengyao and Li Sheng that gave Ji Yunxiao such confidence; he performed exceptionally well today, defeating the dark horse who had been firmly holding the top spot for some time.

"Uncle, I won! I actually won!"

Wearing his bulky racing suit, Ji Yunxiao ran toward Ji Zhengyao, dancing with joy.

Ji Zhengyao felt embarrassed. He exchanged a look with Li Sheng, and both of them retreated into a corner.

They were normal people; they couldn't compare to a social butterfly like Ji Yunxiao.

"Uncle, how was it?"

Ji Yunxiao’s eyes were full of excitement; he didn't even notice that his uncle and Li Sheng had changed positions.

"Not bad."

"Great job!"

Ji Zhengyao and Li Sheng both gave high praise.

"So, is there a reward?"

Ji Yunxiao grinned, his eyes full of anticipation.

"How about I treat you to my new club?"

Li Sheng patted Ji Yunxiao on the shoulder and asked with a smile.

"Sure! I've been wanting to go there for a long time. Can I bring friends?"

"Sure."

Li Sheng nodded.

"Thanks, Brother Li."

With that, as if he had gained a huge advantage, he ran off clumsily to change his clothes.

Li Sheng sighed helplessly. "Is he really that happy just because he called me 'brother'?"

After a long silence without a response from Ji Zhengyao, Li Sheng followed his gaze and realized he was staring at someone.

That person had a buzz cut and a long scar on his face, extending from the corner of his eye down to his jaw.

"Who is that?" Li Sheng asked.

"I heard he's this year's dark horse."

"The one Yunxiao helped pay off all his debts?"

Li Sheng wanted to laugh, and he couldn't hold it back.

"Brother Li, can you stop mocking me?"

Ji Yunxiao returned after changing his clothes, looking a bit unhappy.

Ji Yunxiao was a well-known rich kid at this racetrack; he knew he couldn't beat the others, yet he kept raising the stakes time and time again.

It was said that the dark horse was no longer a "black household" (unregistered resident) now, all thanks to Ji Yunxiao’s help.

"Alright, alright, I'll stop. Let's go, let's go."

Since Ji Yunxiao had finally won for once, Li Sheng didn't want to ruin the mood, so he put his arm around him and headed to the club.

After arriving at the club, Ji Zhengyao didn't join them in the fun. Instead, he took a bottle of liquor and went to a corner.

He was in a bad mood, and after finishing the bottle, he went home.

Back home, Ji Zhengyao scrolled through the photos of Ling Ting he had secretly taken on his phone. The little girl was sleeping soundly, like a little piglet.

Looking at her, Ji Zhengyao smiled unconsciously.

It was a look of indulgence and tenderness.

Ji Zhengyao never expected that he would have a day like this.

He had always thought of himself as a cold-hearted person who would never fall in love with any woman in this lifetime.

But he was wrong; that person had perhaps occupied his heart ten years ago.

Thinking of that heartless little girl, Ji Zhengyao felt a wave of helpless affection and sent her a voice message.

Ling Ting, who had just finished a call with her cousin, accidentally swiped her screen and connected the call.

Ling Ting: "..."

"Hello?"

A soft, sweet voice that felt like a tickle came through the phone, and Ji Zhengyao’s eyebrows twitched slightly.

"Ling Ting, where are you?"

Ji Zhengyao had been drinking, so his tone wasn't as official as usual; it was so gentle it could almost drip water.

"Director Ji, I'm at home."

Ling Ting nervously clutched her pajamas and thought for a moment before saying, "I'm getting ready to sleep."

Ever since Ji Zhengyao kissed her, Ling Ting’s heart had been racing; she would blush and feel her heart pound whenever she thought about it. Now, she just wanted to hang up as quickly as possible.

It was too awkward.

"Sleeping so early?"

Ji Zhengyao checked the time; it was only nine o'clock.

"Yeah, I have to work tomorrow."

"Ling Ting."

Ji Zhengyao was silent for a moment before calling her name.

"Yes?"

"Do you still remember that you owe me a meal?"

Ji Zhengyao curled his lips and asked suddenly.

"I... I remember."

Ling Ting never expected that Ji Zhengyao would send a voice message just to urge her to treat him to a meal.

"So when are you going to treat me?" Ji Zhengyao pressed on.

"How about... the weekend?"

Ling Ting was on the verge of tears. Was a single meal really worth all this?

"It's a deal then, we'll go out for a meal on the weekend."

Ji Zhengyao raised his eyebrows, finally satisfied. "Sleep early."

Because he had been too excited the night before, Ji Zhengyao didn't close his eyes until dawn. He only got up and rushed to get ready for work after receiving a call from Xiao Yao.

"Zhengyao, hurry, hurry, take me to the hospital."

Wen Yazhi stopped Ji Zhengyao, her face full of worry.

"Sister-in-law, what's wrong?"

Seeing that Wen Yazhi’s expression was off, Ji Zhengyao immediately asked.

"It's not me, it's your uncle. He's not doing well."

Hearing that it was about his uncle, Ji Zhengyao frowned slightly. After a moment of hesitation, he finally nodded and followed Wen Yazhi to the hospital.

Ling Ting stood by the window, secretly observing. Seeing that Ji Zhengyao’s parking space remained empty, she felt incredibly happy.

Ji Zhengyao didn't come, so she didn't have to hide; it was wonderful.

"Ling Ting, I'm back!"

Just as Ling Ting was secretly rejoicing and smiling while preparing to pour herself a glass of water, a girl wearing a miniskirt and high heels, smelling of perfume, rushed in.

"Xiaolu, when did you get back?"

Seeing Xiaolu, Ling Ting looked pleasantly surprised.

"Yesterday, the flight last night."

Xiaolu put down her things and reached out to hug Ling Ting.

After the hug, she touched her chin and looked her up and down for a while, then frowned and said, "Ling Ting, why have you lost so much weight?"

Ling Ting had always been thin, but not to this extent.

She didn't even feel comfortable to hug anymore.

"Really?"

Ling Ting touched her face. "I don't think so?"

She hadn't noticed.

"Tell me, did you secretly lose weight just to look good in your wedding dress?"

Xiaolu leaned in close to Ling Ting and whispered, pointing at her.

"No."

The smile on Ling Ting’s face stiffened, and she shook her head. "I'm not getting married anymore."

"What?" Xiaolu was shocked. "You're not getting married?"

"Ling Ting, what did you say? You're not getting married?"

Xiao Liu, who had just walked to the door, heard Ling Ting’s words and rushed in.

Like Xiaolu, his face was full of disbelief.

"Yeah, I broke up with Qin Nan."

Ling Ting hadn't intended to say anything, but thinking that everyone would find out eventually, she decided to just be honest.

"Ling Ting, you finally came to your senses!"

Xiaolu hugged Ling Ting again, laughing happily. "You have no idea how sad I've been because you were going to get married at such a young age."

In Xiaolu’s mind, with Ling Ting’s looks and figure, finding a man with a house and a car would be a breeze.

At the very least, she could find a minor official and have a life of comfort...

chapters.title: Feeling Sorry for Xiaolu
chapters.content:
Qin Nan had only graduated from university a few years ago. Although he was a civil servant, the idea of him getting ahead in a short time was nothing but a pipe dream.

Besides, that guy was stingy. They had been together for so long, and she had never seen him buy Ling Ting anything; he was clearly unreliable.

Well, it was for the best now. The silly girl had finally come to her senses.

"Ling Ting, when did this happen? How come I never heard you mention it before?"

Xiao Liu quickly wiped the emotion from his face and walked over to the water dispenser to pour himself a glass of water.

His heart was pounding violently at that moment, and he had to drink some water to calm himself down.

"Just a few days ago," Ling Ting said, lowering her head, her voice barely a whisper.

"Oh, alright, alright. If it’s over, it’s over. Come, come, look what good things I brought you!"

Xiaolu couldn't bear to see Ling Ting sad, so she grabbed a bag and shoved it into her hands.

"What is this?" Ling Ting asked, holding the bag, confused.

"It’s a bag I bought for you. See if you like it?"

"Xiaolu, this is too expensive."
