Although Ling Ting didn't know much about big brands, Xiaolu was known for being free with her money, so she knew without asking that the bag must be very pricey.

Seeing Ling Ting trying to return the gift, Xiaolu rolled her eyes helplessly. "Oh, stop it. You were in such a good mood."

With that, she handed over the gift for Xiao Liu. "Yours, the latest camera model."

Xiao Liu loved photography and was very skilled at it; Xiaolu figured this was something he would like.

"Thank you."

Xiao Liu was indeed very pleased and grinned foolishly. But only he knew the real reason for his happiness.

"Xiaolu, are you free tonight? I’d like to treat you and Ling Ting to dinner."

Xiao Liu glanced at Xiaolu, then looked at Ling Ting, terrified that she might refuse.

"Sure! I’m going to make sure to bleed you dry today," Xiaolu agreed readily.

"Oh, look who it is. So, Xiaolu is back."

Sister Wang walked in from outside, glanced at the gifts in Ling Ting and Xiao Liu’s hands, and let out a "hmph" through her nose.

"Oh, if it isn't Sister Wang? What time is it? Late again, I see?"

Xiaolu crossed her arms, mimicked Sister Wang’s tone, and gave her a sidelong glance.

"You..."

Sister Wang checked the time and sat down at her desk, fuming. It was only a few minutes late, after all.

Seeing that Sister Wang’s face was ugly and she had finally shut up, Xiaolu didn't want to bother with her. She winked at Ling Ting, grabbed a bag, and headed toward Director Huang’s office.

Although her father’s rank was higher than Director Huang’s, the local official is more powerful than the distant one; a little flattery was still in order.

"What’s she so stuck-up about?"

Sister Wang slammed her bag onto the desk and spat in the direction where Xiaolu had disappeared.

Ling Ting and Xiao Liu exchanged a look, said nothing, and sat quietly at their desks.

With Xiaolu back, the atmosphere in the office instantly livened up. She was talkative and cheerful, which made even Ling Ting and Xiao Liu talk more.

"Work's over, let's go."

With Xiaolu around, the day passed very quickly. As soon as it hit five o'clock, she was already organizing their departure.

Xiao Liu, who was treating them, stood up as well and looked at Ling Ting.

Ling Ting hadn't intended to go, but seeing them both looking at her with eager eyes, she smiled and began to pack her things.

The group was chatting and laughing as they reached the main entrance when a car pulled up and the window slowly rolled down.

"Where are you all headed?"

Ji Zhengyao had been busy all day and only emerged from the hospital half an hour before the end of the workday.

He had originally intended to go straight home, as he didn't like the smell of disinfectant clinging to him. But thinking of Ling Ting, he decisively turned the steering wheel and drove to her office.

"We're going out for dinner."

Ling Ting’s face turned red the moment she saw Ji Zhengyao, and even her ears turned a pale pink.

Ji Zhengyao rested his hand on the car window, watching the young girl in front of him lower her head and fidget with her fingers, not even daring to look at him. He found it both frustrating and amusing.

A single kiss, and it scared her like this? Didn't they have a voice chat just last night?

"Go ahead."

Ji Zhengyao didn't want to put Ling Ting on the spot. He nodded at Xiao Liu and rolled up the window.

"Wow!"

"Who is that?"

Xiaolu had been away for a month and had no idea about Ji Zhengyao’s arrival. Seeing him deftly reverse and drive away, she became completely excited.

"That’s the new Director Ji. Because he holds other positions, he doesn't work here very often."

Xiao Liu led Ling Ting and Xiaolu toward his car, muttering to himself as he walked. What was up with Director Ji? Coming by just before the end of the day and leaving without even going inside?

Hearing that the handsome man was actually their new leader, Xiaolu’s eyes lit up, and she let out a squeal.

"Our crappy office actually managed to get such an eye-catching leader?"

She had thought that having Ling Ting around was already a treat for the eyes, but she hadn't expected a super-invincible handsome man to show up too.

"Director Ji is probably just passing through."

Xiao Liu had heard from others that Director Ji had a powerful family background and an impressive resume; his promotion was only a matter of time. He was just here to "gild" his resume until he reached the right age. After all, he was only thirty-one; there was nowhere else to go but up.

"That’s great."

Xiaolu shook the large hoops on her ears, clicked her tongue, and excitedly reached out to cup Ling Ting’s face.

"Ling Ting, I am just so happy!"

"What for?"

Ling Ting was still immersed in the awkwardness of being stared at by Ji Zhengyao and didn't immediately understand what Xiaolu meant.

"You have no idea how hard it is for me to get through the workday. If it weren't for your pretty face, I probably would have quit and gone home a long time ago."

Xiaolu let go of Ling Ting, put on a blissful expression, and said with satisfaction, "Now it’s even better—with a golden boy and a jade girl by my side, I can survive just by feasting my eyes every day."

"Xiaolu, can you stop joking?"

Xiao Liu opened the car door to signal them to get in, saying to the excitable Xiaolu with a laugh.

"Don't worry about it. I just love looking at handsome men and beautiful women."

That was her personal hobby, and no one could stop her.

Ling Ting shook her head, unable to do anything about Xiaolu.

"Alright, let's put personal hobbies aside for a moment. What do you two want to eat?"

Xiao Liu turned the steering wheel onto the main road and asked Ling Ting and Xiaolu with a smile.

"Let's go for barbecue. Ling Ting is just too thin," Xiaolu said, tugging at Ling Ting’s slender arm, looking very dissatisfied.

"Alright, barbecue it is."

Xiao Liu glanced in the rearview mirror at Ling Ting’s face, which had indeed become much thinner, and nodded in agreement.

Xiaolu was talkative and cheerful, carefree and without a scheming bone in her body. After arriving at the restaurant, she ordered Xiao Liu to go order the food, and while walking to the restroom with Ling Ting, she began talking about her trip abroad.

Ling Ting had assumed Xiaolu must have had some urgent matter to take such a long leave, but to her surprise, she had actually gone to attend her own mother’s wedding.

"What’s wrong? Is it a surprise?"

Xiaolu looked at Ling Ting and forced a smile. "My mom is on her fourth marriage. I’ve already attended her wedding twice."

Ling Ting looked at Xiaolu. Although she was smiling, for some reason, she felt an inexplicable ache in her heart.

"Xiaolu..."

Ling Ting grabbed Xiaolu’s hand, offering silent comfort.

"Oh my..."

chapters.title: Handling the Little Girl
chapters.content:
Seeing Ling Ting looking at her with eyes full of heartache, Xiaolu choked up for a rare moment, held her hand, and said, "It’s fine, I’m used to it."

Her father wasn't even her mother's first husband, so what was there to dwell on?

"Xiaolu, you are so brave."

Ling Ting thought Xiaolu was wonderful, the kind of person who could sleep soundly even if the sky were falling.

She couldn't do that.

Whenever she encountered the slightest trouble, she would shrink into her shell like a tortoise.

Just one kiss from Director Ji had scared away all her courage.

After returning from the restroom, Ling Ting and Xiaolu didn't bring up any unhappy topics again. The group chatted and laughed, and soon all the dishes were served.

Xiaolu was a master at livening up the atmosphere. Throughout the entire meal, she talked about her poor English and the embarrassing things that happened to her abroad, laughing until she had tears in her eyes twice.

However, she had one bad habit: she kept forcing Ling Ting to drink with her.

Xiao Liu had to drive, so he couldn't keep her company.

Ling Ting had always been a good girl; she had never touched alcohol in her life. After one glass of beer, her face started to burn.

Her pretty little face turned flushed, as if she had applied rouge.

Xiaolu said that Ling Ting looked best like this and poured her another glass.

Ling Ting didn't want to drink it, but she couldn't resist Xiaolu's persuasion and forced it down, sip by sip.

"Alright, Ling Ting lives alone; it's not safe if she drinks too much."

Xiaolu was getting more and more excited as she drank. Just as she was about to fill Ling Ting's glass again, Xiao Liu stopped her.

"Fine, fine, fine. Then I'll drink it myself."

Xiaolu listened to reason and finally let Ling Ting off the hook.

However, the look she gave Xiao Liu held a subtle, profound meaning.

After they were full and satisfied, Xiao Liu dropped Xiaolu off at home first, then drove Ling Ting to the entrance of her residential complex.

"Xiao Liu, thank you for today."

Ling Ting rubbed her dizzy head and thanked Xiao Liu politely before getting out of the car.

"Ling Ting!"

Xiao Liu wiped the sweat from his forehead nervously, hesitated for a moment, and called out to her.

"What is it?"

Ling Ting looked at Xiao Liu, puzzled, her blurry eyes struggling to focus.

She was drunk.

"Nothing. Get some rest early."

Staring into Ling Ting’s innocent eyes, Xiao Liu’s heart raced, and he instantly lost his nerve.

"Then drive slowly."

Ling Ting didn't notice the disappointment in Xiao Liu's eyes; she smiled at him, waved her hand, and walked into the complex.

Watching Ling Ting leave his sight just like that, Xiao Liu gripped the steering wheel tightly. After a long while, he slumped against the seat like a deflated balloon.

He was too ordinary; he wasn't good enough for her.

While Xiao Liu was filled with self-reproach over the words he hadn't been able to say, cursing himself the whole way, Ji Zhengyao back home hadn't stopped smoking since he arrived.

He suffered from severe insomnia, and for these past few years, he had relied entirely on cigarettes to get by.

He hadn't slept much last night, and after a grueling day at the hospital, his temples were throbbing.

"Uncle, why are you home so early today?"

Ji Yunxiao wandered in from outside. Seeing his uncle actually at home, his drooping eyelids instantly shot up.

"Aren't you home pretty early yourself?"

Ji Zhengyao glanced sideways at his nephew, leaned forward, and stubbed out his cigarette in the ashtray.

"I was even earlier than this yesterday."

Ji Yunxiao worked at the family business, but he just went there to kill time. Sometimes he would stay for the morning and come back to sleep in the afternoon.

He rarely got off work on time like this even a few times a month.

"You have the nerve to say that?"

Wen Yazhi walked out of the room and glared at her son, frustrated that he wouldn't live up to her expectations.

"Mom, look at you saying that. Why wouldn't I have the nerve?"

Ji Yunxiao grinned, shamelessly wrapping his arms around her. "This is what you call being good at reincarnation—I was born into your womb."

"Fine, fine, fine. I can't win against you. Let me ask you, how are things going with that girl named Lin Wei?"

Wen Yazhi didn't want to listen to her son’s glib talk; once she sat down, she remembered this matter.

"Huh?"

Ji Yunxiao was stunned. He hadn't expected his mother to suddenly ask about this; he had completely forgotten.

He looked at his uncle for help.

When Ji Zhengyao heard the name Lin Wei, he paused slightly, then asked as if casually, "Sister-in-law, what did the other side say after the blind date last time?"

The little girl had used the name Lin Wei when she went on the blind date with him. He had been busy lately and had forgotten all about it.

"The matchmaker said they agreed as well," Wen Yazhi said.

"They agreed as well?"

Ji Zhengyao raised an eyebrow. The little girl didn't look like someone who would agree.

"Uncle, what's wrong?" Ji Yunxiao asked.

"Nothing. Don't upset your mother."

With that, Ji Zhengyao strolled leisurely toward the stairs.

He needed to find someone to look into what was going on.

"Yunxiao, listen to Mom. You must treat that girl well," Wen Yazhi said, watching her brother-in-law go upstairs, trying to persuade her son earnestly.

"Oh, Mom, I know. You don't have to worry."

Ji Yunxiao leaned in close to his mother, hugged her shoulders, and shook them, coaxing her with sweet words.

"Just wait to drink your daughter-in-law's tea and hold your grandson."

"Really?"

Wen Yazhi looked at her son, who had dyed his hair white, and looked at him with disbelief.

"Really, really. When the time is right, I'll bring her home. You just get the welcome gift ready."

His mother had a serious heart condition, and even his father, a tough man, pampered her. Ji Yunxiao wouldn't dare make her angry.

If his father found out, a whip soaked in cold water would be the least of his worries.

Thinking of the stinging sensation of a whip, Ji Yunxiao shivered and continued to feed his mother empty promises.

But as he was talking, he received some terrible news.

His father was coming back!

"Uncle, Uncle, you have to help me!"

After sending his mother back to her room, Ji Yunxiao rushed into Ji Zhengyao's study, wailing as if the world were coming to an end.

"What is it now?"

Ji Zhengyao frowned, hung up the phone, and asked impatiently.

"My dad is coming back, Uncle! My dad is coming back!"

Ji Yunxiao paced around anxiously, looking completely lost.

"Behave yourself for a while. Can't you learn to be obedient?"

His nephew had been mischievous since he was a child, and his eldest brother had a heavy hand. The two of them, one stubborn and one provocative, were in constant conflict.

However, his eldest brother was very busy; as long as his nephew didn't cause trouble, he wouldn't have time to deal with him.

"Uncle, should I go out and hide?"

Ji Yunxiao put his hand to his lips and lowered his voice. "My mom said there was an accident during the exercise this time, and he lost."

Thinking of his brother’s perpetually dark face, Ji Yunxiao felt his liver tremble.

Hearing that his brother had lost the exercise, Ji Zhengyao frowned slightly and glanced at the white hair on his nephew's head.

"What are you doing?" Ji Yunxiao stepped back, suddenly having a bad premonition.

"If you don't want to die, go dye your hair back immediately."

Ji Zhengyao said no more.

"Uncle..."

Ji Yunxiao wanted to say something else, but Ji Zhengyao waved his hand, signaling him to leave.

"Alright."

Ji Yunxiao went out, not forgetting to close the door on his way.

chapters.title: Pampering
chapters.content:
The tactless nephew finally left. Ji Zhengyao picked up his phone again, calculated the time, and sent a message to Ling Ting.

[Did you enjoy your meal?]

After waiting for a while, Ling Ting did not reply.

[Are you home yet?]

The message remained unanswered, like a stone dropped into the ocean.

Ji Zhengyao threw his phone onto the table with some irritation and stood up, walking over to the floor-to-ceiling window.

In his thirty-some years of life, this was the first time he had felt so restless over someone.

Suddenly, Ji Zhengyao cast aside his reserve and sent a voice message directly.

Ling Ting was indeed asleep. After being dropped off by Xiao Liu, she had stumbled into bed, feeling dizzy.

When her phone rang, she was still lightheaded. It took her a long time to press the answer button. "Who is it?"

Her voice was soft and sweet.

Ji Zhengyao, who had been a bit angry because Ling Ting didn't reply to his messages, paused: "..."

"Ling Ting, are you home?"

His voice was so gentle that even he was surprised by it.

"I'm home."

Ling Ting answered vaguely, her eyes closed.

"What's wrong with you?"

Ji Zhengyao’s ears were sharp; he could tell something was off with Ling Ting after just two sentences.

"Nothing's wrong."

Ling Ting’s tone rose, humming in a way that sounded particularly pleasant. "I just drank a bit too much."

"You drank?"

The face that had just been pleasant a moment ago instantly darkened.

"I was happy, so I had two glasses."

Ling Ting seemed to recall something happy, giggling. "Xiao Lu is back, so I have someone to back me up now."

"Is someone bullying you?"

Ji Zhengyao’s expression turned tense.

"With Xiao Lu here, no one can bully me."

Ling Ting continued to giggle foolishly.

Usually, when Ling Ting saw him, she was always timid and afraid to speak. Now that she was happy and her voice was soft and sweet, Ji Zhengyao’s heart instantly softened.

How could he bear to scold her?

"Do you feel like throwing up?"

Ji Zhengyao sighed, as if reconciling with himself. He stood up from his chair, grabbed his car keys, and walked out.

He was worried about Ling Ting and wanted to go check on her.

"I don't want to throw up."

Ling Ting turned over. "Director Ji, why are the walls all slanted? Am I going to be crushed to death?"

"Nonsense, that won't happen."

Ji Zhengyao opened the car door, sat in, and chuckled. "Ling Ting, I'm coming over to hold the wall for you now. Wait for me."

With that, he drove toward Ling Ting's home.

But when he reached the entrance of the residential complex, Ji Zhengyao suddenly stopped the car. Listening to the steady breathing on the other end of the line, he shook his head and smiled.

The little girl had fallen asleep and was even snoring softly.

...

After a night of hangover, her biological clock forcibly restarted the next day. Ling Ting rubbed her temples, which were still throbbing.

She hadn't expected that two beers could make her this dizzy.

Ling Ting gave a bitter smile; her alcohol tolerance was truly average.

Although she felt a bit incompetent, it was almost time for work. Ling Ting tidied up briefly, grabbed her canvas bag, and headed out.

"Ling Ting."

Just as she reached the gate of the complex, she was blocked by Ji Zhengyao.

"Di... Director Ji?"

Ling Ting clutched the hem of her shirt and lowered her head.

Thinking of that kiss, she felt completely uncomfortable.

"Get in the car."

Ji Zhengyao leaned against the car, his long legs crossed, and tilted his head at Ling Ting. "I have something to tell you."

"What is it?"

Ling Ting pursed her lips and stood still.

"It's about you lying to me."

Ji Zhengyao wore a half-smile as he walked up to Ling Ting.

"I..."

Ling Ting’s face changed drastically, her almond eyes filled with disbelief.

What was meant to happen had finally come.

"Do you want to talk about it here?"

Ji Zhengyao leaned down to look her in the eye, staring into her beautiful eyes with keen interest.

"No."

Ling Ting shook her head, glanced at him cautiously, and took small steps toward the car.

Once inside, Ling Ting picked at her fingers, head bowed, looking like someone who had done something wrong.

"Tell me, what exactly is going on?"

Ji Zhengyao turned sideways, avoiding the sight of Ling Ting’s porcelain-white neck, and asked in a low voice.

In truth, he already knew everything.

"It's just..."

"Wait!"

Ji Zhengyao interrupted her, took out the soy milk he had just bought, inserted the straw, and shoved it into Ling Ting’s hand.

"I don't want to drink it."

Ling Ting shook her head. Her lie had been exposed; how could she have the appetite?

"Drink it, and tell me slowly."

The little girl had drunk too much last night, and her complexion was poor.

"Thank you."

Ling Ting was indeed parched from being frightened by Ji Zhengyao. After thanking him, she put the straw to her lips.

After taking a sip of the hot soy milk, her stomach felt much better. She snuck a glance at Ji Zhengyao and, in a small voice, confessed the whole story of how she had gone on the blind date for her cousin.

"Director Ji, I'm sorry."

Ling Ting gave an awkward smile and apologized sincerely.

Ji Zhengyao looked at the pitiful little girl who kept sneaking glances at him. He had intended to accept her apology and let it go.

She didn't have it easy, either.

But thinking of his overall plan, he forced himself to harden his heart and said coldly, "I don't accept it."

"What?"

Ling Ting looked up abruptly, her clear eyes instantly turning red.

"Ling Ting, there is a price to pay for lying to me."

Seeing that the little girl was about to cry, Ji Zhengyao sighed inwardly. He held her hand and guided the soy milk to her lips.

Ling Ting took a sip mechanically and asked blankly, "Director Ji, what do I have to do so you won't be angry anymore?"

Ling Ting was truly afraid of losing her job.

Passing the civil service exam was not easy.

"Be my girlfriend."

"Cough, cough, cough."

She had just taken a sip of soy milk and was startled into a violent coughing fit.

Ling Ting had never dreamed he would make such a request.

Ji Zhengyao furrowed his brows, took a tissue, and helped wipe the corner of Ling Ting’s mouth. "Be my girlfriend for three months, and the matter of you lying to me will be settled."

"Why?"

Ling Ting rubbed her uncomfortable chest and asked, confused.

"It wasn't enough that you went on a blind date for your cousin; you even told the matchmaker that you were willing to get to know me. People on my side of the family took it seriously."

Ji Zhengyao pretended to be in a difficult position. "I am a man of status, after all. To be lied to and then immediately dumped—it’s very embarrassing."

"Ah?"

Ling Ting hurriedly apologized. "I'm sorry, Director Ji, it's all my fault."

"It is definitely your fault, so you must try to make amends."

"How do I make amends?"

Ling Ting blinked. "By being your girlfriend for three months?"

Ji Zhengyao nodded. "Yes."

"But..."

Ling Ting was very troubled, her small face full of conflict.

Ji Zhengyao took the soy milk from Ling Ting’s hand and handed her a steamed bun instead. "Doesn't your ex-boyfriend keep pestering you? If we are together, he will give up."

The previous request was just to fool the little girl; this was Ji Zhengyao’s main goal.

"This..."

Actually, Ling Ting was somewhat tempted by this point.

"Ling Ting, you lied to me first. Are you not even willing to make up for it?"

Ji Zhengyao’s expression darkened, and he straightened his posture.

"I'm willing, I'm willing, but I..."

Ling Ting sniffled. "Director Ji, we have a superior-subordinate relationship. If people find out..."

"They won't!"

Ji Zhengyao looked at Ling Ting. "After three months, we will..."

"We will break up, right?"

Ling Ting widened her almond eyes and answered cleverly.

Ji Zhengyao: "..."

*We will officially be together.*

"Think what you want, it's settled then."

Ji Zhengyao checked the time and started the car with a smile on his lips.

He didn't mind; if they stayed any longer, Ling Ting would be late.

Ling Ting had been drinking and her mind wasn't clear. After being tricked by Ji Zhengyao into agreeing to the three-month term before getting out of the car, she went to work in a daze.

But once she reached the office, as she organized the documents given to her by Director Huang, she pondered what had just happened.

She felt like something wasn't quite right.

How did she end up becoming Ji Zhengyao’s girlfriend in such a confused state?

"Director Ji, do you have any plans for lunch?"

At noon, when work ended, Director Huang approached Ji Zhengyao with a beaming smile.

"Let's just eat in the cafeteria."

He hadn't slept all night, and Ji Zhengyao’s head was hurting.

"Alright, then we'll eat in the cafeteria."

Director Huang had originally wanted to invite Ji Zhengyao out to eat, but seeing his poor complexion, he didn't bring it up.

He was the best at reading the room; if the leader wasn't feeling well, what was there to eat?

The two chatted all the way to the cafeteria. As soon as they walked in, the director spotted Ling Ting and Xiao Lu with his sharp eyes.

"Why didn't you all go out to eat today?"

Director Huang walked over with a smile.

chapters.title: Hoodwinking
chapters.content:
Xiao Lu didn't care about anything else; she made room for Director Huang, poked at the food on her tray, and frowned. "Director, we’d love to eat in the cafeteria every day, but this food is just too terrible."

She had originally planned to go out to eat today, but since Ling Ting and Xiao Liu weren't going, she had tagged along.

However, the cafeteria food was cloyingly sweet, and she really couldn't get it down.

"Hasn't it always tasted like this?"

Director Huang took a napkin and helped Ji Zhengyao wipe off the table.

"Good afternoon, Director Ji."

Seeing Ji Zhengyao behind Director Huang, Xiao Liu quickly greeted him.

Ling Ting, who had been keeping her head down while eating, looked up abruptly.

As their eyes met, Ji Zhengyao made small talk: "Is the cafeteria food not good?"

He appeared to be asking Xiao Lu, but his gaze remained fixed on Ling Ting.

"Exactly, it’s awful," Xiao Lu complained. "Director Ji, you’re the new official in charge; you really need to do something about this."

Hearing Xiao Lu’s words, Ji Zhengyao smiled gently. "Director Huang, is this the issue the young comrade is referring to?"

Director Huang looked helpless. "Director Ji, the contractor for our cafeteria is a relative of the former director."

The statement was blunt, and certainly bold.

The former director probably never dreamed that Director Huang, who had always been at his beck and call, would stab him in the back.

"Issue a rectification notice."

Ji Zhengyao gave the order directly to Director Huang.

From what he understood, Ling Ting’s salary wasn't high, and she ate in the cafeteria most of the time.

The little girl was as thin as a rail; it wouldn't do for her to eat poorly.

Although he could take her out to eat, there would be times when he couldn't look after her.

Solving it at the root would save him the worry.

"Director Ji is awesome!"

Xiao Lu had a straightforward personality. Seeing that Director Ji was so decisive, she instantly made him her idol.

Handsome and capable—not a bad deal at all.

A good leader deserved to be well-served. She stood up with a grin and eagerly went to get more food.

Seeing that Director Huang was still there, Xiao Liu also stood up and followed her.

Director Huang was an old fox; seeing that Ji Zhengyao’s eyes were glued to Ling Ting, he didn't want to stay and be a third wheel, so he slipped away as well.

"Ling Ting, are you free tonight?"

With the bothersome people gone, Ji Zhengyao relaxed his expression, leaned forward slightly, and asked Ling Ting with a smile in his eyes.

"Director Ji, I..."

"Why call me Director Ji?"

Ji Zhengyao interrupted Ling Ting, sounding somewhat dissatisfied. "Aren't we boyfriend and girlfriend? Call me by my name."

"I..."

Ling Ting’s face flushed; she couldn't bring herself to say it.

"It’s okay, don't be nervous. Just say it once for me to hear."

Ji Zhengyao coaxed her, "You’ll have to call me that sooner or later anyway."

"Stop it~"

Seeing that Xiao Lu and the others were about to return, Ling Ting was so anxious she was on the verge of tears.

"Alright, I won't tease you anymore."

Although Ji Zhengyao wanted to hear the little girl call his name, he didn't want to make her cry.

The little girl was too timid; it seemed his road to winning her heart would be a long one.

"Ling Ting, are you hot?"

Xiao Lu respectfully placed her tray in front of Ji Zhengyao, glanced at Ling Ting, and asked.

"No."

Ling Ting shook her head, looking away guiltily.

"If you aren't, why is your face so red?"

Xiao Lu reached out and touched Ling Ting’s forehead. "Could you have a fever?"

"Is it because of the spice?"

Xiao Liu sat down next to Director Huang and asked after glancing at the chili peppers on Ling Ting’s tray.

Ling Ting dodged Xiao Lu’s hand and went along with his suggestion. "A little bit."

"You can't handle spicy food? Then give it to me."

Xiao Lu also assumed Ling Ting was affected by the spice. Without a second thought, she reached over and took the few chili peppers from Ling Ting’s tray.

...

Ji Zhengyao raised an eyebrow. It was no wonder the little girl kept talking about how great Xiao Lu was even when she was drunk.

This young comrade was indeed good to her.

Ling Ting was, of course, aware that Xiao Lu was good to her, knowing she was lazy and secretly helping her finish a lot of the work Director Huang had assigned.

Xiao Lu was also grateful, providing a constant stream of milk tea and snacks.

Being with Xiao Lu was truly happy.

Ling Ting didn't have much money, but she felt it wasn't right to always eat other people's food. After work, she went to the vegetable market.

Xiao Lu had said she wanted to eat dumplings, and since she knew how to make them, she bought some ingredients to wrap them up and bring them in tomorrow morning.

But her plan was good, yet as soon as she arrived at the entrance of her apartment complex, she was blocked.

"What, don't you recognize me?"

Seeing Ling Ting staring at him blankly, Ji Zhengyao walked over and took the groceries from her hands. "Don't cook today; let's go out to eat."

"No..."

Ling Ting wanted to refuse, but was interrupted by Ji Zhengyao. "Ling Ting, we are a couple now; you can't refuse me."

As he said this, he even looked a bit aggrieved.

Ling Ting blinked. She never dreamed that an expression of grievance would appear on Ji Zhengyao’s face.

Was this still the big director she knew?

"Director Ji, I don't want to be your girlfriend anymore."

Ling Ting had been thinking about saying this all day.

It was just too awkward.

"Ling Ting, I think it’s necessary for me to meet your aunt."

Ji Zhengyao tossed Ling Ting’s groceries through the car window. The eyes behind his lenses flashed with an obvious threat.

Oh, so she regretted it after only one day.

Did she not know how much he had been looking forward to this dinner tonight?

"What do you want to eat?"

Hearing that Ji Zhengyao was going to see her aunt, Ling Ting immediately calmed down, opened the passenger door, and obediently sat inside.

She was so fast that Ji Zhengyao was a bit stunned.

"Director Ji, get in the car."

Seeing Ji Zhengyao standing there blankly for a long time without getting in, Ling Ting called out to him softly.

Her aunt was in poor health; if she found out she had conspired with her cousin to lie to her, wouldn't something terrible happen?

Forget it, forget it. Three months would pass quickly.

Ji Zhengyao: "..."

"What do you want to eat?"

Since the little girl was being obedient, Ji Zhengyao didn't want to make things difficult for her. After getting into the car, he naturally helped her fasten her seatbelt.

"It's up to you."

Ling Ting wasn't picky about what she ate.

"Good."

The smile at the corners of Ji Zhengyao’s mouth widened, and he started the car with satisfaction.

He took Ling Ting to a Chinese restaurant. After they sat down, he handed the menu over to her.

"Take a look and see what you want."

Ling Ting was an honest child; since Ji Zhengyao told her to look, she looked.

But after just one glance, she returned the menu to Ji Zhengyao.

Every dish on it was ridiculously expensive; she couldn't afford a single table of these with a month’s salary.

"What’s wrong?"

Seeing Ling Ting acting as if the menu had burned her, Ji Zhengyao asked with a smile.

"It’s too expensive."

Ling Ting leaned toward Ji Zhengyao, put her hand to her lips, and whispered.

"Heh."

Ji Zhengyao reached out and patted Ling Ting’s head, thinking she was truly adorable.

"It’s fine, go ahead and order whatever you want. Your boyfriend can afford it."

After saying that, he pushed the menu back to Ling Ting.

Although Ling Ting had been mentally prepared, she still felt uncomfortable hearing the word "boyfriend."

"What, are you stunned?"

Ji Zhengyao took Ling Ting’s hand and rubbed his thumb over her small, mutton-fat jade-like hand.

"Ji..."

Ling Ting instinctively wanted to pull away.

"Don't move."

Ji Zhengyao smiled and held it tighter. "Ling Ting, you are my girlfriend now."

Between a boyfriend and girlfriend, let alone holding hands, even kissing was nothing.

Thinking of that kiss from last time, Ji Zhengyao’s gaze turned heated, and he instinctively looked at Ling Ting’s luscious lips.

Her lips must be very soft, right?

Ling Ting felt completely uncomfortable under Ji Zhengyao’s stare. Shyly, she lowered her head, grabbed the menu, and shoved it into his hands.

"Just order the food; I’m hungry."

Ji Zhengyao: "..."

He was quite hungry too.

chapters.title: Xiaolu is a True Friend
chapters.content:
Ji Zhengyao stopped while he was ahead. Seeing the little girl had quieted down, he didn't tease her further, let her go, and began to order.

After the food was ordered, Ji Zhengyao took a gift box from his side and handed it to Ling Ting.

"What is it?"

Ling Ting blinked, looking at the beautifully wrapped box in her hands.

"It's cosmetics, a gift for you."

Ji Zhengyao had never had a girlfriend before, so he had specifically consulted Li Sheng about gift-giving.

Li Sheng had a fiancée and several girlfriends; he was an experienced veteran.

Li Sheng: "..."

If you don't want to praise me, then don't.

"Director Ji, I can't accept this."

Ling Ting saw the French writing on the cosmetics and could tell at a glance that it was very expensive, so she shook her head and refused.

"Ling Ting, don't refuse me."

Ji Zhengyao pushed the cosmetics back to her. "While you are my girlfriend, you must accept whatever I give you."

His tone allowed for no rebuttal.

"But..."

"Be good."

Reaching out to pat Ling Ting on the head, Ji Zhengyao coaxed her gently.

Ji Zhengyao’s voice was magnetic and pleasant, and that one word made Ling Ting blush uncontrollably.

She lowered her head, her ears turning red, and she forgot to refuse the cosmetics.

Seeing the little girl finally settle down, Ji Zhengyao curled his lips, revealing a pleased smile.

"Next Monday, the bureau is arranging a study tour to City A. You should prepare for it."

After the dishes were served, Ji Zhengyao didn't bother eating himself; he kept putting food into Ling Ting's bowl.

"Go to City A?"

Ling Ting’s eyes widened. "Why me?"

"Why couldn't it be you?"

Ji Zhengyao smiled; two people from each department were going.

"Then can I choose not to go?"

Ling Ting put down her chopsticks and said to Ji Zhengyao with a serious face.

"Why?"

Ji Zhengyao frowned.

Ling Ting lowered her head and didn't explain.

Such activities were called study tours, but in reality, they were just vacations on public funds.

With only one or two people selected from each department, the competition was actually quite fierce.

She was the youngest and least experienced of the four people in the office; such a good opportunity shouldn't fall to her.

Ling Ting didn't want to rely on Ji Zhengyao's connections, so she didn't want to go.

"It’s not up to me; it was decided by your Division Chief Huang."

Ji Zhengyao had been in the bureaucracy for years; even if Ling Ting didn't say it, he could see through her little thoughts.

However, he didn't want to force Ling Ting to do anything, so he decided to leave it to Division Chief Huang to resolve.

Division Chief Huang was cunning and shrewd; he would certainly know what to do.

Just as Ji Zhengyao expected, Ling Ting hit a wall with Division Chief Huang.

He said the list of personnel had been finalized long ago and couldn't be changed for anyone.

Ling Ting walked out of Division Chief Huang's office listlessly, her mouth pouting high.

She always felt that this matter had something to do with Ji Zhengyao.

"Ling Ting, where did you go?"

Sister Wang followed behind Ling Ting, her tone aggressive.

She had seen with her own eyes that Ling Ting had come out of Division Chief Huang's office.

After the events of these past two times, Sister Wang strongly suspected that that old man, Division Chief Huang, had taken a fancy to Ling Ting.

After all, this young girl was pretty and had no schemes.

"Sister Wang, I went to see Division Chief Huang about something."

Ling Ting didn't notice Sister Wang's tone; she sat down at her desk, feeling listless.

"What thing?"

Sister Wang pressed.

"Work matters."

Ling Ting didn't want to talk about it.

"Ling Ting, you're so young, don't go down the wrong path," Sister Wang said, crossing her arms and speaking in a sarcastic tone. "Division Chief Huang is old enough to be your father."

"Sister Wang, what do you mean by that?"

Ling Ting was honest, but that didn't mean she was stupid.

Sister Wang's words were too nasty.

"You know what I mean."

"Even if you’re lacking fatherly love, you don't have to be that desperate."

Sister Wang "humphed."

"Sister Wang, explain yourself clearly."

Ling Ting’s face turned bright red instantly, and she stood up abruptly.

"I’m just reminding you, don't rack your brains to sneak into people's offices just to climb the ladder."

"Shut your damn mouth!"

Xiaolu, dressed in a flashy style, walked in holding a cup of milk tea. Hearing Sister Wang’s words, she cursed directly.

"Xiaolu, don't be a busybody!"

Although Sister Wang was somewhat wary of Xiaolu’s father, she felt this matter had nothing to do with her and didn't back down.

"Sister Wang, how exactly have I offended you?"

Ling Ting was honest, but she didn't want to swallow this insult either.

"You haven't offended me; I just don't like you."

Facing Ling Ting, Sister Wang’s voice grew even louder. "At such a young age, just because you have a bit of looks, you want to seduce..."

"Go to hell!"

Seeing that Ling Ting was so aggrieved she was about to cry, Xiaolu threw the milk tea in her face and rushed forward.

She grabbed Sister Wang’s cheap wavy hair and began shaking her forcefully from side to side.

"Ah! What are you doing?"

Sister Wang and Xiaolu had worked together for two years; although they often bickered, they had never actually come to blows.

Xiaolu was young, only in her twenties, while she was nearly forty. Being grabbed by the hair and shaken violently, she had no ability to fight back.

"Xiaolu?"

Ling Ting was stunned by the scene; she hadn't expected Xiaolu to fight Sister Wang for her sake.

She rushed over, intending to pull Xiaolu away, but thinking that Xiaolu was fighting for her, she immediately pulled her hands back.

"Xiaolu, what are you doing?"

Xiao Liu returned from outside and was also shocked.

However, he reacted quickly; instead of going up to intervene, he turned and ran toward Division Chief Huang’s office.

Division Chief Huang arrived quickly, and one shout made Xiaolu let go.

"This is outrageous! Do you think this is a vegetable market?"

Division Chief Huang pointed at Xiaolu and then glared fiercely at Sister Wang.

Sister Wang was unconvinced. "She went crazy for no reason and started hitting me."

A large clump of her hair had been pulled out by Xiaolu, and there was a bruise on her face.

"Why don't you mention your filthy mouth?"

Xiaolu lifted her chin, looking like a victor.

"I was talking about Ling Ting, what does that have to do with you?"

Sister Wang leaned toward Division Chief Huang, looking aggrieved.

"What did you say?"

Division Chief Huang had originally thought the two had just had a disagreement and that a little criticism would suffice.

But hearing that Sister Wang was targeting Ling Ting, he broke into a cold sweat.

Ling Ting was someone Director Ji had taken an interest in; even he didn't dare to provoke her. Had Wang Meili lost her mind?

"Both of you, get to my office."

Seeing more and more people gathering, Division Chief Huang snorted coldly and turned toward his office.

This matter had to be handled properly, or it might implicate him.

"Fine, let's go."

Xiaolu wasn't afraid of Division Chief Huang at all. She rolled her eyes at Sister Wang and led Ling Ting away.

"Pah!"

Sister Wang spat fiercely on the ground, straightened her hair and clothes, and followed.

To give Ling Ting an explanation, Division Chief Huang scolded Sister Wang severely, made her apologize to Ling Ting, and told her to go home and reflect before returning to work.

As for Xiaolu, he also told her to go home and cool off.

"Xiaolu, I'm sorry."

Coming out of the Division Chief’s office, Ling Ting held Xiaolu’s hand, her face full of embarrassment.

"What are you saying? We’re friends."

Xiaolu didn't care at all, smiling. "Just treat me to dinner tonight."

"I will, and I was planning to buy you a gift."

In Ling Ting’s heart, nothing she bought could make up for what Xiaolu had done for her.

"Alright, alright, I’ll be waiting then."

Xiaolu straightened her messy hair and pulled Ling Ting back to the office.

Division Chief Huang’s handling of the situation was exactly what she wanted; going home was much more comfortable than staying at work.

However, she wanted to eat with Ling Ting, so after Sister Wang left, she lingered in the office.

Ling Ting couldn't bear to keep Xiaolu waiting, so she took the afternoon off and went out with her.

"Xiaolu, shall we go stroll around the commercial street?"

It was still early for dinner, and she wanted to go shopping first.

"Are you really going to buy me a gift?"

Xiaolu waved her hand. "I was just joking with you, you don't need to buy anything."

Ling Ting had just started working and didn't make much money; she didn't want her to spend it.

"Xiaolu, I have to. Not just for you, but for others too..."

chapters.title: Buying a Gift for Ji Zhengyao
chapters.content:
Ji Zhengyao had given her such expensive cosmetics that Ling Ting felt uneasy.

Besides, she still owed him a meal.

Buying a small gift could be considered a way to return the favor.

"Who else are you buying for?"

Xiaolu held Ling Ting’s hand and asked with some curiosity.

Having been a colleague of Ling Ting for over a year, she knew this young girl was very frugal. Not to mention shopping for things, she hadn't even seen her buy many new clothes.

"A friend."

Ling Ting avoided Xiaolu’s gaze and didn't mention Ji Zhengyao’s name.

Although she had somehow ended up as his girlfriend, the agreement was only for three months, so it was better not to talk about it casually.

Xiaolu wasn't the type to pry, so since Ling Ting didn't want to say, she didn't ask. She drove the new car her mother had bought her and headed toward the commercial street.

Once they arrived at the commercial street, the two went straight to the women's clothing department. Xiaolu immediately went into shopping mode and picked out three items in no time.

Ling Ting didn't buy anything. When Xiaolu offered to buy her something, she refused no matter what.

"I'll pay for this dress for you."

Ling Ting pointed at the colorful dress in Xiaolu’s hand, her lips curling up and her eyes curving into crescents as she spoke.

She wanted to give Xiaolu a gift, but she didn't know what to buy.

Since Xiaolu had already decided on that dress, she decided to kill two birds with one stone.

"You really want to buy it for me?"

Xiaolu held the dress’s price tag out in front of Ling Ting. "It’s over five hundred."

Ling Ting nodded obediently. "Buy it."

Xiaolu had stood up for her against Sister Wang, so five hundred wasn't much.

"Alright, if you want to buy it, then let's buy it."

Xiaolu shrugged and stuffed the dress into Ling Ting’s arms.

Ling Ting was introverted; if she didn't let her buy it, she would definitely feel uncomfortable.

At worst, she could just treat her to lunch when they ordered takeout later. They were close, so it didn't really matter.

Xiaolu didn't push back, which made Ling Ting very happy. She hugged the dress and went to pay for it joyfully.

After paying, the two put their things back in the car and went up to the third floor, the men’s accessories section.

"Ling Ting, do you have any idea what you want to buy?"

Seeing Ling Ting looking around like a headless chicken without finding anything she liked after a long time, Xiaolu asked her.

"I don't know either."

Ling Ting shook her head. She had never bought a gift for a man before and didn't know what she should get.

"Just tell me how old the person is."

Xiaolu let out a long sigh; she was truly defeated by Ling Ting.

They had been shopping for ages, and she still had no idea.

"Um... about thirty-something."

She only knew Ji Zhengyao was in his thirties; she had forgotten exactly how old.

Sister Wang seemed to have mentioned it, but she hadn't paid attention.

Ji Zhengyao: "..."

*And here I am, so fond of you.*

"Thirty-something? Does he smoke?"

Xiaolu led Ling Ting back the way they came.

"Should... should be?"

Ling Ting didn't know this either because she had never seen him smoke, but every time Ji Zhengyao got close, she could smell a faint scent of tobacco.

"So you don't know anything at all?"

"You want to give a gift to someone you don't know at all?"

Sometimes, Xiaolu really wanted to open up Ling Ting’s brain to see what, besides kindness, was actually in there.

"He helped me out by chance; we haven't interacted much."

Ling Ting was telling the truth; she and Ji Zhengyao really weren't close.

But...

But they were boyfriend and girlfriend now...

"Fine, since he smokes, let's get him a lighter."

Xiaolu didn't want to ask anymore and made the decision for Ling Ting directly.

Ling Ting nodded, thinking a lighter sounded like a good idea.

But after buying the lighter, she felt a bit of regret.

"Xiaolu, are lighters this expensive nowadays?"

Looking at the beautifully packaged lighter box in her hand, Ling Ting was shocked.

Over six hundred!

That was enough for her to live on for a month.

"You don't know this, but men's lighters and belts are always very expensive."

"Why?"

Ling Ting was puzzled.

"They're symbols of masculinity, just like bags are for women."

Xiaolu reached out and patted Ling Ting on the head. "Girl, open your eyes and look at the world."

If she stayed this sheltered, she’d end up with the same level of awareness as her great-grandmother.

"Oh."

Ling Ting let Xiaolu lecture her, but she still couldn't understand.

Because for so many years, she had only liked carrying canvas bags.

It was past four o'clock when they left the mall. Both of them were tired from walking, so they found a nearby restaurant and went in.

"Xiaolu, what do you want to eat?"

Ling Ting handed the menu over.

She was treating today, so she let Xiaolu order.

"Order whatever, I don't care."

Xiaolu winced, rubbing her sore feet, and waved a hand at Ling Ting.

Seeing Xiaolu rubbing her feet ever since they entered the restaurant, Ling Ting said with concern, "Xiaolu, don't wear such high shoes anymore. You'll develop health problems when you're older."

Her cousin often wore such high shoes, and that’s what her aunt always said.

She said that you don't feel it now because you're only focused on looking beautiful, but when you get old, all the illnesses will come looking for you.

"If I had a figure as well-proportioned as yours, I wouldn't wear them either."

Although Ling Ting was only 1.66 meters tall, her proportions were excellent—she was truly curvy in all the right places, which was enviable.

Xiaolu was only 1.62 meters tall and had a 50/50 body ratio; she felt too embarrassed to go out without high heels.

"Alright, it's not that exaggerated."

Ling Ting didn't think her figure was that good and didn't want to hear Xiaolu compliment her, so she called the waiter and ordered three dishes.

Xiaolu had driven there, so she wasn't drinking. The two ordered two bowls of rice and started eating.

After a few bites, Ling Ting’s phone rang. She took a look, and her face turned red instantly.

She carefully glanced at Xiaolu, made an excuse about going to the restroom, and scurried off.

Once inside the restroom, Ling Ting dared to press the voice message.

[Have you finished work?]

Ji Zhengyao’s magnetic voice rang out.

Ling Ting hesitated for a moment before quickly typing a few words back.

[I'm out eating.]

A voice call came through the next second.

Ling Ting wasn't prepared and was startled by the abrupt notification sound.

She patted her chest, took a deep breath, and pressed the answer button.

"Where are you?"

Ji Zhengyao asked.

"At a restaurant near the commercial street."

Ling Ting replied in a soft, sweet voice.

"With whom?"

"With Xiaolu."

Ling Ting said obediently.

"When will you be done?"

Ji Zhengyao seemed to have just finished work; Ling Ting could hear the sound of him closing his car door.

"It should be a while."

Ling Ting thought she would head back after eating.

"Then go ahead and eat."

Ji Zhengyao’s voice didn't betray any emotion, and he hung up the phone shortly after.

However, before Ling Ting could even walk out of the restroom, a transfer of ten thousand yuan came through.

Ling Ting stared at the transfer amount, her mouth opening little by little. It took her a long time to react, and she hurriedly sent it back.

The money was returned, and Ling Ting’s heart finally settled. She tucked her phone back into her pocket and left the restroom.

But after she sat down, Xiaolu didn't speak for a long time, her eyes fixed in one direction.

Following her gaze, Ling Ting saw a man and a woman sitting in a corner booth.

Both of them were good-looking, the type that could be called a handsome man and a beautiful woman.

They appeared to be a couple, acting intimately; while eating, they even shared a kiss.

It was this kiss that completely ignited Xiaolu’s fury. She threw down her chopsticks, rushed over like lightning, and slapped the man across the face.

"You shameless bastard, cheating on me with another woman—"

chapters.title: Xiaolu’s Combat Power
chapters.content:
Xiaolu was flailing wildly at the man’s face. Not only was the man stunned, but even Ling Ting was bewildered.

“Xiaolu, have you lost your mind?”

After being struck a few times, the man finally snapped out of it and gave Xiaolu a hard shove.

Wearing high heels, Xiaolu lost her balance and fell hard to the ground.

“Why are you hitting people?”

“Xiaolu, are you okay?”

Ling Ting hurried over and struggled to help Xiaolu up.

“Ling Ting, stay back. Today I’m going to ruin this scumbag; he makes me sick.”

Xiaolu pushed Ling Ting aside and, like a female warrior, charged forward again.

“Xiaolu!”

Xiaolu was truly fierce. She slapped the man across the face again and, while she was at it, grabbed the hair of the woman standing nearby.

The woman, caught off guard, stumbled as she was dragged, her head slamming directly into the corner of a table.

Instantly, a scream rang out.

“Ah!”

Ling Ting was terrified. Fearing that Xiaolu would get into serious trouble, she didn’t know where she found the courage, but she ran over in a few steps and pulled her back to a safe area.

“Xiaolu, are you sick in the head?”

“We’re just friends.”

The man hadn’t expected things to escalate to this point. His chest heaved as he touched his face.

His face burned with pain; it had already been scratched into a mess by Xiaolu.

“To hell with ‘just friends.’ Do you take me for a fool?”

Xiaolu wasn’t backing down. She grabbed a beer bottle and threw it at the man.

The bottle shattered at the man’s feet, and the beer inside splashed onto his pant legs.

The man seemed a bit scared now. He grabbed the still-screaming woman and hid in a corner.

“Call the police! Call the police!”

The woman clutched the man’s clothes tightly, wailing miserably.

“Call them! I’m not afraid.”

Xiaolu sneered, pushed Ling Ting away to stand straight, picked up another beer bottle, and shouted at the man, “You ate my food and used my things, and in the end, you cheated on me. I’ll finish you off first, then go to jail.”

With that, she threw beer bottles one after another like grenades.

“You’re a lunatic! You’re just a lunatic!”

The man was driven back step by step by Xiaolu’s assault. He eventually knocked over two customers’ tables, and his face was bleeding.

Ling Ting had originally thought that if Xiaolu were getting the worst of it, she would have to step in to help, but seeing this scene, she abandoned that idea instantly.

She secretly took out her phone and called her cousin.

Xiaolu had injured someone; she had to find someone to help.

Xiaolu’s combat power was truly no joke.

Just as she had said, she beat the man up badly, and then they ended up at the police station...

“Xiaolu, are you okay?”

Sitting on a bench in the police station, Ling Ting looked at Xiaolu’s simply bandaged foot and asked in a low voice.

This girl was just too fierce. By the end of the fight, she felt her high heels were hindering her combat, so she had simply kicked them off and thrown them away.

Her foot hadn’t been injured by the man at all, but rather by stepping on broken glass by accident.

Xiaolu, who had been dozing off, opened her eyes when she heard Ling Ting, looked at her, and shook her head indifferently. “I’m fine.”

Seeing that Ling Ting’s face was pale, Xiaolu leaned close to her ear and asked in a low voice, “Are you scared out of your wits?”

Ling Ting had an introverted and timid personality, unlike her, who had seen it all.

Back in middle school, because she came from a well-off family, she was bullied by a school thug. She had nearly cracked the kid’s skull open.

Even then, her mother had praised her, saying she did a good job.

“No.”

Ling Ting shook her head, helped Xiaolu lean back, and comforted her gently, “Don’t be afraid, I’ve already called my cousin.”

Xiaolu’s mother was abroad, and her father was on a business trip; there was no one to bail her out.

She had indeed been terrified by the scene earlier, but she felt much better now. At the very least, her hands had stopped shaking.

“Ling Ting!”

Lin Wei walked in wearing a professional suit, carrying a briefcase, and exuding an air of authority.

“Cousin.”

Ling Ting stood up, walked over to Lin Wei, and sniffled, feeling aggrieved.

“What happened?”

Lin Wei glanced at Xiaolu and pulled Ling Ting to the side.

“It’s her boyfriend’s fault. Xiaolu is a good person.”

Fearing her cousin would misunderstand Xiaolu, Ling Ting hurriedly explained on her behalf.

Xiaolu’s outfit was flamboyant, and at the moment, her hair was a mess and she looked completely disheveled; Lin Wei really couldn’t see what was “good” about her.

However, her cousin wasn’t a bad kid, and Lin Wei trusted her friend. Seeing that she was alright, she went over to ask a few brief questions before going to handle the paperwork.

Lin Wei was a lawyer, so these procedures weren’t difficult for her. Before long, after paying the fine, she prepared to take Ling Ting and Xiaolu away.

“Xiaolu.”

Xiaolu’s boyfriend stood up in a panic.

He looked at Xiaolu with pleading eyes, his face covered in scratches.

In this city, his only support was Xiaolu. That new girlfriend of his was not loyal at all; she had run off before the police even arrived.

Xiaolu let out a breath, walked slowly up to him, smiled maliciously, and kicked him right in the crotch.

“Go to hell.”

“Ouch!”

“What are you doing?”

“Run!”

When Xiaolu walked over, Lin Wei had guessed what she wanted to do. Seeing the police coming out, she grabbed her and ran.

They had to run; if they were caught, all the previous paperwork would have been for nothing.

Ling Ting watched the two of them running fast in high heels, shook her head, and was filled with admiration.

That was some high-level skill.

Lin Wei had several cases on her hands and was very busy lately. After taking the two out of the police station, she told Ling Ting to go home early and left in a hurry.

Ling Ting took Xiaolu to a clinic to have her wounds re-bandaged, dropped her off, and made sure there was a nanny at home to take care of her before taking the subway home.

Don’t ask why she didn’t take a taxi; she had spent a lot of money today, and her heart ached.

The distance was too far, and a taxi would be too expensive; she wouldn’t make it home for less than fifty or sixty yuan.

“Why are you back so late?”

Ji Zhengyao was waiting at the entrance of the residential complex. Seeing Ling Ting finally return, his expression was grim.

A girl, out until the middle of the night.

“Director Ji?”

Ling Ting hadn’t expected Ji Zhengyao to be waiting for her so late.

She looked at him pleadingly, not knowing how to explain.

It was probably best not to mention the police station.

“Where’s your phone?”

Ji Zhengyao had no idea that Ling Ting had spent half the night at the police station. He reached out his hand toward her.

Ling Ting didn’t understand why, but she obediently took out her phone.

Ji Zhengyao took the phone and saw that it was dead and powered off; his expression finally softened a little.

“I didn’t notice.”

Ling Ting hung her head, like a child who had done something wrong.

Looking at the top of the little girl’s head, Ji Zhengyao sighed; in the end, he couldn’t bring himself to be harsh.

She was such an obedient little girl that he couldn’t bear to scold her.

“Let’s go.”

Taking the canvas bag from Ling Ting’s shoulder, Ji Zhengyao took her hand.

Ling Ting blinked and struggled uncomfortably.

“Don’t move. I’m very angry today.”

He had been waiting here since he got off work, for several hours already.

No one knew how anxious he had been when he couldn’t get through to her phone.

Several times, he had almost called the police.

Hearing the stern tone in Ji Zhengyao’s voice, Ling Ting stopped struggling and slowly relaxed.

“Good girl.”

Ji Zhengyao was pleased by Ling Ting’s docility. He reached out and pinched the little girl’s ear, then led her upstairs.

chapters.title: Entering the Inner Chamber
chapters.content:
Ling Ting was pulled along by Ji Zhengyao, and by the time they reached the second floor, she was so dazed that she only realized where they were when they arrived at the door.

"Director Ji, are you going in?"

"What do you think?"

Ji Zhengyao sighed in exasperation and started rummaging through her bag. "Where's the key?"

"It's in the small compartment inside."

Ling Ting leaned over to help, but Ji Zhengyao dodged her.

He felt around in the small compartment and inadvertently touched something square.

Ji Zhengyao's eyebrows twitched almost imperceptibly. After a long moment, he took out the key.

He inserted the key, which had a plush toy attached, into the lock, turned it three times, and opened the door.

Ji Zhengyao went in first, felt around the wall beside him, and with a *click*, the room lit up.

Ling Ting's home was small. Ji Zhengyao estimated that the entire living room was barely larger than his bathroom.

But it was clean and tidy, with a faint, pleasant scent of flowers and plants.

Just like Ling Ting herself, it made people feel very comfortable.

"Director Ji, please make yourself at home."

Ling Ting followed Ji Zhengyao inside, changed into her white cartoon slippers, and pointed to the small sofa that could only seat two people before heading toward the kitchen.

Ji Zhengyao had intended to find a pair of slippers to change into, since the girl's place was so clean.

But after searching for a long time, all he found in the shoe cabinet were a few pairs of small white shoes—nothing that would fit him.

This was the second thing Ji Zhengyao was satisfied with about Ling Ting's home.

From her shoe cabinet, he could confirm that she and that Qin Nan were completely over.

A flicker of joy passed through his eyes, and Ji Zhengyao casually closed the shoe cabinet door.

He slowly walked around the room, stole a photo of her at five or six years old, laughing so hard her eyes disappeared, and then sat down on the sofa covered with a cream-colored slipcover.

Hmm, just the right softness. He liked it.

"Director Ji, have some water."

Ling Ting rarely drank beverages and lived frugally, so all she had at home was water.

"You sit too."

Ji Zhengyao took the glass and, seeing Ling Ting standing properly like a primary school student waiting for a scolding, patted the space beside him.

Ling Ting didn’t move. She glanced at the small sofa, which didn’t have much space left.

Ji Zhengyao was tall with long legs. Leaning back casually, he took up more than half the sofa.

Ling Ting was a simple person; all her emotions were written on her face. With just one look, Ji Zhengyao guessed what she was thinking.

With a mischievous raise of his eyebrow, Ji Zhengyao set down his glass and suddenly pulled her toward him.

"Ah!"

Caught off guard, Ling Ting tumbled straight into Ji Zhengyao’s arms.

Startled, her face flushed red, and she panicked, trying to get up.

"Mmm."

Ji Zhengyao groaned, his expression shifting as he pressed her down.

"Damn it!"

Feeling the change in his body, sweat instantly broke out on his forehead.

In her struggle, Ling Ting had bumped into a certain important area.

"Director Ji, I'm so sorry!"

Ling Ting, unaware of the trouble she caused, thought she had hurt him and quickly apologized.

"Don’t move."

Ji Zhengyao gritted his teeth, tightened his arm around Ling Ting’s waist, and tried to regulate his breathing, afraid of scaring her.

His desires were strong. Even when he took care of himself, it took a long time. Now, with the person he liked in his arms, it was truly torturing him.

He was starting to regret his little prank.

Wasn’t this just asking for trouble?

"Director Ji?"

Ling Ting, still awkwardly draped over Ji Zhengyao, called out when he didn’t move for a long time.

"Shh."

Ji Zhengyao pressed a finger to Ling Ting’s lips, slowly adjusted his breathing, and after a long while, reluctantly set her down on the sofa.

"Director Ji, are you okay?"

Ji Zhengyao’s face was flushed, and a thin layer of sweat had formed on his forehead. He looked extremely uncomfortable.

"I'm fine."

His voice was hoarse and dry.

Ling Ting hesitated, then quickly handed him the glass of water from the table.

Ji Zhengyao looked at the glass, then at the worried little girl, sighed, and took it.

He downed the water in one gulp, then fell silent for a long time before asking Ling Ting in a low voice, "Ling Ting, are you afraid of me?"

Even though he had tricked the little girl into being his girlfriend, Ji Zhengyao knew she hadn’t truly accepted him in her heart.

His behavior just now must have been frightening.

"No... not afraid."

Ling Ting looked into Ji Zhengyao’s deep, unfathomable eyes, and her heart suddenly skipped a beat.

"Then can I have a hug?"

He took a light breath, the faint floral scent on her captivating him.

"This..."

Ling Ting’s cheeks turned pink, and she looked uneasy.

"Just for a moment."

Before Ling Ting could respond, Ji Zhengyao leaned over and pulled her into his arms.

"Ling Ting, don’t reject my kindness, okay?"

Ji Zhengyao gently stroked her smooth, soft hair, his voice careful.

"And don’t refuse the gifts I give you or the red envelopes I send, okay?"

God knew how agitated he had been when she returned his money.

He was more than willing to spend on his woman.

"I kept the gift, but I can’t take the money."

Ling Ting shook her head, her voice soft in refusal.

She had her own salary and couldn’t just spend Ji Zhengyao’s money.

Besides, they were only together for three months, and they would have to separate in the future. Too much financial entanglement wouldn’t be good.

Thinking of the gift, Ling Ting’s eyes lit up. She pushed Ji Zhengyao away and quickly rummaged through her bag.

Seeing the little girl digging around in her canvas bag, even dumping everything out, Ji Zhengyao raised an eyebrow, unable to suppress the smile at the corner of his mouth.

"Here, this is the gift I got for you."

Ling Ting finally found the box and presented it to Ji Zhengyao like a treasure.

Her eyes were clear as water, sparkling with starlight.

"For me?"

Ji Zhengyao’s lips slowly curled up. "What is it?"

"It’s a lighter."

Ling Ting opened the box, revealing a silver tank-style lighter.

"Does it look nice?"

She tilted her head and smiled playfully.

"Mmm."

Ji Zhengyao nodded and took the lighter.

He liked it.

More than any of his prized lighters.

"I picked it out for a long time."

Hearing that Ji Zhengyao liked it, Ling Ting let out a sigh of relief.

She had felt uneasy taking his gift, but now that she had given him one in return, she felt much better.

Ji Zhengyao was so absorbed in playing with the lighter that he didn’t notice the relief on Ling Ting’s face.

He gently flicked the wheel, and in an instant, a blue flame ignited.

"Thank you."

By the light of the lighter, Ji Zhengyao looked at the impossibly beautiful Ling Ting in front of him, then suddenly leaned in and planted a kiss on her lips.

Ling Ting hadn’t expected Ji Zhengyao to kiss her again. Her body stiffened, and her blood rushed to her head. With a jolt, she suddenly stood up.

"Director Ji, it’s too late. You should go."

Ling Ting’s face was flushed, and her whole body felt like it was on fire.

She rushed into the kitchen, clattering around, and after a long while, hurried toward her bedroom.

She slammed the door shut with great force, and inside, there was a series of loud noises.

Ji Zhengyao: "..."

What was wrong with this little girl? She just ran around in a panic whenever she got nervous.

No matter what was wrong with Ling Ting, once she went into her room, she didn’t come out again.

Ji Zhengyao tried coaxing her, persuading her, but the little girl kept the door firmly shut.

Director Ji had no choice but to shake his head in defeat and leave, disappointed.

But the trip hadn’t been in vain. Looking at the lighter in his hand, Ji Zhengyao smiled broadly.

chapters.title: Call Me by My Name
chapters.content:
After hearing the door close, Ling Ting waited a while longer before coming out of her room.

Seeing that Ji Zhengyao was no longer in the living room, her tense nerves finally relaxed, and the heat on her face gradually faded away.

She had been so nervous just now; it felt like she had made a fool of herself again.

Ling Ting covered her face. Would Ji Zhengyao think she had a mental illness?

Ji Zhengyao was very understanding and didn't think there was anything wrong with Ling Ting.

The next morning, he sent a message saying he had to go on a business trip on short notice, without mentioning a single word about what happened the previous night.

Ling Ting was relieved; not having to see Ji Zhengyao for a few days would give her some time to recover.

Without Ji Zhengyao’s occasional appearances, Ling Ting felt time flew by. In the blink of an eye, the day for the study tour to City A arrived.

Before leaving, Ling Ting went to visit Qiaoyin. Her hand had healed, and she was sitting in front of the computer, processing after-sales information.

Ling Ting helped her pack some packages that needed to be sent out that afternoon. After the two had a meal together, Ling Ting went to Xiaolu’s place.

There was no helping it; both friends were currently "patients," and she couldn't favor one over the other.

Xiaolu’s father’s secretary had already visited and handled everything for her; all the things that the scumbag had taken from her had been returned in full.

Having been lying at home for the past two days, Xiaolu had been feeling stifled. She was especially happy to see Ling Ting. The two chatted for a long time, and it wasn't until dusk that she let Ling Ting leave.

After returning home, Ling Ting packed her luggage simply and called her aunt.

Her aunt had been gone for two weeks, and other than updates on her social media, there had been no news.

Ling Ting was worried about her and had sent several messages, but they had all disappeared into the void.

Fortunately, this time, her aunt answered the phone.

"Ling Ting, this trip has been worth it for your aunt. I ran into an old classmate I haven't seen in over thirty years."

Tian Rong was very excited and couldn't wait to share this joy with Ling Ting.

"Aunt, when are you coming back?"

After all, her aunt had undergone major surgery, and Ling Ting was worried about her health.

"I won't be back for a while; we are on our way to Lijiang."

It was noisy on her aunt's end, and her speech was intermittent. It took Ling Ting a long time to make out what she was saying.

"Aunt, why are you going so far? Is it safe?"

In the past, her aunt always traveled with tour groups. Going with an old classmate she hadn't seen in thirty years seemed unreliable no matter how she looked at it.

"It's fine, it's fine. Ling Ting, I have things to do here, I'm hanging up now. Don't worry."

Whether it was because she was afraid of Ling Ting’s nagging or she really was busy, her aunt hung up before Ling Ting could finish her sentence.

Listening to the dial tone, Ling Ting frowned and sent a message to her cousin.

Her cousin was very busy and wouldn't be able to reply for a while. Ling Ting didn't want to wait around aimlessly, so she stood up and walked toward the bathroom.

She had to get up early tomorrow, so she might as well take a shower and go to bed.

Ling Ting was slow-paced; it was already ten o'clock by the time she finished showering.

She glanced at her phone; her cousin still hadn't replied. Ling Ting got into bed, ready to sleep.

But just as she lay down, her phone screen lit up. Thinking it was her cousin, she picked it up, only to see it was Ji Zhengyao.

[Are you asleep?]

[Not yet.]

Since Ji Zhengyao was on a business trip, Ling Ting’s reply speed was much faster.

[Answer the video call.]

Almost as soon as Ling Ting sent her message, Ji Zhengyao replied. Before she could react, the video call ringtone started playing.

Ling Ting felt a bit nervous and sat up straight unconsciously.

She looked down at her pajamas and adjusted her pillow. After deciding there was nothing amiss, she accepted Ji Zhengyao’s video call.

"Ling Ting."

Seeing Ling Ting with her hair down, wearing seersucker pajamas, Ji Zhengyao couldn't help but curl his lips into a smile.

The little girl was so fresh and lovely; her little face looked tender enough to pinch water out of.

"Director Ji."

Ling Ting moved the phone slightly to the side, feeling a bit embarrassed by his smile.

Her face was burning, and she was afraid Ji Zhengyao would notice.

"Have you packed everything?"

"We’re meeting at the office entrance at seven tomorrow morning. Don't be late."

"Do you need to set an alarm?"

Ji Zhengyao knew the little girl was shy during their first video call, so he didn't force her to face the camera. Instead, he acted like a mother hen, asking about every little detail.

"Everything is packed, and I've set the alarm. I won't be late."

Ling Ting had a gentle temperament; she didn't feel impatient with Ji Zhengyao’s nagging and answered every question.

"City A is by the sea; the temperature is lower than here. Remember to bring a jacket."

Ji Zhengyao was very satisfied with Ling Ting’s docility and smiled as he continued to instruct her.

"I'll remember."

Her voice was soft, almost like she was acting spoiled.

Ji Zhengyao had already been missing Ling Ting, and hearing her obedient reply made his heart flutter.

He wanted to go with her.

"Ling Ting."

Ji Zhengyao sighed and leaned closer to the phone.

"Hmm?"

Ling Ting thought Ji Zhengyao had something else to tell her, so she responded.

But after waiting for a long time, he didn't continue. Ling Ting looked at him curiously.

"I want to hear you call me by my name."

Ji Zhengyao’s voice was hoarse, his breathing heavy.

Ling Ting’s heart trembled, and she lowered her head involuntarily.

"Director Ji..."

"We are boyfriend and girlfriend now. Can't you call me by my name?"

Ji Zhengyao’s tone carried a sense of loss as he coaxed her, "It’s true that I am a director, but shouldn't a girlfriend call me by my name?"

"I..."

Ling Ting was left speechless by Ji Zhengyao.

She knew she should call him by his name, but for some reason, she just couldn't bring herself to say it.

There was a faint sense of shyness.

"Be good, just say it once~"

Director Ji started acting spoiled.

He looked just like a child wanting a piece of candy.

Ling Ting’s eyes widened in shock, and she instinctively covered her pounding heart.

This Ji Zhengyao was too good at this.

He was teasing her until her face was flushed and her heart was racing.

On the surface, Ji Zhengyao appeared easygoing, humble, and polite.

But through getting to know him over this period, Ling Ting felt that besides that, he seemed to have another side.

He could act spoiled, he could get angry, and he changed his face faster than turning a page.

Acting spoiled—she wasn't even very good at that herself.

"Will you?"

Ji Zhengyao continued, acting as if he wouldn't hang up until he heard Ling Ting change how she addressed him.

Ling Ting kept her head down, tugging at the hem of her pajamas. After struggling for a long time, she finally whispered like a mosquito, "Ji Zhengyao~"

It was soft, sweet, and captivating.

That one call, using his full name, broke through the defenses of the cold-hearted, smiling tiger.

Ji Zhengyao stood up abruptly from his hotel bed, paced around the room several times, and finally took a few deep breaths to calm himself down.

He had almost run back overnight.

But the distance was too great; even if he drove fast, he probably wouldn't arrive until the middle of the night.

Ling Ting was leaving at seven tomorrow morning, and his return would definitely affect her sleep.

Besides, he had a meeting tomorrow that he couldn't miss.

After weighing the pros and cons of going back, reason finally prevailed.

Ji Zhengyao sat down slowly.

"Good girl, say it again."

Ji Zhengyao hadn't heard enough and coaxed Ling Ting to call him again.

"No."

Ling Ting was blushing furiously; she couldn't bring herself to say it again.

"Be a good girl."

Ji Zhengyao tried to use sweet talk to get Ling Ting to comply.

"Ji Zhengyao!"

Pushed by him, Ling Ting felt a bit angry and pouted as she shouted in defiance.

"Heh."

Ji Zhengyao laughed, not the usual hypocritical fake smile.

It was so sincere that even he didn't notice it.

"Alright, I won't force you."

Ji Zhengyao leaned close to the phone and suddenly kissed the screen.

With a "mwah" sound, he gave Ling Ting a start.

Ling Ting: "..."

She decisively hung up the phone.

chapters.title: Director Ji is Angry
chapters.content:
Ling Ting hadn't slept well the night before, teased by Ji Zhengyao, so she didn't get up until her alarm had gone off twice the next morning.

She tidied up briefly and, without even having time for breakfast, rushed to her workplace.

When she arrived at the entrance, a crowd had already gathered. Not long after she waited, the bus arrived.

"Little Ling, come, come, sit here."

Division Chief Huang was the first to board. He pointed to a seat in the first row and spoke to Ling Ting with a pleasant expression.

"No, thank you, Division Chief Huang. I'll go sit in the back."

Ling Ting shook her head and hurriedly declined; she didn't want to sit with Division Chief Huang.

She wouldn't know what to say; it would be too awkward.

"I’ve arranged to play cards with Deputy Division Chief Liu, so you take the seat."

Division Chief Huang seemed to guess what Ling Ting was thinking. He said this with a chuckle and walked toward the back.

For Ling Ting's sake, Ji Zhengyao had specifically called him that morning, hinting throughout the conversation that he should take care of her. How could Division Chief Huang not take it to heart?

This Ling Ting might just be a stepping stone on his path to success; he had to maintain a good relationship with her.

Seeing Division Chief Huang leave, Ling Ting breathed a sigh of relief. She greeted a colleague nearby and placed her bag on the luggage rack.

"Hmph!"

But just as she put her things away, before she could even sit down, a familiar voice rang in her ear.

She looked up, and it was actually Sister Wang!

Sister Wang was wearing a very eye-catching red dress with a low neckline, half-exposing her breasts.

She lifted her chin provocatively at Ling Ting, wearing the expression of a victor.

Ling Ting frowned imperceptibly, her face full of confusion.

For this study tour, it had clearly been decided that she and Little Liu would go. Why was Sister Wang here?

Xiao Lu was still at home reflecting on her mistakes, yet Sister Wang was able to go on the study tour. Ling Ting felt uncomfortable.

Ling Ting, who was always good-tempered, felt a bit angry.

"Ding-ling."

Her phone chimed; Ji Zhengyao had sent a message.

[Sweetheart, are you on the bus?]

Ji Zhengyao didn't know how to dote on Ling Ting enough, so he had specially given her a sweet pet name.

If it were before, Ling Ting would have blushed and felt her heart race upon seeing such a name, too shy to know how to reply.

But at this moment, feeling wronged, she replied to Ji Zhengyao without thinking.

[I don't want to go anymore.]

[Why?]

Ji Zhengyao sent a question mark; the message was returned in seconds.

[Sweetheart, tell me.]

Ji Zhengyao sent another one.

But Ling Ting was already so angry at Sister Wang that she was on the verge of tears and didn't even look at her phone again.

Ji Zhengyao stood in front of the conference room door with his hands on his hips, his usually gentle and elegant handsome face as gloomy as water.

He was very worried about the little girl; he didn't know why she suddenly said she didn't want to go to City A anymore.

Had something happened?

He sent a few more messages, but there was still no reply from her side.

"Director Ji, the meeting is about to start."

Secretary Yao checked the time and walked over to Ji Zhengyao, urging him in a low voice.

"Right away."

He raised a hand to signal Secretary Yao to wait a moment, then pulled up Division Chief Huang's number and called him directly.

Division Chief Huang was chatting with Deputy Division Chief Liu when he suddenly received a call from Ji Zhengyao. His heart skipped a beat.

Director Ji calling at this time gave him a bad premonition.

Division Chief Huang's intuition was accurate; something had indeed gone wrong.

Ji Zhengyao's tone was very poor, and he asked straightforwardly what had happened on the bus.

Division Chief Huang looked at his colleagues who were chatting and laughing, and for a moment, he didn't know how to answer.

Just as he was burning with anxiety and about to stand up to go to the front to ask Ling Ting, he suddenly saw Sister Wang.

Division Chief Huang cursed under his breath, said he would handle it immediately, and called her outside.

"Who the hell told you to come?"

Division Chief Huang led Sister Wang to a secluded spot and roared in a suppressed voice.

He stared fixedly at Sister Wang, wishing he could slap her.

"What's wrong?"

Sister Wang was frightened by the distorted look on Division Chief Huang's face. She shrank her shoulders and said aggrievedly, "Why are you yelling at me?"

The two had reconciled, and they had even slept in the same bed last night; she thought Division Chief Huang was no longer angry.

"Why am I yelling at you?"

Division Chief Huang sneered. "Were you on the list for this study tour?"

"I..."

Sister Wang looked embarrassed. "Little Liu had something come up at the last minute and couldn't go, so I'm filling in for him."

In reality, she had sought out Little Liu and used both soft and hard tactics to get the spot.

Because Division Chief Huang treated Ling Ting differently, Sister Wang felt a sense of crisis.

She was eager to spend time alone with Division Chief Huang to cultivate their relationship, and this trip to City A was a perfect opportunity.
