She wasn't good at much else, but she was very confident in her skills in bed. As long as she spent a few days alone with Division Chief Huang, she was sure she could win him back.

"Enough nonsense. Get back on the bus, grab your things, and get the hell home."

Division Chief Huang's face was livid. He didn't want to hear Sister Wang's excuses. He pointed at her and issued a warning.

The study tour he had meticulously prepared had almost been ruined by this woman.

Sister Wang was unconvinced and just about to say something, but Division Chief Huang delivered a harsh ultimatum: "If you still want your job, keep your mouth shut."

After saying this, he strode away.

Sister Wang's arrival had made Ling Ting, who was originally excited, want to back out. But just as she was hesitating whether to get off the bus and give the opportunity to someone else, she saw Sister Wang leave with her bag.

She looked dejected, like an eggplant hit by frost.

Ling Ting: "..."

What was going on?

Ling Ting blinked, her small face filled with disbelief.

However, before she could figure it out, the bus started and sped toward City A.

Sister Wang's departure made Ling Ting feel much more at ease, and in her happiness, she finally had the mood to reply to Ji Zhengyao's messages.

[I've already set off.]

Heaven knows how happy Ji Zhengyao was to receive this message from Ling Ting while he was in the middle of a meeting.

He had always been diligent at work, but this was the first time he had been distracted by his phone during a meeting.

But Ling Ting didn't know any of this, because after she sent the message, she drifted off to sleep.

When she opened her eyes again, it was three hours later, and Ji Zhengyao's messages had flooded her screen.

[I was in a meeting just now, my phone was on silent.]

[The meeting is over now.]

[Where are you?]

[Did you fall asleep?]

Ling Ting rubbed her eyes and leaned against the window to look outside. Seeing the road signs for City A, she curved her lips into a smile.

[Yes, I've already entered the territory of City A.]

She could already smell the salty scent of the sea.

[Sweetheart, what happened earlier?]

Division Chief Huang was still on the bus. Although he had called him to say the matter was handled, he had been vague and hadn't gone into detail.

Ji Zhengyao was very worried about Ling Ting.

[Nothing, I just saw someone I dislike.]

Thinking of Sister Wang, Ling Ting pouted.

Thinking that she would have to share an office with her when she returned, Ling Ting's mood, which had just improved, began to sink again.

[Who is it?]

Ji Zhengyao pressed.

He really wanted to know who had upset his little sweetheart.

[No one.]

Ling Ting didn't want to say.

She didn't want to burden Ji Zhengyao with her troubles.

Across the phone, Ji Zhengyao's face darkened.

The little girl didn't treat him as one of her own.

But that was fine; he could investigate it himself.

chapters.title: Travel-Worn
chapters.content:
Ling Ting was simple-minded and unaware that her words had prompted Ji Zhengyao to consider investigating those around her. Once they crossed the bridge, she excitedly took out her phone.

The ocean! She saw the ocean!

Extending her phone out the window, she recorded a short video and sent it directly to Ji Zhengyao.

In the past, she would have shared this joy with her cousin and Qiaoyin first. Now, Ji Zhengyao had become the first person she wanted to share things with.

Ji Zhengyao was on his way back to the hotel, having just instructed Secretary Yao to look into who had upset Ling Ting, when he suddenly received the video. He was pleasantly surprised.

The little girl had finally wised up and knew how to take the initiative to message him.

He watched the video over and over, his stern face slowly thawing.

Secretary Yao, who had been holding his breath, kept his eyes fixed on his own nose, maintaining a stoic composure...

Love makes people unpredictable.

When would their elegant and domineering Bureau Chief Ji ever return to normal?

Ling Ting didn't know what Ji Zhengyao was like; at this moment, her eyes were shining with excitement.

The organization hosting this visit was truly impressive; the hotel they arranged was located not far from the beach.

Opening the window, she could hear the sound of the waves.

She leaned against the window, watching the few seagulls flying by, and all her gloomy feelings were cast to the back of her mind.

"Ling Ting, they're calling for dinner in the group chat. Are you ready?"

Ling Ting was sharing a room with a girl from the office next door named Wen Meimei. Although they were only nodding acquaintances, it didn't feel awkward.

"Let's go."

Ling Ting smiled at Wen Meimei, grabbed her room card, and headed to the restaurant with her.

The restaurant was on the third floor. By the time Ling Ting and Wen Meimei arrived, many people were already eating.

"Ling Ting, sit here."

Ling Ting was beautiful, and Section Chief Huang was afraid of misunderstandings, so he didn't dare to interact with her too much, only instructing his secretary, Xiao Gao, to take good care of her.

Xiao Gao was a tall, refined-looking boy who had been hired in the same batch as Ling Ting. It was said that his family background was very good.

Although Ling Ting wasn't close to him, since he had invited her, she just smiled and sat down.

However, Wen Meimei stopped in her tracks, glared fiercely at Xiao Gao, and went to sit at the next table.

Ling Ting: "..."

Confused, Ling Ting looked at Xiao Gao.

Xiao Gao’s expression was very poor; if there hadn't been so many people in the restaurant, he probably wouldn't have been able to maintain even a basic facade.

He gripped his chopsticks so tightly that his knuckles turned white. Ling Ting was worried he might lose his temper in public.

Ling Ting sat there awkwardly, unsure whether to eat or leave.

Fortunately, Xiao Gao was still rational. After fuming for a while, he began to eat voraciously.

He devoured his food as if he had a grudge against it.

Although Ling Ting was still a bit worried, she began to eat in small bites. She had no choice; she hadn't eaten breakfast and was already hungry.

After finally finishing lunch, seeing that Wen Meimei was chatting happily with others, Ling Ting told her and returned to her room.

She had been in the car all morning and was a bit tired.

When Wen Meimei returned, it was almost four o'clock. Her expression had returned to normal, and she asked Ling Ting with a smile if she wanted to go to the food street.

Ling Ting had rested enough, so she thought for a moment and agreed.

Since the afternoon was free time, going for a stroll was fine. If it was good, she could just have dinner out.

Because it wasn't far, Ling Ting and Wen Meimei didn't take a car, walking and chatting all the way there.

But just as they arrived at the food street, Xiao Gao followed them, grabbed Wen Meimei, and asked her what she meant by her behavior.

Wen Meimei was a fiery person; without a word, she slapped Xiao Gao across the face.

The sound of the slap was loud, startling Ling Ting.

Xiao Gao seemed used to it; even after being slapped, he didn't let go, insisting on talking to Wen Meimei.

"You two, talk it out properly, don't use your hands."

Seeing a crowd gathering in just a short while, Ling Ting thought for a moment and stepped in to mediate.

"Ling Ting is right. Let's settle this once and for all," Xiao Gao said to Wen Meimei, his eyes red.

Wen Meimei’s chest heaved for a while, and as if she had made a decision, she looked at Ling Ting.

"I'm sorry, Ling Ting. Could you go look around by yourself for a while?"

Since she was the one who suggested the outing, Wen Meimei felt a bit embarrassed.

"It's fine, it's fine. I'll head back on my own when I'm tired of walking."

Ling Ting was now eager for them to leave quickly.

Wen Meimei nodded and left with Xiao Gao.

Watching their retreating figures, Ling Ting let out a long breath and wiped the cold sweat from her forehead.

She was timid and her heart would tremble whenever she saw people arguing.

After Wen Meimei and Xiao Gao left, Ling Ting bought a serving of local stir-fried noodles and continued to stroll after eating.

When she got tired, she found a corner to sit for a while, bought some snacks, and kept eating.

Just like that, Ling Ting walked and ate all the way. By the time she finally felt a chill, it was almost dark.

Ling Ting hugged her arms and rubbed them, shivering involuntarily. She decided to head back to the hotel.

"Ling Ting."

Ling Ting was jogging back to the hotel when she heard someone call her just as she reached the steps.

Turning her head, she saw Ji Zhengyao leaning against his car, a faint smile on his face, looking travel-worn.

"Bureau Chief Ji, why are you here?"

Ling Ting blinked, glanced cautiously toward the hotel, and walked toward Ji Zhengyao.

"Can't I come?"

Seeing that Ling Ting was only wearing a dress and her face was red from the cold, Ji Zhengyao took off his coat and wrapped it around her.

Ling Ting was held by Ji Zhengyao, his warm scent instantly surrounding her, and a blush crept onto her cheeks.

"Didn't I tell you to bring a coat?"

Ji Zhengyao reached out to tidy her hair, which had been blown messy by the wind, looking a bit annoyed.

This little girl looked soft, but she was not obedient at all.

"I forgot."

Ling Ting lowered her head, her voice soft.

It was mid-summer, so she really hadn't expected it to be this cold.

"Hmph!"

Ji Zhengyao pinched her little face in annoyance and pulled her into the car.

"Bureau Chief Ji, where are we going?"

After getting in, Ling Ting blinked her bright almond-shaped eyes and asked softly.

"To find somewhere to eat."

Ji Zhengyao fastened her seatbelt.

"I'm already full," Ling Ting said instinctively.

Having eaten several snacks in one go, she wasn't hungry at all.

"I haven't eaten yet."

Ji Zhengyao turned to look at Ling Ting. "I drove for six hours just to come see you sooner."

After saying this, he reached out and pinched her ear, his eyes filled with grievance.

He could have come tomorrow, but he really couldn't wait.

The little girl was angry for no reason, which made him restless.

Ling Ting was speechless and smiled embarrassedly. "Then what do you want to eat?"

"Let's have hot pot."

Ji Zhengyao started the car.

Although he could eat anything, the little girl seemed quite cold, so hot pot would warm her up.

Ling Ting nodded. She was fine with whatever Ji Zhengyao wanted to eat; as long as he didn't get handsy, she would support him even if he wanted to eat an elephant.

Ji Zhengyao: "..."

chapters.title: Feeding Shrimp
chapters.content:
Ji Zhengyao had been in meetings all morning and hadn't eaten lunch in his rush to travel, so he was indeed hungry.

However, no matter how hungry he was, he still took great care of Ling Ting, constantly piling food onto her plate for fear that she would be too shy to eat.

"Thank you."

Ling Ting looked at the small mountain of vegetables and meat on her plate and felt a mix of amusement and helplessness.

Was he trying to feed her like a pig?

"What's wrong?"

Ji Zhengyao held a peeled shrimp to Ling Ting's lips and asked with a smile.

Ling Ting had been feeling quite relaxed, but seeing the shrimp right at her lips, her face flushed red in an instant.

She shook her head in a panic and tried to lean away.

"Be good, open your mouth. Ah."

Ji Zhengyao moved his hand forward, his expression calm, and tilted his chin at Ling Ting.

Ling Ting didn't really want to eat it, but since Ji Zhengyao kept holding it there, she had no choice but to open her mouth and take it.

However, she was so nervous that she accidentally bit Ji Zhengyao’s finger.

A tingling sensation shot through Ji Zhengyao’s fingertips, an electric current surging straight to his brain, and he instantly lost his previous composure.

He stared straight at Ling Ting’s flushed face, suddenly leaned over, and planted a quick kiss on her ear.

*Thump.*

Ling Ting’s heart raced, her cheeks burned, and her ears turned even redder than the shrimp she had just eaten.

She blinked rapidly in shyness, her hands feeling awkward and unconsciously twisting together.

"Heh."

Ji Zhengyao loved Ling Ting’s shy little appearance and teased, "We’re a couple; things like this are perfectly normal."

"Stop it~"

Ling Ting couldn't handle him saying such things and lowered her head in embarrassment.

She really wished she could find a hole to crawl into.

Having gotten his way, Ji Zhengyao felt satisfied, but he didn't want to delay the girl’s meal, so he didn't have the heart to tease her further.

"Alright, I'll stop."

Another shrimp was offered to Ling Ting’s lips.

Ling Ting refused to eat, keeping her mouth tightly shut.

"Eat up."

Ji Zhengyao tilted his head, coaxing her gently.

The earlier awkwardness had left a shadow in Ling Ting’s heart, and no matter how he tried to persuade her, she refused to eat any more shrimp peeled by him.

Ji Zhengyao had no choice but to eat them himself.

Because Ji Zhengyao intentionally dawdled, the two of them didn't finish their meal until after ten o'clock at night.

Wen Meimei was worried and called her.

"I have to go back."

Ling Ting hung up the phone and said to Ji Zhengyao with some urgency.

When they arrived, Director Huang had said that they were a group and should try not to wander off alone.

If she didn't go back now, she would probably get scolded.

Ling Ting was timid and, since this was her first time out, she took the rules very seriously.

Seeing the girl so anxious that she had stood up, Ji Zhengyao smiled helplessly, called the waiter to pay the bill, and said, "I'll take you."

"No..."

"I’m staying at that hotel too."

Ling Ting had wanted to refuse, but Ji Zhengyao cut her off.

"Oh."

She had almost forgotten that Ji Zhengyao was also there for the tour and study trip, so it was normal for him to stay at that hotel.

However, Ling Ting was ultimately afraid of gossip, so when they were still a distance away from the hotel, she asked Ji Zhengyao to stop the car.

Ji Zhengyao wouldn't agree and insisted that Ling Ting give him a kiss.

Ling Ting was so angry that her eyes turned red, and Ji Zhengyao, startled, quickly pulled the car over.

"Ji Zhengyao, you’re too mean."

Ling Ting was furious. Before getting out of the car, she didn't know where she found the courage, but she glared at Ji Zhengyao.

Ji Zhengyao was overjoyed by that glare and, after a long moment, burst into hearty laughter.

The little girl was getting comfortable with him; she dared to scold him now.

But it sounded so sweet.

What should he do? He wanted to hear it again.

Ling Ting: "..."

Because he had such a pleasant time with Ling Ting, Ji Zhengyao was in a great mood. As soon as she went inside, he called Director Huang.

Director Huang received the call and came out to greet him shortly after, bringing the room key with him.

"Director Ji, why are you here today?"

Director Huang handed the room key to Ji Zhengyao, asking with a face full of respect.

He had assumed that after the meetings, Director Ji would at least rest for the night and arrive by tomorrow at the earliest.

"I was a bit worried, so I came early."

Ji Zhengyao took the key, tucked it into his pocket, and gave Director Huang a meaningful look.

Director Huang: "..."

Director Huang felt incredibly awkward.

He knew that Director Ji was pointing out his failure to handle things properly.

At first, Director Huang had thought that because Ling Ting was pretty, Ji Zhengyao was just playing around. After all, he had seen enough of that in his many years in officialdom.

But now, his thoughts had changed.

Is this... is this turning into something serious?

However, Director Huang was quick-witted. He immediately turned his clever brain, sacrificed a few of his remaining hairs, and said, "Director Ji, there is a study task tomorrow morning, but the afternoon is free for personal activities."

Director Huang reported the schedule for tomorrow with a smile.

In reality, the activities were scheduled for the whole day, but to create an opportunity for his good Director, he had cut it down to just the morning.

"That works."

Though he had previously had some opinions about Director Huang, after hearing his arrangement, Ji Zhengyao couldn't help but raise an eyebrow.

This was a good arrangement; he could take the little girl out to play in the afternoon.

Seeing that his flattery had hit the mark, Director Huang secretly breathed a sigh of relief, while also feeling very fortunate that he had bet on the right treasure in Ling Ting.

Ling Ting was oblivious to the outside world and had no idea that Director Huang had gone to such great lengths just to create opportunities for her and Ji Zhengyao.

The next day, after finishing the morning tour, she went to eat with Ji Zhengyao.

She had no choice; he kept sending messages, telling her not to go with the other colleagues.

She had even rejected Wen Meimei’s invitation.

Heaven knows she was someone who couldn't lie; she would blush whenever she tried to deceive someone.

"After we eat, shall we go to the amusement park for a bit and then head to the beach?"

Ji Zhengyao watched as the girl, who had been sneaking around and hunching over as if trying to shrink into a ball, finally got into the car, and asked with amusement.

This little girl was too funny; dating him was like being a thief.

Not only did she make him park the car far away, but she didn't even dare to answer her phone.

"Okay."

Ling Ting carefully looked left and right, and after confirming no colleagues were nearby, she let out a soft sigh of relief.

Her relationship with Ji Zhengyao couldn't be exposed; it would be fine after three months.

...

"Alright then, let's go eat first."

Ji Zhengyao helped Ling Ting fasten her seatbelt and then started the car, heading toward the city center.

For the afternoon’s itinerary, Ji Zhengyao had spent half the night researching.

Because it was peak tourist season, the specialty restaurants were very crowded, and it took a long time before they could finally get a meal.

After eating, they hurried straight to the amusement park and went on every ride suitable for children under ten.

Ling Ting was timid and didn't even dare to go on the Ferris wheel.

But this was fine too. Watching Ling Ting ride the carousel with a group of children, her eyes curved into crescents with joy, Ji Zhengyao silently took out his phone.

He wanted to record every happy moment of Ling Ting’s, so that in the future, when he couldn't sleep during the long, quiet nights, he could pull them out and look at them.

Looking at Ling Ting’s smiling face, the long nights didn't seem so hard to endure anymore.

chapters.title: Xu Xianzhu
chapters.content:
After playing in the amusement park for a long time, Ling Ting’s face was flushed from the sun, but her eyes remained curved like crescent moons.

Ji Zhengyao pulled her off the bumper car. Seeing that the little girl’s hair was damp with sweat, he wiped it away for her with a look of tender concern and brought a bottle of water to her lips.

Ling Ting didn't think much of it and took a sip from his hand.

Only after she finished did she realize what she had done, and she lowered her head in embarrassment.

A faint blush appeared on her face.

She was becoming increasingly spoiled; not only did she let Ji Zhengyao wait on her during meals, but now she didn't even have to lift a finger to drink water.

"Let's go. The beach is beautiful at dusk; let's go take a look."

Ji Zhengyao reached out to tuck a stray lock of hair behind Ling Ting’s ear, his gaze so gentle it felt as if one could drown in it.

Ling Ting turned her head away, feeling incredibly shy.

"Sweetheart, you look so beautiful."

Ji Zhengyao felt as if he were lovesick; his eyes followed the little girl everywhere she went.

When she was happy, he felt a surge of joy; when she pouted, he would do everything in his power to cheer her up.

Never in his life had he cared so deeply for anyone.

"Can you stop calling me 'sweetheart' all the time?"

Ling Ting bit her lip, her voice as soft as a mosquito’s hum.

He had a name for her, yet he insisted on calling her "sweetheart," which made her feel awkward.

"I like it."

Ji Zhengyao took Ling Ting’s hand and walked toward the car, saying, "I won't call you that when others are around."

He leaned in close, lowering his voice, "Only in secret."

"You..."

Ling Ting felt a bit defeated.

"Heh."

The way the little girl had no idea how to handle him was truly adorable.

Ji Zhengyao loved it.

The beach at dusk was beautiful, with the evening glow spilling over the sea, shimmering like gold.

Ji Zhengyao crouched down to take off Ling Ting’s shoes, carrying them in his hand as he walked slowly with her.

"Do you want to buy a swimsuit?"

Seeing many people nearby wearing swimsuits, Ji Zhengyao tilted his head and smiled at Ling Ting, teasing her on purpose.

"You're annoying."

Ling Ting was annoyed by his teasing and suddenly threw a little tantrum.

She turned her back to him, ignoring him.

He wouldn't stop calling her "sweetheart" when she asked, and now he was saying things like that.

He didn't act like a leader at all.

He was acting like a total rogue.

"Alright, alright, I won't say it anymore."

Ji Zhengyao hadn't expected the little girl to snap so suddenly. He raised his hands with a smile, making a gesture of promise.

It was his own loose tongue.

"Hmph!"

Ling Ting wasn't one to hold a grudge. Since Ji Zhengyao had apologized, she wouldn't dwell on it.

She playfully wrinkled her nose at him, let go of his hand, and ran toward the sea.

Barefoot on the sand, with her arms spread wide to welcome the sea breeze, she felt happier than she had ever been.

"Sweetheart, do you like it here?"

Ji Zhengyao stood behind Ling Ting, gently smoothing the hair that the sea breeze had tousled, and asked softly.

Ling Ting turned her face, gave him a bright smile, and nodded. "I like it."

"That's good."

Ji Zhengyao carefully wrapped his arms around Ling Ting’s waist and nuzzled her cheek.

Feeling uncomfortable, Ling Ting pushed him away and ran off again, chasing the waves.

Ji Zhengyao followed behind, his eyes locked firmly on her, filled with longing.

On this side, Ji Zhengyao followed Ling Ting step by step, guarding her like a bodyguard, terrified that the little girl might get her dress wet.

Meanwhile, at the Ji family estate, an uninvited guest had arrived.

"How did that matter I asked you about last time go?"

Xu Xianzhu, dressed in a sharp, professional outfit, asked Wen Yazhi with a serious expression.

"Xianzhu, I'm afraid that won't work out."

Wen Yazhi handed a cup of tea to Xu Xianzhu and shook her head.

"Why?"

Xu Xianzhu’s expression shifted slightly as she set the cup down on the coffee table.

"Zhengyao is a man with his own mind; he likely won't be interested in an arranged marriage."

Her brother-in-law was successful in his career, having risen to the position of bureau chief at a young age, with a bright future ahead of him.

In Wen Yazhi’s view, there was no need for an arranged marriage at all.

Of course, he had said it himself: when he eventually married, his wife would have to be someone he loved.

"What is 'love'?"

Xu Xianzhu scoffed. "Isn't it enough as long as it's beneficial to him?"

"That's not how it works."

Wen Yazhi sighed and patted Xu Xianzhu’s hand gently.

"He's not a child anymore; he knows what he wants. Why don't we... why don't we just let him be?"

Wen Yazhi didn't want to see a rift form between mother and son.

"Let him be?"

Xu Xianzhu sneered. "Impossible!"

"I am his mother. No matter how independent he thinks he is, he still has to listen to me."

Thinking of the son she had given birth to, who treated her like a stranger whenever they met, Xu Xianzhu’s anger flared even higher.

"Xianzhu, can't you change your temper?"

Wen Yazhi and Xu Xianzhu had grown up together; they were close friends who shared everything.

However, their relationship was complex. To put it simply, Xu Xianzhu was her step-mother-in-law.

When Xu Xianzhu was twenty, the Xu family was sabotaged and pushed to the brink of bankruptcy, leading her father and brother to jump to their deaths.

A happy family was reduced to just her and a sickly younger brother.

To keep the company afloat, Xu Xianzhu grew up overnight, begging everyone she could.

But when a tree falls, the monkeys scatter; not only did she find no one to help her, but she was also taken advantage of by many.

Later...

Later, she married Ji Yun, who was Wen Yazhi’s father-in-law.

There was a large age gap between them, and her father-in-law had been married twice before and had several children.

Wen Yazhi had already been engaged to Ji Zhengye at the time and had tried to persuade Xu Xianzhu countless times, but she was headstrong and even gave birth to her brother-in-law.

Because of the relationship between Xu Xianzhu and her father-in-law, Wen Yazhi had been in a very awkward position and had almost broken up with Ji Zhengye at the time.

If he hadn't been so persistent, they probably wouldn't be where they were today.

But a marriage based on ulterior motives was destined not to last. Xu Xianzhu saved the company with her father-in-law’s help, and after that... she didn't want to come home anymore.

The two divorced when Zhengyao was two years old.

"I am his mother; he is the one who needs to change."

Xu Xianzhu was dictatorial and never believed she was in the wrong.

She had been busy with work all these years, and mother and son had spent little time together. She hadn't been involved in many aspects of her son's life, but his marriage was something she had to control.

She wanted to choose a wife for her son who would help his career and strive to surpass his father’s achievements.

Marrying Ji Hong was the greatest humiliation of Xu Xianzhu’s life, and she wanted her son to completely transcend him.

"You..."

Wen Yazhi wanted to persuade her further, but thinking of Xu Xianzhu’s temper, she shook her head and gave up.

Seeing Wen Yazhi’s unhappy expression, Xu Xianzhu reined in her emotions and sighed. "Fine, your health isn't good, so stop worrying about it. Shall we go out for dinner?"

As friends of several decades, and given that Wen Yazhi had helped her look after Zhengyao for so many years, Xu Xianzhu had deep feelings for her.

"Forget it, I won't go."

Wen Yazhi shook her head; she didn't want to talk to Xu Xianzhu right now.

She was already full from the frustration.

"You, you've just been spoiled by Ji Zhengye."

Xu Xianzhu glared at Wen Yazhi, stood up, and walked out.

She was very busy, and she didn't eat...

chapters.title: Temporarily Went Back
chapters.content:
Ji Zhengyao had no idea that the moment he stepped out, his own mother would start causing trouble. She draped her coat over Ling Ting’s shoulders and gently asked, “Cold?”

The evening breeze was a little chilly, and he was worried the little girl might catch a cold.

“Not cold.”

Ling Ting was having so much fun, nestled under Ji Zhengyao’s arm, her feet still splashing in the water.

“Want to go back?”

Ji Zhengyao brushed his fingers against Ling Ting’s face, wanting to take her back.

“Mhm.”

Ling Ting nodded, agreeing softly.

But she really loved it here, and a hint of reluctance tugged at her heart.

“If you like it, we can come again tomorrow.”

Ji Zhengyao could see that the little girl wasn’t done playing.

Ever since they arrived at the seaside, she had become much more cheerful.

“Probably not.”

Ling Ting lifted her gaze to Ji Zhengyao, her voice soft. “Tomorrow seems to have a scheduled visit.”

Even if it was just a formality, she still had to attend.

“It’s fine, I’ll tell Director Huang.”

Ji Zhengyao took Ling Ting’s hand, gently massaging it.

As long as Ling Ting wanted, he could arrange everything.

“No, no, no.”

Ling Ting refused. “I can’t ask for special treatment.”

Her colleagues were already gossip-hungry. If they found out she and Director Ji had disappeared together, the rumors would fly everywhere.

At the thought of everyone whispering behind her back, Ling Ting’s heart jolted, and she quickly shook her head.

“Alright, then we’ll come back during free time.”

Ji Zhengyao chuckled, tickling the palm of her hand.

The little girl’s hand was so soft, the touch was incredible.

Ling Ting squirmed under his touch, pulling her hand back.

Seeing her face turn red again, Ji Zhengyao teased, “Avoiding me?”

“No.”

Ling Ting’s face burned under his gaze, her voice sweet and muffled as she lowered her head.

“Alright, let’s go back.”

Ji Zhengyao couldn’t bear to tease her anymore. He wrapped his arm around her and walked toward the car.

Ling Ting let out a small sigh of relief, her lips curling into a smile.

She had been so happy today—going to the amusement park, playing in the water. Even after returning to the hotel, the smile on her face remained bright.

“Ling Ting, where did you go this afternoon?”

Wen Meimei noticed Ling Ting had finally returned, still draped in a man’s coat. Her eyes sparkled with gossip. “Did you go out with someone?”

Ling Ting’s hand paused as she took off the coat, forcing a small smile. “Went out with a friend.”

She had told Wen Meimei she was meeting a friend when she left at noon.

“A man, right?”

Wen Meimei raised an eyebrow, as if she had already figured it all out.

“Mhm.”

Ling Ting blinked, quickly folding the coat and stuffing it under her pillow.

In her fluster, she completely forgot to return it to Ji Zhengyao.

“I knew it.”

Wen Meimei wagged her finger, lowering her voice. “Ling Ting, tell me the truth—did you get a new boyfriend?”

Xiaolu had a big mouth and had already spread the news that Ling Ting wasn’t getting married.

Wen Meimei had heard about it, so she assumed the coat Ling Ting was wearing must belong to a new boyfriend.

At the very least, a suitor.

Ling Ting was beautiful and had a great personality. Plenty of male colleagues in the office had their eyes on her.

Just this afternoon, two or three people had asked Wen Meimei about Ling Ting’s whereabouts.

Wen Meimei could tell they were all interested in her.

“No, don’t guess randomly.”

Ling Ting adjusted the blanket on the bed, her gaze flickering as she spoke.

She and Ji Zhengyao might be in a relationship, but it was only for three months. It would be over soon.

“Stop lying, it’s written all over your face.”

Wen Meimei flopped back onto her pillow. “I’ve been through this too. I know what love looks like.”

There was a sparkle in Ling Ting’s eyes—the kind that came from being nourished by love.

“Wen Meimei, you and Xiao Gao…”

Normally, Ling Ting wouldn’t pry into others’ private affairs, but to change the subject, she forced herself to ask.

“It’s over. We broke up.”

Wen Meimei waved her hand, speaking in frustration.

“Why?”

Ling Ting sat on the edge of the bed. “Wasn’t Xiao Gao pretty good?”

Xiao Gao came from a good family, had a good job, and wasn’t bad-looking.

In Ling Ting’s eyes, he was a decent choice.

“Good? What’s good about him? He just knows how to annoy me.”

Wen Meimei seemed to recall something, humphed, and pulled the blanket over her head.

Ling Ting: “…”

Ling Ting wasn’t the type to dig for details. Seeing that Wen Meimei seemed upset, she offered a few words of comfort before going to wash up.

After finishing, she lay in bed, tossing and turning for a long time, unable to fall asleep.

Thinking back on every little moment she had spent with Ji Zhengyao that day, her heart inexplicably stirred.

Even though Ji Zhengyao was a leader, when he was with her, he was just like an ordinary boyfriend.

He was considerate, attentive, and incredibly easy to talk to.

He catered to all her emotions, even fulfilling every request she made.

She let out a soft sigh and rolled over, wondering who in the future would be lucky enough to marry Ji Zhengyao.

He would definitely make a good husband.

Meanwhile, Ji Zhengyao had no idea that Ling Ting was lying in bed thinking about him. After returning to the hotel, he had gone straight into the bathroom.

The water ran loudly, but it couldn’t drown out the heavy breathing.

The little girl had only been wearing a white dress, which had clung to her body after getting soaked in seawater. Only heaven knew how hard it had been for Ji Zhengyao to resist.

He had wanted to drag her into the car and cherish her properly several times, but in the end, he had given up on the idea.

The little girl was so pure and obedient—he was afraid his beastly behavior might scare her.

After all, in front of her, he had always maintained a dignified demeanor.

After spending half an hour in the bathroom, Ji Zhengyao finally emerged with wet hair, his expression relaxed.

His body, now relieved, craved a cigarette.

As he smoked, he scrolled through the photos he had taken that day, his heart overflowing with joy.

Before he knew it, he was laughing out loud.

His little girl was just too beautiful.

*Ring ring ring*

Just as Ji Zhengyao was happily looking through the photos, about to send a message to his little girl, his phone rang. The name “Secretary Yao” flashed on the screen.

“Hello?”

Ji Zhengyao answered the call.

“Director Ji, there’s been a problem with the project in Qingshan County. Could you come back for a bit?”

Secretary Yao’s tone was serious, with a hint of urgency.

Ji Zhengyao held two positions and was overseeing two major projects.

He had been working on the Qingshan County project for three years, and it was just about to wrap up. He hadn’t expected something to go wrong now.

“I’ll be right back.”

Ji Zhengyao hung up the phone, pulled out his suitcase, and quickly packed his things. Just as he was about to leave, he remembered Ling Ting.

He took out his phone, intending to call her over for a quick meeting.

But after checking the time, he abandoned the idea.

The little girl had been out in the sea breeze—she might already be asleep. He couldn’t bear to wake her.

Ling Ting found out about Ji Zhengyao’s departure the next morning.

When she woke up, her phone had over a dozen unread messages, all sent by him late last night.

He had briefly explained the reason for his sudden return, reminding her to have fun and to dress warmly in the evening.

Though she felt a small pang of disappointment at his sudden leave, Ling Ting understood.

After all, he held two positions and had a lot on his plate.

Being able to spend an entire afternoon with her was already more than enough.

chapters.title: Missing the Little Girl
chapters.content:
Ji Zhengyao had been busy for three days since he returned. Things had finally taken a slight turn for the better, and he was finally able to spare some time to go home.

He had intended to take a shower, get some sleep, and have a simple rest, but before he could even head upstairs, the door was pushed open with great force.

"Zhengyao, tidy yourself up. There’s a dinner party tonight; come with me."

Xu Xianzhu walked in with a swagger, showing no awareness that this was no longer her home, and issued the order to Ji Zhengyao.

"I don't have time."

Ji Zhengyao stood at the foot of the stairs, one hand in his trouser pocket, his face devoid of any extra expression.

Having not slept for three days, he couldn't even manage a smile.

"What do you mean you don't have time? Aren't you just standing there idle?"

Xu Xianzhu was very dissatisfied with Ji Zhengyao's words, and her face darkened.

"I'm very sleepy right now. I want to sleep."

Ji Zhengyao’s expression was indifferent, and his words were devoid of emotion.

His temples were throbbing, and the pain was making his teeth tremble slightly.

"When can't you sleep?"

Xu Xianzhu walked up to Ji Zhengyao, failing to notice the exhaustion on his face, and continued on her own, "It’s not easy for your Uncle Xiao to come back for a visit, and Yanyan is here too."

As she spoke, she raised her eyebrows at Ji Zhengyao, implying something.

"I said, I’m not going."

Ji Zhengyao turned around, making a move to go upstairs.

He couldn't stand anymore.

"Zhengyao, can you try to be sensible!"

Being rejected by her son time and time again, Xu Xianzhu grew angry.

She grabbed Ji Zhengyao, her voice rising.

This son had been like this since he was a child; he had never once followed her wishes.

"I said, I want to sleep."

Ji Zhengyao shook off Xu Xianzhu’s hand, his tone already showing a hint of impatience.

"Zhengyao, I arranged this dinner specifically for you. Don't be ungrateful."

Having spent all these years busy with her career, Xu Xianzhu had not remarried and had only Ji Zhengyao as her child.

At the time, she hadn't wanted Ji Zhengyao to enter politics; she wanted him to take over the company.

After all, her younger brother had no children, and the company would be his sooner or later.

But Ji Yun disagreed. He said Zhengyao had the brains and the drive, making him suitable for the political arena.

The two had a huge argument over this matter, and in the end, they had no choice but to leave the decision to Ji Zhengyao.

Ji Zhengyao chose politics, and mother and son did not speak for three years.

Although their relationship had eased over the years, it remained lukewarm.

While they tried to maintain a facade of peace and occasionally had a meal together, they never opened up to each other.

"It’s really unnecessary."

Ji Zhengyao lowered his eyes, not looking at his mother at all.

The two interacted no more than three times a year; they weren't close.

"Ji Zhengyao, you are just like your father."

Rejected by Ji Zhengyao once again, Xu Xianzhu finally erupted.

She pointed at Ji Zhengyao, her face twisted. "You ungrateful wretch, you only know how to side with him."

Xu Xianzhu scolded him loudly, losing control of her emotions. "I’m doing this for your own good, yet you don't appreciate it. You really are an ingrate."

"Since I’m an ingrate, then stop meddling in my affairs."

Ji Zhengyao shed his calm demeanor, looking at Xu Xianzhu with a cold face.

"You..."

Ji Zhengyao’s gaze was like a knife; Xu Xianzhu was left speechless.

"Don't arrange any more so-called 'for my own good' dinners. I don't need them."

Having said that, Ji Zhengyao walked upstairs without another word.

"Ji Zhengyao!"

Xu Xianzhu was trembling with rage, and she made a move to chase after him.

She was an extremist who had to win every argument.

"Xianzhu, come back."

Wen Yazhi, who had been hiding in the room, hadn't wanted to get involved in the mother-son conflict, but seeing the situation spiraling out of control, she hurried out to hold her back.

"Yazhi, look at him. Look at the attitude he has toward me!"

Held back by Wen Yazhi, Xu Xianzhu pointed upstairs and shouted.

"Alright, alright. Zhengyao is probably in a bad mood. Let’s talk about it later."

Wen Yazhi pulled at Xu Xianzhu, afraid that if she kept making a scene, she would provoke Ji Zhengyao.

Don't let his usual smiling face fool you; that boy had a terrible temper.

She had seen with her own eyes how he had smashed a room to pieces.

"What do you mean 'later'? I’ve already made an appointment with them."

Yanyan had come specifically for Ji Zhengyao; how was she supposed to explain this?

"You’re so capable, I’m sure you’ll find a way to resolve it."

Wen Yazhi pulled Xu Xianzhu toward the exit, persuading her as they walked.

"No!"

Xu Xianzhu still refused to give up, shaking off Wen Yazhi’s hand, intending to go upstairs.

"Xianzhu!"

Wen Yazhi called out to her loudly.

"Do you really want to ruin your relationship with your son over a single meal?"

"I..."

Xu Xianzhu’s expression was ugly, and she suddenly hesitated.

"Sigh."

"Don't be impulsive. Take it slow."

Seeing that Xu Xianzhu had finally calmed down, Wen Yazhi took the opportunity to lead her out.

With the noise downstairs finally gone, Ji Zhengyao let out a long sigh. He checked the time and called Ling Ting.

He didn't want to wait for Ling Ting to reply slowly; he wanted to hear her voice immediately.

"Hello?"

The call was answered, and Ling Ting’s soft, sweet voice came through.

"My dear."

Ji Zhengyao’s irritable mood finally eased at this moment.

"Have you eaten?"

Ji Zhengyao asked gently.

He didn't want to bring his negative emotions to the little girl, so he tried his best to restrain himself.

"Mm, I was just about to go eat."

There were voices on Ling Ting’s end; she must have been on her way to a restaurant.

"Where are you going after eating?"

Ji Zhengyao felt a bit of regret. If he weren't dealing with things here, he would definitely have taken Ling Ting out to eat by now.

The little girl had finally made a trip to A City, and he had ruined it for her.

"Wen Meimei said she wants to go to the beach."

Ling Ting had already been there several times in the past few days, but she still loved it.

"Mm, remember to wear a jacket."

Hearing that Ling Ting was going to the beach again, Ji Zhengyao quickly reminded her.

The little girl would play to her heart's content once she reached the beach, and he was truly afraid she would catch a cold.

"I know."

Ling Ting was always very obedient and didn't argue with him.

"My dear..."

Ji Zhengyao called out to Ling Ting.

"Hmm?"

Although she was still very unaccustomed to Ji Zhengyao using this term, she had tried to get him to stop several times to no avail, so Ling Ting had given up.

"When are you coming back?"

Ji Zhengyao missed her—missed her so very much.

"I’ll be back the day after tomorrow morning."

Ling Ting calculated the time. "I’ll be home by noon."

"Do you want me to pick you up?"

Ji Zhengyao wanted to see her as soon as possible.

"No, no need. I’ll go back by myself."

Ling Ting was a bit flustered and quickly refused Ji Zhengyao.

His car was too eye-catching; it wouldn't be good if her colleagues saw it.

"My dear, but I want to go."

Ji Zhengyao knew what Ling Ting was afraid of, and he curled his lips, teasing her on purpose.

"Better not."

Ling Ting clearly took him seriously. "How about you wait downstairs at my place? I’ll be back soon."

The conditions in her residential complex weren't great, and although it was close to her workplace, Ling Ting had observed that none of her close colleagues lived there.

"You’re just going to let me wait outside?"

Ji Zhengyao remained persistent.

"Then..."

Ling Ting hesitated for a moment. "Then go get the key from the flowerpot at my door and go upstairs to wait."

"What?"

Ji Zhengyao sat up slightly, not expecting such a pleasant surprise.

"You left a key at home?"

Ling Ting smiled. "That’s my spare key."

"Is it a spare for me?"

Ji Zhengyao asked teasingly.

"It is not."

Ling Ting sensed the playfulness in Ji Zhengyao’s tone, gave a little "hmph," and hung up the phone.

Listening to the dial tone on the phone, the smile on Ji Zhengyao’s face grew wider and wider.

Was he, perhaps, going to become the master of that little home very soon?

chapters.title: The Small Apartment Helps with Sleep
chapters.content:
Knowing where Ling Ting kept her spare key, Ji Zhengyao felt a surge of excitement, and his sleepiness vanished instantly.

Unable to sleep, he decided not to try. He went to Ling Ting’s place and rummaged through the flowerpot by the door.

The key was buried in the soil.

Looking at the key in his hand—which had been far too easy to find—Ji Zhengyao’s handsome brows furrowed.

The little girl had absolutely no sense of security. Wasn't this practically an invitation for a thief?

The joy he felt moments ago was replaced by worry, and his expression darkened.

When the girl returned, he would definitely have to give her a good lecture.

She might be beautiful, but she was truly too careless.

He opened the door. The place was as clean and tidy as ever, filled with the scent of flowers.

Ji Zhengyao took out a pair of newly purchased slippers, put them on, and sat down on the sofa. His mood inexplicably brightened.

This small apartment, though a bit cramped, was exceptionally cozy.

Staying here, his feelings of agitation vanished completely, and he felt instantly relaxed.

As the restlessness faded, sleepiness began to creep up on Ji Zhengyao. He leaned back against the sofa and closed his eyes shortly after.

Ji Zhengyao slept very soundly. When he woke up, it was already dark outside.

Looking at the unfamiliar place that held such a familiar scent, the corners of Ji Zhengyao’s lips curled up without him realizing it.

Insomnia—a problem that had plagued him for ten years—had actually improved here with the little girl.

It was truly incredible.

Because he was well-rested, Ji Zhengyao’s headache was gone. The next day, he handled his affairs with greater ease, and the project crisis was quickly resolved.

Ling Ting arrived home at noon on the third day. Upon entering, she saw someone lying on the sofa and was so startled she nearly screamed.

However, Ji Zhengyao’s handsome face was too recognizable. With just one glance, her heart settled.

She smoothed her chest and walked over. Seeing Ji Zhengyao curled up on the small sofa, sleeping soundly without his glasses, Ling Ting couldn't help but curve her lips into a smile.

She went into the room to find a blanket, gently covered Ji Zhengyao with it, tidied up a few things, and then went to the kitchen to cook.

Because of traffic, they had been delayed for three hours on the road. It was nearly two o'clock now, and they hadn't had lunch yet.

When Ji Zhengyao woke up, Ling Ting’s noodles were just finished.

"Director Ji, you're awake?"

Seeing Ji Zhengyao stir, Ling Ting gave him a sweet smile and took off her apron.

"Sweetheart, you must call me by my name."

Ji Zhengyao pulled Ling Ting into his arms and gave her ear a playful, punishing nip.

"Ah!"

Ling Ting winced in pain, tears nearly welling up in her eyes.

"Did you remember?"

Ji Zhengyao rubbed Ling Ting’s ear, asking with a hint of annoyance.

Ling Ting sniffled and nodded.

"Say it for me."

Seeing that the little girl was almost moved to tears by his nip, Ji Zhengyao suddenly felt a bit regretful.

But he still insisted that she change how she addressed him.

"Ji Zhengyao~"

Her voice was as soft as a feather, brushing against the tip of Ji Zhengyao’s heart.

"Good girl."

Ji Zhengyao pulled Ling Ting back into his embrace, apologizing with a pang of guilt, "I'm sorry, sweetheart."

He shouldn't have treated her like that.

"Let's... let's eat."

Although Ling Ting felt a bit aggrieved, she thought about how Ji Zhengyao had corrected her more than once. She sniffled and pointed to the noodles on the dining table.

"Did you make these?"

Ji Zhengyao pulled Ling Ting up, walked to the table, and asked as he looked at the two fragrant bowls of noodles.

"Mm."

Ling Ting nodded and handed the chopsticks to Ji Zhengyao.

Ji Zhengyao took the chopsticks and sat down at the table.

He picked up a mouthful of noodles, put them in his mouth, and nodded. "Delicious."

"Really?"

Ling Ting sat down and asked, feeling unsure.

Her cooking skills were average; she didn't think it was good enough to be called delicious.

"Really. If you don't believe me, have a bite."

As he spoke, Ji Zhengyao picked up a mouthful of noodles and held them to Ling Ting’s lips.

Ling Ting blinked, not opening her mouth.

"Eat."

Ji Zhengyao didn't give up; he kept his eyes full of smiles, waiting patiently.

Ling Ting felt bad about making him wait, so she reluctantly opened her mouth and ate them.

"How is it?" Ji Zhengyao asked.

Ling Ting nodded. "It's alright."

It was indeed just "alright."

"Here, have the egg."

Since the noodles were just average, Ling Ting wanted to make up for it with the egg.

"You're not eating it?" Ji Zhengyao asked, looking at the poached egg in his bowl with confusion.

"Oh, just eat it if I give it to you."

Ji Zhengyao had lost weight. In just a few days, his cheeks had become slightly sunken.

Though she didn't know the reason, she wanted to care for him in her own way.

"Heh."

Ji Zhengyao seemed to have guessed Ling Ting’s thoughts. He picked up the poached egg, put it in his mouth, and let out a happy laugh with his cheeks puffed out.

The little girl was finally learning to care for him.

After the meal, Ling Ting saw that Ji Zhengyao had no intention of leaving, so she sat on the sofa with him to watch TV.

But as they watched, Ji Zhengyao leaned against her, looking faintly like he wanted to sleep.

"Sweetheart, I'm so sleepy."

Ji Zhengyao felt that as long as he was at Ling Ting’s place, he couldn't keep his eyes open.

"Can I go sleep in your room?"

Ji Zhengyao nuzzled against Ling Ting’s shoulder.

Because the girl hadn't been home, he hadn't been into her bedroom yet.

"This..."

Ling Ting hesitated.

She had never let anyone sleep in her room before.

"I'm just so sleepy."

Ji Zhengyao continued to negotiate.

"Then... alright then."

Ji Zhengyao was tall with long legs; he really couldn't sleep well on the sofa.

Ling Ting didn't refuse anymore and nodded in agreement.

"Good girl."

Ji Zhengyao leaned over, kissed Ling Ting on the cheek, and stood up to head to the room.

Watching Ji Zhengyao’s cheerful back, Ling Ting suddenly felt like she had invited a wolf into her house.

But since she had already agreed, it was too late to go back on her word. She sighed and continued watching TV.

Ji Zhengyao slept very deeply and didn't open his eyes until it was dark.

He came out of the room and saw Ling Ting sitting on the sofa, holding a towel and drying her hair.

The girl had washed her hair.

"Why didn't you use a hairdryer?"

Ji Zhengyao walked over to Ling Ting and asked, looking at her damp hair.

"It's fine."

Ling Ting was afraid the noise of the hairdryer would wake Ji Zhengyao up.

Ji Zhengyao reached out and flicked her nose, then went to the bathroom to get the hairdryer.

"I'll do it myself?"

Seeing Ji Zhengyao about to dry her hair, Ling Ting felt instantly awkward.

"I'll do it."

Ji Zhengyao dodged Ling Ting’s hand and turned on the hairdryer.

Ling Ting’s hair was very long, soft, and smooth. Ji Zhengyao ran his fingers through her locks, and the texture was surprisingly good.

Because of the project issues and his mother’s meddling, Ji Zhengyao had been in a bad mood for days.

But ever since he came to Ling Ting’s place and had those two naps, his state of mind had suddenly changed.

He had found a very quiet harbor.

Although this place was small, it held someone he cared about.

Even though the little girl couldn't fully accept him yet, Ji Zhengyao was already very satisfied.

Take it slow. He believed that one day, the little girl would accept him with all her heart.

Their future would surely be beautiful and happy.

chapters.title: A Scumbag
chapters.content:
After drying Ling Ting’s hair, Ji Zhengyao sat for a while longer. Seeing that she could barely keep her eyes open, he finally got up to leave.

He knew that as long as he didn't leave, the little girl probably wouldn't dare to sleep.

Ji Zhengyao was right; with him there, Ling Ting really felt too shy to fall asleep.

After he left, Ling Ting rubbed her eyes, did a quick wash, and got into bed.

However, once she lay down, she couldn't help but think about how Ji Zhengyao had also slept in her bed. She tossed and turned, unable to fall asleep at all.

Was she getting too close to Ji Zhengyao?

Three months—that should pass quickly, right?

After a night of restless thoughts, Ling Ting finally drifted into a hazy sleep just as dawn was breaking.

She slept soundly until past nine, only to be woken up by the sound of her phone.

It was her cousin calling, saying that a colleague had given her a lot of fruit and she couldn't finish it all by herself, so she asked Ling Ting to come over and take some.

When her cousin gave the word, Ling Ting didn't dare refuse. She tidied up and headed over to her aunt’s house.

When she arrived, she saw her cousin was busy, so she didn't disturb her and just found a bag to start packing fruit.

Since her cousin told her to take it, she didn't pretend to be polite.

"Your aunt is fine; she’ll be back in a few days."

Lin Wei worked for a while before going to the room to bring out a carton of milk.

"Take this back too; I don't drink it."

Her cousin was thrifty, so she took everything she could.

Ling Ting nodded. "Cousin, you’ve managed to get in touch with my aunt?"

Her aunt’s phone had been unreachable, and Ling Ting had been very worried.

"I got in touch. She’ll be back in three to five days at most."

Lin Wei packed some more food for Ling Ting and sighed, "I won't let her go out again after she gets back this time. She’s such a worry."

Heaven knows how many methods she had to use to find her missing mother.

Hearing her cousin’s words, Ling Ting smiled but said nothing.

Ever since her surgery, her aunt had been the one calling the shots at home; she wouldn't listen to her cousin.

Her cousin was quite busy, and Ling Ting didn't want to bother her further. After a bit more small talk, she took her things and left.

She had intended to go straight home, but just as she reached the bottom of the building, she received a call from Qiao Yin.

Qiao Yin said she was overwhelmed and needed Ling Ting to come and save her.

Ling Ting was always ready to help, so she hurried over.

"Ling Ting, you’re finally here! Quick, quick, help me pack!"

Qiao Yin was so busy she couldn't even stop to catch her breath. When she saw Ling Ting, she gave her a big hug and pointed to the packages on the floor that hadn't been packed yet.

Ling Ting didn't hesitate. She put down the fruit she had brought, rolled up her sleeves, and got to work.

Because the order volume was quite large, the two of them worked straight through until past eight in the evening. During this time, Ji Zhengyao sent messages asking Ling Ting out for dinner, but she didn't agree to any of them.

"Phew."

Watching all the packages being packed and neatly stacked against the wall, Qiao Yin plopped down onto the floor.

The cheongsam design Ling Ting had created had become a hit the moment it went on sale, and Qiao Yin couldn't handle the workload alone.

"Ling Ting, thank goodness for you, or I’d be finished."

Tomorrow was the last day; if she didn't ship them out, the customers would start requesting refunds.

"Alright, 'Qiao the Bloodsucker,' even exploitation has its limits. When are we going to eat?"

Ling Ting hadn't eaten all day and was starving.

"Let's go, let's go. 'Qiao the Bloodsucker' will take you out for a meal."

Qiao Yin wrapped her arm around Ling Ting, looking like an old landlord from the old society.

Ling Ting ignored her, left some of the fruit behind for her, and started walking downstairs.

Both of them were exhausted, so they didn't go far and just found a nearby restaurant to eat.

After dinner, Qiao Yin wanted to call a taxi for Ling Ting, but Ling Ting refused firmly and walked toward the subway station on her own.

After seeing Ling Ting off, Qiao Yin let out a burp, rubbed her full stomach, and decided to take a leisurely walk home.

But as she walked, she suddenly stopped in her tracks, her eyes widening as she watched a man and a woman arguing ahead.

"Li Sheng, why are you treating me like this? Is there something I did wrong?"

The woman was tugging at the man’s sleeve, crying pitifully.

"Let's part on good terms."

The man was leaning against a red sports car, his handsome face sullen, his voice extremely cold.

"No!"

The woman shrieked, "I don't want to break up with you!"

She threw herself into the man’s arms, only to be pushed away a second later.

"Don't pull these stunts. Just go."

The man impatiently threw his cigarette on the ground, stepped on it, and made a move to leave.

Qiao Yin was a natural gossip. Seeing that the man looked somewhat familiar, she took small steps forward to get a better look, crouching down to hide behind a large tree.

"Li Sheng, I’m pregnant."

Seeing the man about to leave, the woman grabbed his waist.

The man stopped his movement of opening the car door.

He turned around slowly, pulled the woman’s hands away, and looked at her as if she were a joke.

"Heh."

"Did I forget to tell you something?"

"What?"

The woman stepped back, her eyes guarded, a vague sense of foreboding rising within her.

"I can't have children. If you’re really pregnant, you’d better figure out whose seed it is first."

"That’s impossible!"

The woman shook her head, her eyes filled with terror.

"Believe it or not, that's up to you."

The man snorted coldly, ignored her, and pulled the car door open, ready to get in.

But the woman wouldn't let it go and lunged at him again.

The man looked thoroughly displeased and kicked the car door shut.

His patience was limited, and he was already furious.

"Are you fucking done yet?"

"Didn't I give you a breakup fee?"

"I don't want money! I just want to know why!"

"You want a reason, right?"

The man sneered, shook off the woman’s hand, rushed directly behind the tree, and yanked Qiao Yin out.

"Hey, hey, hey! I’m just passing by!"

Qiao Yin was grabbed by the collar, struggling like a little chick.

"See? Because of her. Because I have a new flame."

After saying that, without waiting for the woman to react, he shoved Qiao Yin into the car.

"Hey, hey, hey! Slow down! I get motion sickness!"

After being shoved into the car by Li Sheng, Qiao Yin wanted to curse him out, but the rapidly increasing speed terrified her.

She suffered from severe motion sickness, so she covered her eyes, trembling all over.

Li Sheng glanced at her, raised an eyebrow, and deliberately accelerated.

"Big brother, big brother, I beg you, please!"

Seeing things were going south, Qiao Yin turned into a total coward, shivering as she began to beg for mercy.

Li Sheng found her quite amusing and decided to tease her. "Calling me 'big brother' won't work. Call me 'uncle' and let me hear it."

"Uncle! Uncle, please stop!"

Qiao Yin was so scared she didn't dare open her eyes and shouted it out without a moment's hesitation.

"Hahaha!"

Li Sheng was amused by Qiao Yin, slowly reduced the speed, and pulled over to the side of the road after a short while.

"Alright, you can take your hands down now."

Seeing Qiao Yin trembling, her hands still covering her face, Li Sheng said with a laugh.

"Are you fucking sick in the head? You almost killed me with your car last time, and now you want to scare me to death?"

Qiao Yin opened the car door, got out, dry-heaved a couple of times, and started cursing loudly.

"What?"

Li Sheng was a bit confused.

When did he hit her?

"Oh, right."

Li Sheng slapped his own forehead, suddenly remembering something. "You’re that little girl on the electric scooter?"

"Called... Qiao Yin?"

He knew she looked familiar.

chapters.title: I’ve Taken a Fancy to You
chapters.content:
Qiao Yin had no desire to waste her breath on a playboy. She spat in disgust and turned to leave.

She had initially thought he was quite handsome and had leaned in to watch the excitement, but who would have thought he was a lunatic?

He had scared her to death.

"Hey, why are you leaving?"

Seeing Qiao Yin walk away just like that, Li Sheng poked his head out of the window and asked teasingly.

"Should I stay and wait for the New Year?"

Qiao Yin didn't look back, waving her hand dismissively.

"Heh."

Watching her small frame make such a carefree gesture, Li Sheng raised an eyebrow.

His rugged, handsome face was filled with interest.

"The little thing is actually quite amusing."

Qiao Yin had no idea that the big boss Li had already taken notice of her. After returning home, she couldn't wait to tell Ling Ting about what had just happened.

Over the phone, she ranted fiercely about Li Sheng, calling him a complete scumbag and a maniac who drove recklessly.

Ling Ting hadn't expected that in such a short time, Qiao Yin would have been snatched into a stranger's car. Ling Ting warned her with lingering fear, "Don't be so nosy in the future. Stay as far away from abnormal people as you can."

"Got it, I'll remember that."

Qiao Yin considered this a lesson learned and obediently listened to Ling Ting.

She had encountered Li Sheng twice, and both times were incredibly harrowing; he was her nemesis.

From now on, if she saw him, she would take a three-mile detour.

She would stay far, far away from him.

Qiao Yin had planned it all out, but some things were truly not for her to decide.

And so, the next day when she went downstairs to take out the trash, Qiao Yin was stunned to see that flashy red sports car.

"Why are you here?"

Qiao Yin frowned and instinctively took two steps back.

She kept Ling Ting’s words in mind: stay away from perverts.

"I came to find you, of course."

Seeing Qiao Yin about to run, Li Sheng quickly opened the door and got out.

"Find me?"

Qiao Yin was puzzled. "What do you want with me?"

"I have business with you, obviously."

Li Sheng gave Qiao Yin a wicked, charming smile and took two steps toward her.

"Just... just say it from there."

Qiao Yin held up her palm to stop Li Sheng’s advance. "Don't come any closer."

This man was reeking of overpowering perfume; she was about to sneeze.

"What do you mean by that?"

Li Sheng was displeased. He wasn't some filthy thing; why couldn't he move?

"Oh my god, are you going to say it or not? If not, I’m leaving."

Qiao Yin didn't want to waste words with Li Sheng. She pulled a long face and made a move to leave.

"Wait."

Li Sheng called her back.

"Be with me."

Li Sheng was full of confidence and stated it bluntly.

After returning home last night, facing his empty, lifeless house, he had suddenly thought of Qiao Yin.

Although this little thing looked average and didn't have much going for her, she had a good personality.

He was tired of those women who were beautiful but fake and pretentious; he wanted to experience a different type.

"What the hell?"

Qiao Yin took a step back, looking at Li Sheng as if he were an idiot. "Did you take the wrong medicine?"

Li Sheng shook his head, his expression calm. "I like your personality. Want to get to know each other?"

Get to know your grandmother!

Qiao Yin felt that Li Sheng was insulting her.

A playboy running around treating her like a Sunday pastime?

Not wanting to say more to him, Qiao Yin rolled her eyes in a strange and difficult manner, turned around, and walked away.

"What a freak!"

"Hey, think about it! I’m a great catch."

Qiao Yin had run off, and Li Sheng felt a faint sense of loss, shouting loudly at her retreating back.

"Get lost!"

"You motherf..."

Qiao Yin roared, though only she could hear the last three words.

Li Sheng was handsome and had the means; he had never lacked women over the years.

If he liked someone, he just had to beckon, or at worst, throw some money at them, and the women would become like little lambs.

This was the first time he had met someone like Qiao Yin, who would open her mouth and curse him directly.

Feeling uncomfortable from being rejected, Li Sheng took out his phone and called Ji Zhengyao directly.

He wanted to invite Ji Zhengyao to dinner and, incidentally, ease his current dry spell.

But Ji Zhengyao spent every spare moment by Ling Ting's side and didn't even answer the phone.

Li Sheng: "..."

What kind of friend was this?

"Achoo! Achoo!"

Ji Zhengyao, who had just arrived at Ling Ting's door: "..."

"Who is it?"

Ling Ting had been away for several days and was tending to the flower pots on her windowsill when she suddenly heard sneezing at the door, which made her feel a bit scared.

There were three households on her floor, all single young women; how could there be a man's voice?

And this voice was clearly right at her door.

Slowly putting down the small watering can, Ling Ting moved toward the door, trembling with fear.

"It's me."

Ji Zhengyao took out his key and opened the door. Seeing Ling Ting’s pale little face, he felt an instant pang of heartache.

"Sweetheart, did I scare you?"

Ji Zhengyao walked over and reached out to pat Ling Ting on the head.

"You..."

Ling Ting was a bit dazed, staring blankly at Ji Zhengyao.

"Your house key has been with me the whole time."

Ji Zhengyao shook the key in his hand, which he had already attached to a pendant, and hurriedly explained.

"Oh."

Ling Ting let out a breath.

She had been scared to death.

"I forgot."

She reached out to take the key, but Ji Zhengyao pulled it away.

"Leave it with me for now; that flower pot of yours is really not secure."

Saying this, Bureau Chief Ji tucked the key back into his pocket.

He didn't intend to give it back to Ling Ting.

When he had time, he would tell the little girl his own door code, just to be fair.

Thinking of his own home, Ji Zhengyao pondered for a moment. "Sweetheart, let me take you somewhere, shall I?"

Ji Zhengyao took Ling Ting’s hand and pulled a pair of shoes from the shoe cabinet, placing them on the floor.

"Where are we going?"

Ling Ting put on the shoes passively, asking in confusion.

"You'll know when we get there."

Ji Zhengyao smiled, took her hand, and headed out.

He drove, taking Ling Ting through the city center, making two turns, and entering a residential complex that was low-key and luxurious but had a rather rustic name.

"Happiness Garden?"

Ling Ting tilted her head to look at Ji Zhengyao, not understanding why he had brought her here.

It couldn't be what she was thinking, could it?

Ji Zhengyao smiled and found a parking spot.

He opened the door for Ling Ting to get out and said with a smile, "I bought a place here last year."

He pointed to the building in the very center not far away. "The twentieth floor."

"This place must be very expensive, right?"

Ling Ting sized up the surrounding environment, leaned into Ji Zhengyao’s ear, and asked in a tiny voice.

"Heh."

This was the first time he had seen Ling Ting being so sneaky and secretive.

Flicking his finger against her forehead, Ji Zhengyao chuckled. "Don't worry, I have other investments."

He knew what the little girl meant; she must have thought he was involved in corruption or bribery.

Ling Ting felt very embarrassed about misunderstanding Ji Zhengyao, her ears turning red as she lowered her head.

People at work all said Ji Zhengyao came from a good family; how could she have been so rude as to misunderstand him?

"Let's go."

Ji Zhengyao sighed helplessly, took Ling Ting’s hand, and headed upstairs.

The little girl was concerned about him; he should be satisfied.

"Come on in."

Ji Zhengyao led Ling Ting to the twentieth floor, and after exiting the elevator, he punched in the code on the digital lock.

He didn't hide it from Ling Ting and even deliberately read the numbers out loud.

However, Ling Ting was simple-minded and didn't understand Ji Zhengyao’s painstaking efforts at all; she turned her face away, intentionally not listening.

Ji Zhengyao: "..."

All that effort wasted.
